Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: War is Business, and Business is Hell Welcome to the Inner Sphere, Commander You are a Mercenary, standing on the Bridge of your very own Argo, a mobile Space Station, looking forward to a life of conflict among the warring factions of Humanity. Will you Prosper, or be remembered only as yet another thug who couldn't cut it?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战争是生意，而生意就是地狱 欢迎来到内层星域，指挥官 你是一名雇佣兵，站在属于自己的阿尔戈舰桥上——那是一座移动空间站，期待在人类彼此交战的各种势力之间过上充满冲突的生活。 你会兴旺发达，还是只被记为又一个混不下去的暴徒？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: During the First Succession war the Aalzorg system was abandoned after being rendered mostly uninhabitable due to the fighting, and was removed from many maps.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 第一次继承战争期间，Aalzorg星系因战斗而变得大部分无法居住，随后被废弃，并从许多地图上被移除.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Abadan has been affiliated with the Free Worlds League for much of its history. Abadan is home to facilities owned by two defense manufacturers, Adam Tech Industries and Austen-Armstrong Industries.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Abadan在其历史的大部分时间里一直隶属于自由世界联盟. Abadan是两家防务制造商——Adam Tech Industries和Austen-Armstrong Industries——所拥有设施的所在地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The planet Abagnar is a simple agricultural world of little significance; most of the planetary population lived in or around the capital city, Hancock City, and the only notable establishment is the School of Medicines and Medical Procedures.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 行星Abagnar是一个无足轻重的简单农业世界；行星上的大部分人口都居住在首府汉考克市及其周边，唯一值得一提的设施是医药与医疗程序学院.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An unremarkable system that has been Lyran controlled for many centuries, noted only for the mining facilities built to withstand the high gravity and rocky terrain, as well as being located only a week's travel from the jump point.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个平平无奇的星系，已被莱兰联邦控制了数个世纪，唯一值得一提的是为抵御高重力和崎岖地形而建造的采矿设施，以及从这里到跳跃点只需一周航程。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The capital city of Cottontown on the planet of Abbeville perfectly describes this simple agricultural world, devoted almost entirely to the production of agricultural and trading goods for export.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Abbeville行星上的首府Cottontown完美地诠释了这个简朴的农业世界，它几乎完全专注于生产供出口的农产品和贸易商品.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The low gravity water world of Abejorral is a popular destination for many members of the aristocracy, with its small population devoted almost entirely to a service based economy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Abejorral是一个低重力水世界，是许多贵族成员的热门目的地，其稀少的人口几乎完全投身于以服务业为基础的经济.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Formed by the Rims World Republic before the Starleague and later annexed by the Lyran Commonwealth in the ending days of the Star League. Extensive mining operations cover the planet. Outside of mining this system is a quiet backwater.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由边缘世界共和国在星际联盟成立前建立，后在星际联盟末期被天琴共同体吞并. 星球上遍布大规模采矿作业. 除采矿外，这个星系是个安静的穷乡僻壤.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Abiy Adi III is the third planet in the Abiy Adi system. Abiy Adi is a dry and arid world orbited by a single moon, Amarigna, and the surface of Abiy Adi is home to a factory owned and operated by Luthien Armor Works (LAW).
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Abiy Adi III是Abiy Adi星系中的第三颗行星. Abiy Adi是一颗干燥干旱的星球，由一颗名为Amarigna的卫星环绕，而Abiy Adi的表面坐落着一座由Luthien Armor Works（LAW）拥有并运营的工厂.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Large quantities of germanium present prompted Hunter's Paradise and Gillfillan's Gold to collectively form a colony on Able's Glory. Outside of mining the colony is mostly used as a safe jump point for jump ship traffic.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大量的锗促使猎人天堂与吉尔菲兰之金共同在艾布尔之荣建立了一处殖民地。除采矿之外，该殖民地主要被用作跃迁舰交通的安全跳跃点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: During the Third Succession war the Aboukir system was abandoned after being depopulated in the fighting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在第三次继承战争期间，Aboukir星系在战斗中人口灭绝后被放弃.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled at some point during the Star League era, this minor system contains numerous moons rich in minerals.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时代的某个时期被殖民，这个小型星系拥有众多富含矿藏的卫星.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Forming a part of the St. Ives Commonality region of the Capellan Confederation, Abruzzi was conquered or annexed by the Federated Suns during the Second Succession War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为卡佩拉邦联St. Ives共同区的一部分，Abruzzi在第二次继承战争期间被恒星联邦征服或吞并.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Abushiri was settled by the Rim Worlds Republic during the Star League era, then conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth, before succumbing to the fighting in the Third Succession war and being abandoned.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Abushiri在星际联盟时代由边缘世界共和国建立定居点，随后被天琴共同体征服，最终在第三次继承战争中因战火而沦陷并被废弃.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Acala system changed hands between the Federated Suns and the Capellan Confederation at least twice after the system was settled and was on the border between the two nations for most of the history of the two states.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Acala星系在被殖民后，至少在恒星联邦和卡佩拉邦联之间易手过两次，并且在两国的大部分历史中，它都位于两国边境上.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Acamar system has ten planets and a substantial asteroid belt named Illeudian, which is the site of a number of mining operations due to the massive mineral deposits located in the system. Acamar VIII is more commonly referred to as Acamar.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Acamar星系拥有十颗行星以及一条名为Illeudian的庞大行星带. 由于该星系蕴藏着大量矿藏，这里成为了许多采矿作业的所在地. Acamar VIII通常更常被称为Acamar.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Accrington was settled prior to the beginning of the Age of War, with the system forming a part of the interstellar proto-nation known as the Federation of Skye and subsequently the Lyran Commonwealth.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Accrington在战争时代开始之前就已被殖民，该星系构成了被称为斯凯联邦的星际雏形国家的一部分，随后又成为天琴共同体的一部分.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Achilles system was settled during the Star League era but vanished from most maps by the time of the Third Succession War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Achilles星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，但到第三次继承战争时已从大多数星图上消失.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Achnoly vanished from maps during the Second Succession War, indicating that the system had been abandoned, depopulated, or rendered too insignificant to merit further recording on maps.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Achnoly在第二次继承战争期间从星图上消失，表明该星系已被废弃、人口流失，或变得过于无足轻重，不值得在星图上继续记录.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Achton vanished from maps during the Third Succession War, indicating that the system had been abandoned, depopulated, or rendered too insignificant to merit further recording on maps.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Achton在第三次继承战争期间从地图上消失，这表明该星系已被废弃、人口尽失，或因变得过于无足轻重而不值得在地图上继续记录.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Acoma vanished from maps during the First Succession War, depopulated due to the viscous and unrelenting fighting at the time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 第一次继承战争期间，Acoma从地图上消失了；由于当时残酷无情且毫不松懈的战斗，该地人口灭绝.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Aconcagua system was settled during the First Exodus from Terra, and subsequently became part of the Free Worlds League. Boreholes on the fifth planet allow access to rich deposits within the mantle, though high gravity makes mining dangerous.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Aconcagua星系在第一次从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间被殖民，随后成为自由世界联盟的一部分. 第五颗行星上的钻孔可通往地幔内丰富的矿藏，不过高重力使采矿十分危险.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Acrux (Alpha Crucis) system is a multiple star system that is a part of the region of the Free Worlds League which was commonly referred to as the Bolan Thumb.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: The Acrux (Alpha Crucis) 星系是一个多星系统，是自由世界联盟通常称为Bolan Thumb的区域的一部分.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Acubens system was settled during the First Exodus from Terra, when habitable bands suitable for agriculture were discovered on the icy second planet orbiting a large gas giant.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Acubens星系是在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间被拓殖的，当时在一颗环绕大型气态巨行星运行的冰封第二行星上发现了适合农业的宜居地带.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: On Addasar, glaciers have carved out beautiful fjords in the tropics and a Magistracy settlement perches in the peaks, where they mine some of the rarest gemstones in the Periphery.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在阿达萨尔，冰川在热带地区雕琢出了美丽的峡湾，一座自治区定居点就坐落在山峰上，在那儿，他们开采出了外围最稀有的宝石.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Addhara is a recently formed colony, a large population of sheep like animals were discovered here and soon their meat became a regional delicacy. Also their wool makes nice hats. Agromech's are needed to herd them as they grow to 3 meters.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿达拉是最近才建立的殖民地，这里发现了大量类似绵羊的动物，其肉很快成为当地珍馐。它们的羊毛还能做成漂亮的帽子。由于它们能长到3米，需要农用机甲来放牧。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Addicks system has changed hands repeatedly since it was colonized at some point prior to the Age of War. Addicks IV is the main planet in the system, known for its major manufacturing capabilities.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Addicks星系自其在战争时代之前的某个时期被殖民以来，已多次易手. Addicks IV是该星系的主要行星，以其强大的制造能力而闻名.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ad Duwayd is not a very hospitable planet. Geothermal vents allow for extensive under ice fisheries. Large silo like structures are built through the ice. Most of the population live in these large under ice facilities.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Ad Duwayd并不是一颗非常宜居的行星. 地热喷口使得大规模的冰下渔业成为可能. 巨大的筒仓状建筑贯穿冰层而建. 大部分人口居住在这些大型冰下设施中.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Before the Star League, Adelaide's claim to fame was the longest individual hour of any Lyran system at 89 min an hour. Not much has changed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星盟之前，阿德莱德值得一提之处是它拥有莱兰各星系中最长的个人小时，每小时89分钟。此后变化不大。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Adelson is a world basking in the blue glow of its B class star. This causes the plants to grow orange, yellow and red. Being an agricultural center, many call it the Red Basket.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Adelson是一颗沐浴在其B型恒星蓝色光辉下的世界. 这使得植物呈现出橙色、黄色和红色. 作为农业中心，许多人称它为红色篮子.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Adhafera is filled with sweatshops and other textile manufacturing. The rivers are dyed different colors by the factories. Every year the citizens celebrate with a rainbow festival and the rivers are dyed rainbow. Don't eat the fish.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿达菲拉遍地是血汗工厂与其他纺织制造业。工厂把河水染成不同颜色。每年市民都会以彩虹节庆祝，河水也被染成彩虹色。别吃那里的鱼。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally named Adhara the planetary government had to change the name to Trip after too many misshipping accidents. Negotiations for the 1000 tons of Agromech shears misdelivered is still a hot topic of debate amongst locals.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初名为Adhara，但因误运事故过多，行星政府不得不将名称改为Trip. 围绕误交付的1000吨农业机甲剪切机展开的谈判，至今仍是当地人热议的话题.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Adherlwin's manufacturing and mining operations made it a target of SLDF in the Star League days. Not important enough for a garrison the world was conquered and the SLDF moved on. Eventually it was reincorporated into the Magistracy of Canopus.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿德赫温的制造业与采矿业使其在星际联盟时代成为SLDF的目标。它不够重要到需要驻军，于是被征服后SLDF便离开了。最终它被重新并入卡诺帕斯行政区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Abandoned due to a nuclear winter caused by strikes during the Second Succession war.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 因第二次继承战争期间的袭击引发的核冬天而被废弃.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The surface of Adrar is ruined and polluted after an early attempt at independence was quelled, harshly, by Capellan forces. The remaining population struggles to sustain an agricultural industry in the wreckage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿德拉尔在早先一次独立的企图被镇压后，地表就被卡佩拉军队无情地破坏并污染了. 剩余的人口在废墟中苦苦地维持着一家农企.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Adrian was initially founded as a Buddhist temple. Now it is a tourism location since most of the world has been turned into buddhist temples and gardens. Pilgrims make journeys here from across the Inner Sphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Adrian最初是作为一座佛教寺庙建立的. 如今，由于这个世界的大部分地区都已变成佛教寺庙和园林，这里成了一个旅游胜地. 朝圣者从内天体各处前来此地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Aea is a wet, lush, tropical world with an atmosphere dense with foul-smelling sulfurous volcanic outgassing. ComStar maintains an HPG facility on the planet; support of that facility is the only reason the system still boasts colonists.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 埃尔亚是一个潮湿，郁郁葱葱的热带行星，大气中弥漫着恶臭的含硫火山气体. 通讯之星在该星球维持着一座HPG设施; 对该设施的支持是该星系仍然拥有殖民者的唯一原因.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Aea is a wet, lush, tropical world with an atmosphere dense with foul-smelling sulfurous volcanic outgassing. ComStar maintains an HPG facility on the planet; support of that facility is the only reason the system still boasts colonists.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 埃尔亚是一个潮湿，郁郁葱葱的热带行星，大气中弥漫着恶臭的含硫火山气体. 通讯之星在该星球维持着一座HPG设施; 对该设施的支持是该星系仍然拥有殖民者的唯一原因.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A very recent colony of Polygamists was formed here. While mainly a farming world, many pirate hideouts are present on the two habitable moons, leading to a nice blackmarket on planet, where it's said even people are bought and sold.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一群一夫多妻者在此建立了非常新的殖民地。虽然该星球主要是农业世界，但两颗宜居卫星上存在许多海盗藏身处，催生了星球上一处不错的黑市——据说那里连人都可以买卖。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: “Yes that Afarsin! You may recognize our planet from the SLDF videos of Battlemechs playing volleyball! Come enjoy our beaches and you too could have fun in the sun!” -Excerpt from Afarsin’s tourism board. When not playing volleyball the locals farm
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: “对，就是那个阿法尔辛！你也许能从SLDF机甲打排球的视频里认出我们星球！来享受我们的海滩，你也能在阳光下玩得开心！”——《阿法尔辛旅游局宣传册》摘录。不打排球的时候，当地人种地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Recently rediscovered, Afleir went uncharted on maps for over 200 years. The locals just thought their habit of eating people scared non pirates off. The pirates have made a good living smuggling in “food” for the local populace.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最近才被重新发现，Afleir在地图上未标注的状态持续了 200 多年. 当地人只以为是自己吃人的习惯把非海盗都吓跑了. 海盗们则靠给当地民众走私“食物”过上了好日子.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Amish and Mennonites colonized the planet, unfortunately a local apex predator hunted them until they were forced to use modern technology. Now the planet exists with enclaves of Amish and Mennonites, but is heavily modernized.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿米什人和门诺教徒殖民了这颗行星，不幸的是，一种当地顶级掠食者猎捕他们，直到他们被迫使用现代技术. 如今这颗行星上仍有阿米什人和门诺教徒的聚居区，但已高度现代化.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Initially colonized for religious freedom, after a few hundred years the Draconis Combine annexed the system. Later it became the seat of Ishikawajima-Harima Battle Armor Industries, who owned 2 factories producing arms and armor for the DC.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初是为了宗教自由而殖民，几百年后，天龙联合体吞并了该星系. 后来，它成为石川岛播磨战斗装甲工业的总部所在地，该公司拥有两座为天龙联合体生产武器和装甲的工厂.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Destroyed during the Second Succession War, Aggstein was abandoned. Recently pirate activity has prompted the Federated Suns to re-explore the system to verify the House Liao is not preparing a surprise attack on other systems in the area.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Aggstein在第二次继承战争期间被摧毁后便遭废弃. 最近，海盗活动促使恒星联邦重新探索该星系，以确认廖氏家族并未准备对该区域的其他星系发动突袭.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Known for its production of alcohol, Agliana has many aquatic resources it exports. Not the least of which is ice. Alcoholic ice is a favorite of worlds around the Inner Sphere, with Solaris being a major importer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Agliana以出产酒精而闻名，拥有许多可供出口的水生资源. 冰便是其中之一. 酒精冰是内天体周边世界的最爱，Solaris则是主要进口方.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Abandoned during the Third Succession War, rumours abound of some colonists attempting to restart a colony here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在第三次继承战争期间被废弃，有传言称一些殖民者正试图在此重新建立殖民地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: On Ahlat, a tiny Taurian installation mines rare isotopes at one pole, while at the other, a rickety collection of scuttled ships are chained together into a pirate stronghold. Sometimes, in sealed caves in the tropics, there's a not-so-secret market.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在阿赫拉特，一颗微小的金牛座设施在一极开采稀有同位素，另一极则是一堆摇摇欲坠的报废飞船被链成一处的海盗据点。有时，在热带那些封闭洞穴里，还有一处不太秘密的市场。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Abandoned after the 3rd Succession War, Aigle was removed from most maps of the known Inner Sphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在第三次继承战争后被废弃，Aigle已从已知内天体的大多数地图上移除.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Natives from the agricultural world of Aiguebelle follow a complex code of law that takes years to learn thoroughly. Unsurprisingly many leave when given the chance, breaking 1-hx75b, the law against leaving.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Aiguebelle农业星球的原住民遵循一套复杂的法典，需要多年才能彻底学透. 不出所料，许多人一有机会就离开，违反了禁止离开的 1-hx75b法.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Home of the Aitutaki Academy, this economic and agricultural powerhouse was one of the main worlds of the Principality of Regulus. After the Free Worlds League took over, the planet was still a hotbed of dissent, many SAFE agents were assigned here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Aitutaki学院的所在地，这个世界曾是Regulus公国的主要世界之一，也是经济和农业重镇. 自由世界联盟接管后，这颗行星仍是异见活动的温床，许多SAFE特工被派驻于此.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Home to the Diplan Mechyards, the whole population lives in the Diplan Mechworks Fortress, or is involved in mining. Criminals are sent outside for a breath of fresh air, as the atmosphere is poisonous and uninhabitable.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为Diplan机甲工场的所在地，全体人口都住在Diplan机甲工厂堡垒里，或从事采矿. 罪犯会被送到外面去呼吸新鲜空气，因为大气有毒且不适宜居住.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Akfata is a remarkably boring system. It's main product is agriculture and some mining. Some people enjoy a slower, quieter pace of life and so it has a large population and tech level. It isn't quite backwater but close.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿克法塔是一个极其无聊的星系。它的主要产品是农产品和一些矿产。有些人喜欢更慢、更安静的生活节奏，所以它人口众多、技术水平也不低。算不上穷乡僻壤，但也差不多了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alamagordo was once a bustling, growing colony. Unfortunately, the world is a flash-point for conflicts between Liao and Marik, and repeated conquests reduced the infrastructure to rubble. The remaining residents eke out a living by farming.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔马戈多曾经是一个日益繁华的殖民地. 不幸的是，这个星球是廖氏和马里克之间冲突的一个导火索. 反复的侵略将这里的基础设施化为瓦砾. 剩下的居民苦苦地以务农为生.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alarion is the administrative capital of the Alarion Province and is home to a number of industries including JumpShip and WarShip manufacturers, such as Bowie Industries and the Alarion Naval Academy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Alarion是Alarion省的行政首府，也是众多工业的所在地，其中包括跃迁舰和战舰制造商，如鲍伊工业和Alarion海军学院.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Albalii is an excellent example of arid terraforming. When first colonized, the interiors of the planet were deserts, using dropships and vast amounts of purified seawater, the interiors of the continents were turned into lush crop producing havens.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Albalii是干旱地球化改造的一个绝佳范例. 最初殖民时，这颗行星的内陆地区还是沙漠；后来借助降落飞船和大量净化海水，大陆腹地被改造成了郁郁葱葱的产粮乐土.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: There are reports of a habitable planet in this system, and also pirate ghost stories! As of yet no effort has been made to find Morituri's Ghost Awesome. Although some say if you listen to the wind at night, you can hear him howling...
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 有报告称该星系存在一颗宜居行星，还有海盗鬼故事！到目前为止，还没有人努力去找莫里图里的幽灵"恐怖"。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A quiet agricultural system, its sole claim to fame is a ancient monument to the SLDF troopers who conducted a HALO insertion to eliminate a pirate band who took a whole city hostage hundreds of years ago.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个安静的农业星系，它唯一出名之处是一座古老的纪念碑，纪念数百年前执行HALO空降渗透、消灭了一伙劫持整座城市为人质的海盗的SLDF士兵.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Home to the Holden Mining Corporation, and Prefecture capital of the Albiero Prefecture, this world contains vast iron and copper deposits. Recent wars and tech loss have caused many mines to close, and the population is slowly diminishing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这里是Holden Mining Corporation的所在地，也是Albiero Prefecture的首府；这颗星球蕴藏着丰富的铁和铜矿藏. 近期的战争与技术遗失导致许多矿场关闭，人口正在缓慢减少.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: There is not a world here, keep looking. Definitely not a “Pentagon World” whatever that means. Also what is a Burrock? I haven’t ever seen one have you!? Leave freebirth, or so help me I’ll send the ghost of Kerensky after you!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这里没有世界，继续找。绝对不是什么"五角世界"，管那是什么意思。还有，什么是岩蜍？我从没见过，你见过吗！？滚开，自由出生者，否则我发誓我会派克伦斯基的鬼魂来追你！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Albion system was settled during the Star League era and vanished from maps during the Third Succession War indicating that the system had been abandoned or depopulated.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Albion星系在星际联盟时代有人定居，并在第三次继承战争期间从地图上消失，这表明该星系已被废弃或人口锐减.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Here there be Vikings! But don't worry they left the Inner Sphere to get away from war. Still.... Vikings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这里有维京人！但别担心，他们离开内天体是为了远离战争。不过……维京人。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Due to an extreme axial tilt, Alchiba is split into two very different biomes. The northern half is temperate and has the entire world's agriculture sector, while the southern half is exclusively for mining. No industry outside these exist on Alchiba
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由于极端的转轴倾角，阿尔基巴被分为两个截然不同的生物群系。北半部气候温和，拥有全世界的农业部门，而南半部专用于采矿。除此之外阿尔基巴上不存在任何工业

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Minerals attracted the first colonizers to Alcor. Unfortunately Alcor doesn't have a diverse enough biome to support extended farming. So Alcor out of necessity became a trading hub. This arrangement has worked well over the last 800 years.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 矿产吸引了最初的殖民者来到阿尔科尔。不幸的是，阿尔科尔没有足够多样的生物群系来支撑长期农业。于是阿尔科尔出于必要成了贸易枢纽。这套安排在过去800年里运作良好。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alcyone has been traded between the different factions since its inception in 2036. Farmers have learned to stay away from the cities as they become host to invading armies every few decades.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Alcyone自2036年建立以来，就一直在不同派系之间易手. 农民们已经学会远离城市，因为这些城市每隔几十年就会成为入侵军队的驻扎地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Throughout its history, Aldebaran has been a contested world. Until recently, House Liao was able to maintain control through all the invasions. However in 3028 House Davion finally succeeded in wresting control and have held firm to counter attacks.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 纵观其历史，Aldebaran一直是一个争夺激烈的世界. 直到最近，廖氏家族仍能在所有入侵中维持控制. 然而在3028年，戴维恩家族终于成功夺取了控制权，并牢牢顶住了反攻.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Aldertaine is known for their popular children's drink, Aldertiane Blue. Aldertaine corporations pay lots of money to Comstar to have their commercials played beside cartoons across the Innersphere. Rumors of permanent blue teeth are unfounded.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 奥尔德泰恩以其广受欢迎的儿童饮品"奥尔德泰恩蓝"闻名。奥尔德泰恩的企业花大钱付给康星，让他们的广告在内天体各处的卡通片旁边播出。关于牙齿会永久变蓝的传言毫无根据。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Formerly a Terran world, Alrecht was abandoned during the First Succession War due to most of the population being wiped out.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Alrecht曾是一颗泰伦星球，在第一次继承战争期间因大部分人口被消灭而被废弃.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alegro was named for the 21st century drug Allegra. The local dialect changed it eventually to Alegro. It was named this because it was the only drug found to stop the psychosis caused by the local mushroom spores.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Alegro得名于21世纪的药物Allegra. 当地方言最终将其改成了Alegro. 之所以这样命名，是因为它是唯一被发现能阻止当地蘑菇孢子引起的精神病的药物.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Formed during a mass exodus from what used to be Russia, this colony is known for its potato based economy. It's also has the best damn vodka in Lyran space and Katrina Steiner is known to keep a bottle in her bar at all times.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这个殖民地是在一次从前俄罗斯地区的大规模外流中建立的，以马铃薯经济著称。它还拥有莱兰空间最好的伏特加，据说卡特琳娜·施泰纳的酒吧里永远备着一瓶。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Known for its pastoral beauty and high culture, Alexandria has been a hub of the arts since the Star league. Unfortunately this also made it a target during the Succession wars, and is now constantly under siege from one aggressor or another.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Alexandria以其田园之美和高雅文化而闻名，自星际联盟时代以来一直是艺术中心. 不幸的是，这也使它在继承战争期间成为目标，如今则不断遭到不同侵略者的围攻.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once a populous and profitable mining colony, local strife abruptly depopulated Alexandria, as well as poisoning most of the native life.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 亚历山德里亚曾是一个人口稠密，利润丰厚的矿业殖民地，当地的冲突使它的人口急剧下降，同时也荼毒了大部分的土著生物.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Alexandrian Covenant is a group of systems that moved away from the Magistracy of Canopus and settled 3 different systems. Not much is known about these systems and only recent exploration expeditions have confirmed their existence.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: The Alexandrian Covenant是一组从船底自治区分离出来并定居在3个不同星系的星系. 关于这些星系所知甚少，只有最近的探索远征才证实了它们的存在.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Discovered by a misjump that damaged their jumpship's K-F drive. Alfirk has remained isolated for hundreds of years. Only Comstar has had any contact with Alfirk. Comstar helped cure a plague and promoted isolationism based on their view of the IS.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它由一次损坏了跃迁舰K-F驱动器的跳跃失误而被发现。阿尔弗克已与世隔绝数百年。只有通讯之星与阿尔弗克有过接触。通讯之星帮助治愈了一场瘟疫，并基于他们对内层星域的看法推行了孤立主义。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A strategic world for both the Star League and the DC. Algate has housed a military company almost since its founding. The world itself is mainly an agricultural center, with many comparing it to Kansas on Earth.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对星际联盟和DC双方来说，这都是一个战略要地. Algate几乎自建立之初就驻扎着一支连级部队. 这个世界本身主要是一个农业中心，许多人将其比作地球上的堪萨斯.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As the capital system of the Algedi Prefecture, Algedi is a major trade and manufacturing system. As such it is heavily defended and boast a large Bazaar in the capital city Algiers, where it is said you can find anything your heart desires.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为Algedi行政区的首府星系，Algedi是一个重要的贸易与制造星系. 因此，它防御森严，并在首府城市Algiers拥有一个大型集市，据说在那里你可以找到任何心之所向的东西.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A recent addition to the Hegemony, Algenib was colonized for the vast mineral wealth found under its ice sheets. After colonization it was found that the ice was actually Earth standard fresh water and ice shipping operation soon commenced.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为霸权新近纳入的领地，Algenib因在其冰盖下发现的丰富矿产资源而被殖民. 殖民之后，人们发现这些冰实际上是地球标准淡水，于是运冰业务很快便开始了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled to take advantage of the rich supply of fish, the discovery of rich fertile soil led to it being developed for agricultural concerns, and Algol would go on to be an major exporter to every planet within a jump of itself.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初定居于此是为了利用丰富的鱼类资源，而肥沃土壤的发现促使其被开发为农业产业；Algol后来则成为其一次跃迁范围内每颗行星的主要出口方.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A binary star system with a K class star orbiting an A class supergiant. The planet's economy is based on mining and ore extraction. To protect themselves from the intense solar radiation, most of the Alborabians live in underground cities.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个双星系统，一颗K级恒星围绕一颗A级超巨星运行。该行星的经济以采矿与矿石开采为基础。为保护自己免受强烈的太阳辐射，大多数阿尔博拉比人住在地下城市里。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Algot is a beautiful Terran world with a reputation for being bad for ones health - due to a plague centuries ago. Ironically it has one of the highest life expectancies in the Federated Suns.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Algot是一颗美丽的类地世界，因几个世纪前的一场瘟疫而落得对健康有害的名声. 讽刺的是，它却拥有恒星联邦中最高的预期寿命之一.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alhena is a world that travels between two suns via an eccentric orbit, leading to long winters and short summers. The lack of arable land on the surface and a lack of free water on the surface meant that Alhena needs to import most of their food.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Alhena是一颗以偏心轨道在两颗恒星之间运行的星球，这导致其冬季漫长、夏季短暂. 地表缺乏可耕地，也缺乏自由水，这意味着Alhena需要进口其大部分食物.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Al Hillah system was settled during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and before the Age of War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Al Hillah星系是在从泰拉出发的第一次大迁徙期间或之后不久、并在战争时代之前被殖民的.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alioth's most distinctive feature is its atmosphere, which can best be described as hyper-oxygenated. The high oxygen content allows plant life to flourish on the world, making it a true breadbasket.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿里奥最显著的特征是它的大气，最恰当的描述是高度富氧。高含氧量让植物在该行星茂盛生长，使它成为真正的粮仓。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Al Jafr system was home to at least one habitable world, and was located in the Timbuktu Theater of the Lyran Commonwealth.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Al Jafr星系至少拥有一颗宜居星球，位于天琴共同体的廷巴克图战区.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Al Jubaylah is a farming world. Most the world is plains and to maximize farmable land the cities and rich live in the few mountainous areas. The ruling Mullahs are even handed and it is a prosperous world whose citizens enjoy freedoms most do not.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Al Jubaylah是一个农业星球. 该星球大部分为平原，为了最大化可耕种土地，城市和富人都居住在为数不多的山区. 统治的毛拉们处事公正，这是一个繁荣的星球，其公民享有大多数地方所没有的自由.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alkaid is situated four months away from the nearest jump point and has a single moon named Vishnu. Alkaid has been home to a substantial chemical industry for centuries, hosting such companies as Toloy Chemicals.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Alkaid距离最近的跃迁点有四个月路程，并拥有一颗名为Vishnu的卫星. 数个世纪以来，Alkaid一直是规模可观的化学工业所在地，拥有Toloy Chemicals等公司.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alkalurops is a world laden with a dense atmosphere that frequently spawns hurricanes and tornadoes. The colonists (mostly miners and natural gas exporters) constructed most of their homes in the caves and cliffs of the planet's mountain ranges.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔卡鲁普斯是一颗大气浓密、频繁生成飓风与龙卷风的世界。殖民者（大多是矿工与天然气出口商）把大部分住所建在该行星山脉的洞穴与峭壁中。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alkes is covered with vast, deep oceans. A large axial tilt and a highly elliptical orbit make for extremes of temperature, driving a highly unpredictable and notoriously unpleasant weather system.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Alkes被广阔而深邃的海洋覆盖. 巨大的轴倾角和高度椭圆的轨道造成了极端的温度变化，催生出极其难以预测且出了名地恶劣的天气系统.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alktral's only major landmass features rocky terrain and several active volcanoes. No indigenous lifeforms exist here, and the only human habitation was centered around small-scale mining operations which is now abandoned.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔克特拉尔唯一的大陆以岩石地形和数座活火山为特征。这里没有本土生命，唯一的人类居住点围绕着小规模采矿作业，如今已被废弃。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An agricultural world which grows the native plumberry - a thumb-sized purple fruit which tasted like a cross between a blueberry and a lemon. The plumberry wine industry employs millions of seasonal workers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个农业世界，种植着本地的plumberry——一种拇指大小、紫色的果实，尝起来像是蓝莓和柠檬的混合体. plumberry葡萄酒产业雇佣了数百万季节性工人.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A desert world with a nitrogen/oxygen atmosphere. The planet's only ocean surrounds its northern ice-cap.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一颗拥有氮氧大气的沙漠行星。该行星唯一的海洋环绕着它的北极冰盖。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Allerton is a large world with a hefty manufacturing base dedicated to light vehicles and scout Mechs. Once devastated during the First Succession War, its economic output is only just now returning to historic levels.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Allerton是一颗大型星球，拥有规模庞大的制造基地，专门生产轻型车辆和侦察机甲. 它曾在第一次继承战争期间遭到严重破坏，其经济产出直到现在才刚刚恢复到历史水平.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alloway is rocky and barren, except for a 200km-wide equatorial band of lush jungle that teems with native life. Human settlements are mostly concentrated on the edges of this band.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿洛韦是片满是石头的不毛之地，只有一条200公里宽的赤道带具有茂密的丛林，拥有大量的土著生物. 人类定居点多集中于这一地带的边缘.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alloway is rocky and barren, except for a 200km-wide equatorial band of lush jungle that teems with native life. Human settlements are mostly concentrated on the edges of this band.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿洛韦是片满是石头的不毛之地，只有一条200公里宽的赤道带具有茂密的丛林，拥有大量的土著生物. 人类定居点多集中于这一地带的边缘.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alma Alta system was settled during or just after the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the Protectorate of Donegal when the Protectorate joined with the Tamar Pact and Federation of Skye to form the Lyran Commonwealth in 2341.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Alma Alta星系是在第一次离开地球的大迁徙期间或刚结束后不久被开拓的，并且在2341年多尼戈尔保护国与塔马尔公约和斯凯联邦合并组建天琴共同体时，它是该保护国的一员.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Almach is an oft contested world. The real item of interest is Almach's extensive ocean-farming installations. Prior to the Succession Wars the products of Almach's seas fed every world in the Chesterton Commonality
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔马赫是一颗常被争夺的行星。真正有价值的其实是阿尔马赫规模庞大的海洋养殖设施。在继承战争之前，阿尔马赫海域的产物供养着切斯特顿共同体中的每一颗行星

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A small planetoid orbit a gas giant, Almunge is nevertheless a majestically habitable world with lush grass and rolling green hills.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一颗小行星体环绕着一颗气态巨行星运行，尽管如此，Almunge仍是一个极为宜居的壮丽世界，有着茂密的草地和连绵起伏的绿色丘陵.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alnadal was settled during the Star League era and was an oft traded border world between the Federated Suns and Draconis Combine, until the Third Succession War when it was finally abandoned. Little remains of the mining facilities.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Alnadal在星际联盟时代得到殖民开发，是恒星联邦与天龙联合体之间一个频繁易手的边境世界，直到第三次继承战争期间才最终被废弃. 采矿设施已所剩无几.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Capital of the Al Na'ir Prefecture in the DC, The system has 2 major population centers, Al Na'ir itself and the Yuri Mech Works, located in domed cities in the asteroid belt around the planets. It is one of the most valuable systems the DC owns.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为DC中阿尔纳伊尔管区的首府，该星系有两个主要人口中心：阿尔纳伊尔本身与尤里机甲厂，后者位于该行星周围小行星带中的穹顶城市里。它是DC拥有的最有价值的星系之一。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alnasi is known for its vast ore mining and mineral facilities dotted around the capital city of Gantarius. The low gravity makes sending large amounts of material to orbit extremely cost effective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Alnasi以其遍布首府城市Gantarius周围的庞大矿石开采和矿物设施而闻名. 低重力使得将大量材料送入轨道极具成本效益.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alorton was one of fifty-one contested worlds to be placed under Terran Hegemony authority during the Star League era. During the First Succession War Alorton once more became a flashpoint between the Free Worlds League and Lyran Commonwealth.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Alorton是星际联盟时代被置于泰拉霸权管辖之下的五十一个争议世界之一. 第一次继承战争期间，Alorton再次成为自由世界联盟与天琴共同体之间的冲突焦点.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alpha Eridani II - named Achernar by the population - has been inhabited for centuries and is host to a number of industrial facilities belonging to companies such as Achernar IndustrialMechs, Achernar BattleMechs and Valiant Systems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Alpha Eridani II——被当地居民称为Achernar——已有数百年的居住历史，并且是多家工业设施的所在地，这些设施属于Achernar IndustrialMechs、Achernar BattleMechs和Valiant Systems等公司.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alphard is is known for its precious ore mining and gem refining facilities dotted around the capital city of Haquinus.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Alphard以其珍贵的矿石开采和宝石精炼设施而闻名，这些设施散布在首都Haquinus周围.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The capital of the Marian Hegemony since that nation was founded, Alphard was host to at least two major manufacturers - Alphard Trading Corporation and Marian Arms Incorporated - as well as an aerospace training academy and the Senate House.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 自马里安霸权建国以来，Alphard一直是其首都，这里至少拥有两家主要制造商——Alphard Trading Corporation和Marian Arms Incorporated——以及一所航空航天训练学院和参议院大楼.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Alphecca system was settled prior to the mid-twenty-fourth century and was a member of the Federation of Skye prior to the formation of the Lyran Commonwealth. Alphecca II is the second planet in the Alphecca system.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Alphecca星系在二十四世纪中叶之前就有人定居，并且在天琴共同体成立之前是斯凯联邦的成员. Alphecca II是Alphecca星系中的第二颗行星.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alpheratz is the fourth planet in the and the Capital of the Outworlds Alliance. Alpheratz is home to the Alliance Executive Parliament and the largest weapons industry in the Alliance. Alpheratz has a single moon named Aisha.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Alpheratz是该星系中的第四颗行星，也是外域联盟的首都. Alpheratz是联盟执行议会和联盟内最大武器工业的所在地. Alpheratz有一颗名为Aisha的卫星.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alrakis II is the second planet of three in the Alrakis system and has five moons named Cassius, Delvia, Fermosa, Weir, and Zalazar, many of which are rich in minerals making this system hotly contested during the succession wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Alrakis II是Alrakis星系三颗行星中的第二颗，拥有五颗卫星，分别名为Cassius、Delvia、Fermosa、Weir和Zalazar，其中许多卫星富含矿物，使该星系在继承战争期间成为激烈争夺之地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alrescha was colonized to feed the peoples of Tikonov in the 2300s. It was not the most ideal candidate for a farm world because of its unbreathable atmosphere. However it was close, warm and wet, just the way Tikonovians liked.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Alrescha被殖民是为了在2300年代养活Tikonov的人民. 由于大气无法呼吸，它并不是农业世界的最理想候选地. 然而，它距离近、温暖且湿润，正合Tikonov人的喜好.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alsek's claim to fame is that a ruling Davion died here! In 2445 Major Arthur Davion died while fighting against rebels on the planet. Since they are apart of the Federated Suns, they don't talk about it much.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔塞克之所以出名，是因为一位戴维恩统治者死在这里！2445年，亚瑟·戴维恩少校在该星球与叛军作战时阵亡。由于他们属于联邦太阳国，这事他们不太提起。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A heavily forested world with abundant mineral reserves, which has extensive Mechfactories creating Dragon and Panther 'Mechs for the Combine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一颗森林茂密、矿产储量丰富的行星，拥有大量机甲工厂，为联合体生产龙与黑豹机甲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alta vanished from maps during the Third Succession War, abandoned due to the fighting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在第三次继承战争期间，Alta从星图上消失，因战火而被遗弃.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The system has a class F7III star that produces an unusual amount of surface activity. Solar storms leave Altair without comms for long periods, and so it is unsurprising that the system has been subjected to numerous raids throughout its history.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该星系拥有一颗F7III型恒星，其表面活动异常频繁. 太阳风暴使Altair长时间无法通讯，因此，该星系在历史上遭受过无数次袭击也就不足为奇了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The jungles and prairies that originally lured settlers to this world were gone when a comet hit the equator soon after colonization, causing mass extinctions. It also caused active volcanism and rare earth metals to become readily available.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 殖民后不久，一颗彗星撞击了赤道，引发大规模灭绝，原本吸引定居者来到这个世界的丛林与草原也因此消失. 彗星还引发了活跃的火山活动，并使稀土金属变得易于获取.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alta Vista was the site of a prominent engine trader in the Star League era but during the Second Succession war they became irrelevant, leaving a minor industrial and agricultural base behind.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Alta Vista在星际联盟时代曾是一家著名引擎交易商的所在地，但在第二次继承战争期间，它变得无足轻重，只留下了一个小型的工业与农业基地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled as a farming community, Altdorf no longer is suitable for this. Gamma rays destroyed the atmosphere a few hundred years after colonization. Instead the DC now uses this planet as a prison and work camp.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Altdorf最初作为农业社区被殖民定居，但如今已不再适合这一用途. 殖民数百年后，伽马射线摧毁了大气层. 取而代之的是，DC现在将该行星用作监狱和劳改营.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Currently locked in an extended ice age. Years of fighting has led the planetary government to join the Free Rasalhague Republic. It is now a buffer between the LC and DC and the citizens hope their backyard will no longer be a battlefield.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 目前仍深陷于漫长的冰河期. 多年的战斗促使行星政府加入了自由拉萨尔哈格共和国. 如今它成为LC与DC之间的缓冲区，市民们希望他们的后院不再成为战场.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Located close to the capital system of Atreus, Alterf has traditionally been used as a bread basket world. However its southern continent is reserved for military exercises by the Free Worlds League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Alterf位于Atreus首都星系附近，传统上一直作为粮仓世界使用. 不过，其南部大陆被自由世界联盟保留用于军事演习.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Located on the scenic edge of the inner sphere, Althastan is a thriving nudist colony. Settled after the star league era, colonists were quickly conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth and a no clothes law was established. A fun family vacation spot!
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Althastan位于内天体风景优美的边缘，是一个繁荣的裸体主义者殖民地. 殖民者在星际联盟时代之后定居于此，但很快被天琴共同体征服，并确立了一项禁止穿衣的法律. 一个有趣的家庭度假胜地！

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Althea's Choice was named after the leader of the colonists had to make a choice between systems to settle. Some say she got it wrong.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔西娅之选以殖民者领袖命名，她必须在几个星系之间做出定居的抉择。有人说她选错了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alto was settled during the Star League era, until the Third Succession War when it was finally abandoned. Little remains of the mining facilities.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Alto于星际联盟时代被殖民，一直延续至第三次继承战争时最终被废弃. 采矿设施几乎无存.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The DC uses Altona as a low G training world for its troops. Other then the industrial military complex present on Altona, not much else exists. Mechwarriors-in-training are taught how to survive on low G worlds and fight aerospace assets here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: DC将Altona用作其部队的低重力训练世界. 除了Altona上存在的军工工业综合体之外，那里几乎别无他物. 受训中的机甲战士在此学习如何在低重力世界生存，并与航空航天力量作战.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Altoona is a rare example of a system orbiting a red dwarf star. Even rarer that the planet itself is a moon of a gas giant. But what makes it exceptional is that there are 3 habitable moons orbiting the same gas giant although only one is inhabited.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Altoona是一个围绕红矮星运行的星系，这十分罕见. 更罕见的是，行星本身还是一颗气态巨行星的卫星. 但真正让它非同寻常的是，同一颗气态巨行星周围有 3 颗宜居卫星，尽管其中只有一颗有人居住.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Altoona was destroyed during the second succession war. A small mining colony, no one bothered to recolonize it because it was barely habitable to begin with. Most survivors were glad to be rid of the horrible place.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Altoona在第二次继承战争期间被摧毁. 那是一个小型采矿殖民地，由于这里本来就几乎不适合居住，没人费心去重新殖民它. 大多数幸存者都为摆脱这个可怕的地方而庆幸.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Altorra IV - more commonly known simply as Altorra - is a world with relatively low gravity and a single moon named Delilah.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Altorra IV——通常简称为Altorra——是一个重力相对较低的星球，拥有唯一一颗名为Delilah的卫星.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Traditionally a BattleMech producing center, Alula Australis no longer has the means to produce Mechs, they were all destroyed for a 4th and final time during the 3rd succession war and were moved off world. Now it is mined for its rare metals.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Alula Australis传统上是一个战斗机甲生产中心，如今已不再具备生产机甲的能力；在第三次继承战争期间，这些设施第四次也是最后一次被全部摧毁，生产也被迁离该星球. 现在，这里开采的是其稀有金属.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Colonized to take advantage of the rare earth elements readily available on the surface, Alula Borealis is a backwater mining colony with enough strategic value to have a garrison stationed on planet. Not much has changed since the Star League days.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为了利用地表易于获取的稀土元素，Alula Borealis被殖民；它是一个偏远落后的矿业殖民地，但其战略价值足以让星球上驻扎一支驻军. 自星际联盟时代以来，这里几乎没有什么变化.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alya and its moon are characterised by both the unusual elongated revolutionary cycle around the star and by Xanadu's unusual orbital path, both being the result of the gravitational influence of a huge gas giant in the outer reaches of the system.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿莉亚及其卫星的特点是绕恒星的公转周期异常绵长，而桑纳杜的轨道也与众不同，两者都是该星系外缘一颗巨大气态行星引力影响的结果。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Alyina system was colonized during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War. The first livestock on the world ate the local vegetation and began to hallucinate, sending them escaping across the vast plains.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Alyina星系在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民. 这个星球上的第一批牲畜吃了当地植被后开始产生幻觉，纷纷逃窜着穿过广袤的平原.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ambatomainty was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Ambatomainty在统一战争结束后的星盟时代某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Amber was settled during the Star League era, until the Third Succession War when it was finally abandoned.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Amber于星际联盟时代被殖民，直到第三次继承战争时最终被废弃.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ambergrist system was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War. Ambergrist was notable for producing a flavorful vermouth
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Ambergrist星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民. Ambergrist以出产一种风味浓郁的味美思而闻名.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Amber Grove, named after the amber like glow from the forests situated on mudflats, was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, and for much of its history was a part of the Taurian Concordat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Amber Grove，得名于位于泥滩上的森林所散发的琥珀般光辉，于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，在其历史的大部分时间里都是金牛协约国的一部分.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ambrose was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Ambrose于统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Amiga system was settled during the early twenty-fourth century at some point shortly after the formation of the Federated Suns as an expansive silicon mining colony to power the industrial might of House Davion.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Amiga星系在二十四世纪早期、恒星联邦成立后不久的某个时候被殖民，成为一个庞大的硅矿开采殖民地，为戴维恩家族的工业实力提供动力.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Amity is the second planet in the Amity system. Lacking any moons, Amity has been home to a number of industrial facilities belonging to various companies including Imstar Aerospace
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Amity是Amity星系中的第二颗行星. 由于没有卫星，Amity一直是包括Imstar Aerospace在内的多家公司旗下众多工业设施的所在地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Amminadav is a boring world - literally. It's thermal boreholes extend deep into the surface to provide access to a wealth of minerals.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿米纳达夫是一颗无聊的行星——字面意义上的。它的热钻孔深达地表之下，让人能获取丰富的矿物。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ammon was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Ammon是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of many worlds settled and then subsequently abandoned and forgotten about during the succession wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是众多在继承战争期间被开拓、随后又被废弃和遗忘的世界之一.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Exploratory boreholes were sunk through the glaciers of Amu Darya, and early samples showed promising mineral wealth, but the costs of the Succession Wars made exploiting that wealth too expensive for the Capellan leadership.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 勘探钻孔挖穿了阿姆达里亚的冰川，早期样本显示出了富有前景的矿产资源，但继承战争的代价使得开发那财富对卡佩拉领导人而言过于昂贵了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Amu Darya
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿姆达里亚

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Anaea was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Anaea是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Anaheim was settled at some point in the twenty-second century and was contested in the early parts of the Reunification War. Not much of its industrial base survived the Succession Wars, though Suwama Munitions maintains a mega factory here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Anaheim在二十二世纪的某个时候被殖民，并在统一战争初期成为争夺之地. 历经继承战争，其工业基础所剩无几，不过Suwama Munitions仍在此维持着一座巨型工厂.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Anatolia (Pillory 3130+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Anatolia（Pillory 3130+）在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ancha is best known for the fate of the first wave of colonists who all died to plague. The second wave, using the notes from the first wave, managed to synthesize a cure, meaning that their sacrifice was not in vain.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Ancha最为人所知的是第一批殖民者的命运，他们全都死于瘟疫. 第二批殖民者利用第一批留下的记录成功合成了解药，这意味着他们的牺牲没有白费.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: To expand the habitable area of the planet to exploit the native faunas health properties, the Star League built large solar mirrors in orbit to focus energy from the sun toward the planet, which created storms that wrack the planet centuries later.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为了扩大星球的宜居区域，以利用本土动物群的保健特性，星际联盟在轨道上建造了大型太阳反射镜，将太阳的能量聚焦向星球，由此产生的风暴在几个世纪后肆虐该星球.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Andarmax is not a single planet, but rather a gas giant with a large number of moons, in varying states of terraforming. The seat of government and the ComStar temple are located on Heinlein, the smallest of the moons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 安达马克斯不是一个单一的行星，而是一个拥有大量卫星的气态巨星，这些卫星都处于不同状态的地球化改造中. 政府所在地和通讯之星神殿位于最小的卫星海因莱因.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Andelys was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Andelys在统一战争结束后的某个时间点、星际联盟时代期间被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Apart from a few warm lakes and rivers, Andro is dry. Noxious gases erupt from deep fissures. Some local plants hover in mid-air, held aloft by gas bags.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 除了少数温暖的湖泊和河流外，Andro十分干旱. 有毒气体从深处裂隙中喷涌而出. 一些当地植物悬停在半空中，由气囊托浮着.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Andurien is the fifth planet in the Andurien system and has served as the capital world of both the Andurien Commonality and the Duchy of Andurien as well as being home to a number of defense industries such as Andurien AeroTech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Andurien是Andurien星系中的第五颗行星，曾作为Andurien共同体和Andurien公国的首都世界，同时也是Andurien AeroTech等众多国防工业的所在地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled during the First Exodus from Terra, Anegasaki is characterised by a rocky desert lit by a harsh red sun. Deep canyons cut into the planet's crust. The plants are shaped like brittle trumpets pointing up at the sky.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿内加萨基在第一次从地球出发的大逃亡期间被殖民，特征是岩石沙漠，被一颗刺眼的红色恒星照亮，深峡谷切入星球地壳。那里的植物形似脆弱的喇叭，朝天而立。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An unremarkable world scarce in everything, Anembo was still the site of a Castle Brian nicknamed Castle Kodiak during the Star League era as well as a large BattleMech garrison. Scavengers scour the surface constantly looking for LosTech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Anembo是一个平平无奇、什么都匮乏的世界，但在星盟时代，它仍是一座绰号为“科迪亚克城堡”的布莱恩城堡所在地，并驻扎着一支庞大的战斗机甲卫守部队. 拾荒者不断在星球表面搜寻失落科技.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled to access radium and cesium, Angell has a stark social structure. Water supplies are tainted with a chemical called citrium which is poisonous in large doses. As a result the population is reliant on technology and fresh water shipments.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 为了获取镭和色而在此定居，Angell的社会结构极为严酷. 供水被一种名为citrium的化学物质污染，大剂量摄入会中毒. 因此，民众依赖科技和淡水运输.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Angelsey was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Angelsey是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In common with the other worlds of the New Delphi Compact, ninety percent of the population of Anglia lived an agricultural lifestyle maintained by technology of an equivalent to that found on Terra in the late eighteenth or early nineteenth century
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 与新德尔斐盟约国的其他世界一样，Anglia百分之九十的人口过着农业生活方式，这种生活方式由相当于泰拉在十八世纪末或十九世纪初的技术维持.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: When Angol was discovered by humans it was already a frozen planet, locked in orbit around a small, dying red star. Settled by prisoners and other \"undesirables\" from nearby Tikonov, the society was modelled after Communism.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 当人类发现安戈尔时，它已经是一颗冰封行星，被锁在一颗微小垂死红星的轨道上。它由来自附近提科诺夫的囚犯与其他"不受欢迎者"定居，其社会以共产主义为蓝本。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Angra was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Angra是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The surface of Anguilla is tundra and a few frozen lakes. There are extensive fossilized forests with squat, knotted trunks with black spines. Large amounts of petroleum sit under the surface, the basis for the economy on this ruined world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Anguilla的表面是苔原和几片结冰的湖泊. 那里有大片化石森林，树干矮壮、多节，长着黑色尖刺. 地表下蕴藏着大量石油，是这个破败世界经济的根基.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Vast parts of the habitable continent are covered in shallow frozen lakes and swamps. The local plant life takes the shape of small orange bubbles, with hundreds of dark green animals hunting in well-coordinated packs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宜居大陆的大片区域被浅浅的冰封湖泊和沼泽覆盖. 当地植物呈小型橙色气泡状，还有数百只深绿色动物以配合默契的群体进行狩猎.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ankaa wasn't settled until four centuries after the first JumpShips left Terra. The hot world resembled the African and Middle East regions, but the middle latitudes and equator were far harsher and hotter than any Terran desert.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 安卡在首批跃迁舰离开地球之后四百年才被殖民。这颗炎热的行星类似非洲与中东地区，但中纬度与赤道比任何类地沙漠都更加严酷炽热。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Anklan system is located near the Elbing and Visby systems and trades rare materials from its cavernous mines with other worlds in the Hanseatic League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Anklan星系位于Elbing和Visby星系附近，并用其巨穴矿井中出产的稀有材料与汉萨同盟的其他世界进行贸易.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A sandy desert lit by a dim blue sun. Huge grey rocks litter the land. A thin dusting of brown lichen covers the land. Many dormant volcanos litter the land.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一片沙质沙漠，被一颗暗淡的蓝色太阳照耀. 巨大的灰色岩石遍布大地. 一层薄薄的棕色地衣覆盖着大地. 许多休眠火山遍布大地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Annapolis is a 'potential' garden world colonized during the First Exodus. Famine and disease have reduced Annapolis to 19th Century level technology. Most of the citizens survive by subsistence farming, and life for most is brutal and dirty.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 安纳波利斯是第一次大逃亡期间被殖民的“潜在”田园世界。饥荒与疾病把安纳波利斯的技术水平拉回到19世纪。大多数居民靠自给农作维生，多数人的生活残酷而肮脏。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: There are scattered forests of thick light green stems with massive flowers. Squat muscular bipeds move between the flowers. The lifeforms on this planet appear to be part of a kind of superorganism.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这里有零散分布的森林，由粗壮的浅绿色茎干组成，上面开着巨大的花朵. 矮壮而肌肉发达的双足生物在花朵之间穿行. 这颗行星上的生命体似乎是某种超个体的一部分.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Annwyn was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Annwyn在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Antallos III is an arid world with two moons. Following the collapse of the Star League, civilization on Antallos collapsed quickly, and by the thirty-first century the barren wastes (\"Free Zones\") are home to the worst of humanity.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 安塔洛斯III是一颗拥有两颗卫星的干旱世界。星盟崩溃之后，安塔洛斯的文明迅速瓦解，到三十一世纪，这些荒芜的废土（"自由区"）成了人类中最恶劣者的家园。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A desert world of jagged rocks, there are large plateaus with steep sides. Fauna takes the shape of green geodesic domes within which colonies of small many-colored creatures live. The air is filled with organic compounds that induce hallucinations.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个由嶙峋岩石构成的沙漠世界，分布着侧壁陡峭的大型高原. 动物群呈绿色测地线穹顶状，穹顶内栖息着色彩斑斓的小型生物群落. 空气中弥漫着可致幻的有机化合物.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The icy world of Antias was a battleground of the Second Succession War. To survive, the local government made the world a free haven for pirates and mercenaries. Currently, the government is controlled by pirate cartels.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 冰天雪地的安提亚斯星球是第二次继承战争的战场. 为了生存，当地政府把世界变成了海盗和佣兵的自由天堂. 目前，政府被海盗卡特尔所控制.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Antietam system was settled relatively early during human expansion across the Inner Sphere, possibly during the First Exodus from Terra, and is the home to numerous small aerovehicle exporters.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Antietam星系在人类向整个内天体扩张期间相对较早地就被定居，可能是在从地球出发的第一次大迁徙期间，并且是众多小型飞行器出口商的所在地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An Ting is a dry world where farmers eke out a living. Many agrimechs survived the Star League era, and there are often competitions with Cattlemaster agromechs such as Space Bull Rodeo.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: An Ting是一个干旱的世界，农民们在那里勉强度日. 许多农业机甲在星际联盟时代幸存下来，那里经常举办使用Cattlemaster农业机甲的竞赛，例如太空公牛竞技.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: There are scattered forests of orange fronds. A network of tunnels extends under much of the surface. The air is filled with dark orange fluttering creatures. Most of the local animals are different morphs of the same highly versatile species.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 零星分布着橙色叶状体组成的森林. 地表之下的大部分区域延伸着一片隧道网络. 空气中满是深橙色、振翅飞舞的生物. 当地大多数动物都是同一种高度多能物种的不同形态.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Antwerp is the fifth planet in the Antwerp system and is home to the major Bordello Military Goods, Inc. industrial plant - the only military manufacturing plant in the Hanseatic League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Antwerp是Antwerp星系中的第五颗行星，也是Bordello Military Goods，Inc. 主要工业工厂的所在地——汉萨同盟唯一的军事制造工厂.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once a site of a major Diplass BattleMechs site, the only remnant now is a Star League era continent spanning train service. A common phrase spoken here is to \"Take the midnight train going Anywhere\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这里曾是迪普拉斯战斗机甲的一处主要厂址，如今只剩下星盟时代横贯大陆的列车服务。这里常说的一句话是"搭上午夜列车，去往任何地方"

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Aodh was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Aodh在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The barren rock of Aomen was a viable source of germanium, a critical element for K-F Drives. With fewer drives in production, and more easily extracted sources of the rare mineral available, the League ultimately abandoned the mining facility.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 奥蒙光秃秃的岩石可以提供锗这种K-F驱动器的重要元素. 随着驱动器的产量日益减少，以及这种稀矿有了更多易于开采的来源，联盟最终放弃了这座矿业设施.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Aosia was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Aosia在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Apinzel was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Apinzel在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Place was devastated by famine after the first succession war. A small terrain world notable for political intrigue during the second succession war, not much happens other than farming here. It earns its name.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: A Place在第一次继承战争后因饥荒而遭受重创. 一个在第二次继承战争期间以政治阴谋闻名的小型地形世界，这里除了农耕之外没什么事情发生. 它名副其实.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Apolakkia has a planet-wide, deep ocean that is constantly steaming. Black winged creatures spend their lives in flight, not even landing to reproduce. Most of the local animals are different morphs of the same highly versatile species.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Apolakkia有一个覆盖全球的深海，海水不断冒着蒸汽. 黑翼生物终生都在飞行中度过，甚至连繁殖也不降落. 当地大多数动物都是同一适应力极强的物种的不同形态.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Apollo was for several centuries the capital world of the Rim Worlds Republic. Apollo is been home to a number of manufacturing facilities operated by companies such as United Mechanics, as well as massive fortresses modelling after Castle Brians.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Apollo在数个世纪里一直是边缘世界共和国的首都星球. Apollo曾是联合机械公司等企业运营的众多制造设施，以及仿照布莱恩城堡建造的巨型要塞的所在地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A planet-wide ocean mostly free of ice, except at the poles. Groups of striped creatures splash and frolic in the shallows. The adults hunt their own juveniles for food. Constant hurricanes ravage the surface.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 整个星球被海洋覆盖，除两极外大部分不结冰. 成群带条纹的生物在浅滩中溅水嬉戏. 成年个体会捕猎自己的幼体作为食物. 持续不断的飓风肆虐着地表.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Appian features a lush, fertile Terran world called Omen. Every attempt to colonize Omen has failed, and the world is littered with ruins. The inhabitants are researchers in a small station, trying to pierce Omen's secrets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿皮亚拥有一颗名为"预兆"的葱郁肥沃类地行星。对预兆的每一次殖民尝试都失败了，这颗行星遍布废墟。居民是一些小站点里的研究人员，试图揭开预兆的秘密。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Apriki system was colonized at some point prior to the end of the Reunification War and became a major industrial center for the Draconis Combine. Osaka Heavy Metrics produces many IndustrialMech designs here, such as the CattleMaster.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Apriki星系在统一战争结束前的某个时候被殖民，并成为天龙联合体的主要工业中心. Osaka Heavy Metrics在这里生产许多工业机甲设计，例如CattleMaster.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Apsalar was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Apsalar在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A former holding of the Free Worlds League, Aquagea lost much of its infrastructure to the League's reprisals during their independence movement. The current inhabitants are fiercely nationalistic and detest the League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为自由世界联盟的前属地，阿夸盖亚在其独立运动期间因联盟的报复行动而失去了大部分基础设施。现在的居民极为民族主义，痛恨联盟。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Aquavita was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Aquavita在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Aquileia was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Aquileia是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民的，但在继承战争的战乱中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Aragon was one of the systems that formed a part of the region in the Deep Periphery known as Nueva Castile.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Aragon是组成深空外围中被称为新卡斯蒂利亚的区域的一部分的星系之一.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Arboris is the fifth planet of seven in the Arboris system and is a temperate world with three moons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Arboris是Arboris星系中七颗行星里的第五颗行星，是一颗拥有三颗卫星的温带世界.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Arcadia is a temperate and somewhat habitable world that, in common with many other Clan worlds, has been held by - and contested by - several Clans at the same time for the majority of its history as a settled world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Arcadia是一个温带且勉强宜居的世界，与许多其他氏族世界一样，在其作为定居世界的绝大部分历史中，一直同时被数个氏族占据并争夺.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Arcadia (FS) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Arcadia (FS) 在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某一时刻被殖民，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Strong in agriculture and manufacturing, Arcadia is nevertheless an awkwardly situated world with heavy gravity and planetary wide storms.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 尽管在农业和制造业方面实力雄厚，Arcadia仍是一个位置尴尬的星球，拥有高重力和全球性风暴.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Arc-Royal system was originally a quiet, pastoral world; later the planet was a heavily-fortified world with a significant number of important industrial facilities.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Arc-Royal星系最初是一个宁静的田园世界；后来这颗行星成为一个戒备森严的世界，拥有大量重要的工业设施.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original Capital of the Lyran Commonwealth for centuries, the resulting population shift as inhabitants followed the capital to Tharkad has left a series of cities on the world that are vastly oversized for the current population.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为数百年来天琴共同体的原首都，居民随首都迁往Tharkad所导致的人口转移，使这个星球上留下了一系列对当前人口而言规模过大的城市.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ardoz system was settled during or soon after the First Exodus from Terra and by the end of the Age of War had been incorporated into the Draconis Combine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Ardoz星系在第一次从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间或之后不久被开拓，到战争时代结束时已被并入天龙联合体.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ares has been home to a number of various defense industries and is associated with the interstellar treaty called the Ares Convention.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Ares一直是众多不同国防工业的所在地，并与被称为《Ares公约》的星际条约有关.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Arganda system was settled soon after the First Exodus from Terra and by the early twenty-fourth century the system was a part of the Federation of Skye. When the Lyran Commonwealth formed in 2341 the Arganda system became a part of that nation
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Arganda星系在第一次泰拉大迁徙后不久便得到殖民，到二十四世纪初，该星系已成为斯凯联邦的一部分. 当天琴共同体于2341年成立时，Arganda星系成为了该国的一部分.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: SURVEY DATA INCOMPLETE
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 勘测数据不完整

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The savannahs and deserts of Argos are dominated by native fauna, but a small network of hardy, fiercely independent townships have carved out a distinct culture in the temperate zone.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔戈斯的稀树草原和沙漠被土著动物所控制，但是，一个由顽强，极端独立的小镇组成的小网络，在温带地区开拓出了一种独特的文化.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Argyle is located near New Avalon, but wasn't settled until that world became too crowded. It quickly became one of the Crucis March's breadbasket worlds and exports a great deal of food to neighboring worlds, along with other manufactured goods.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿盖尔位于新瓦隆附近，但直到那颗星球过度拥挤之后才被殖民。它很快成为克鲁西斯边区粮仓世界之一，向邻近星球出口大量粮食以及其他制成品。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Home to Toddlette Industries (now Earthwerks Incorporated), this high tech industrialised world is known for the production of the smallest BattleMech, the Flea.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这里是Toddlette Industries（现为Earthwerks Incorporated）的所在地，这个高科技工业化世界以生产最小的战斗机甲——Flea而闻名.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Aristotle is notable for the large anarchist commune in residence on the planet, and the Commonwealth was more than happy to point to the technological backsliding of Aristotle as example to illustrate how useful central government was by comparison.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Aristotle以其星球上居住着的大型无政府主义公社而闻名，而共同体则非常乐意拿Aristotle的技术倒退作为例子，来说明相比之下中央政府有多么有用.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Arkab system was settled at some point prior to the end of the Reunification War by a large muslim population. The vast deserts of Arkab are mineral rich, and the planet is home to Cairo Enterprises, the manufacturer of the Sand Devil hovertank.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Arkab星系在统一战争结束前的某个时候由大批穆斯林人口定居. Arkab的广袤沙漠矿产丰富，该行星也是沙魔悬浮坦克制造商开罗企业的所在地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Arlanda was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Arlanda于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Arlington system was colonized during the First Exodus from Terra, and was home to an SLDF garrison in the final years of the Star League. A ruined but intact Castle Brian still stands firm amidst the undergrowth.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Arlington星系在第一次泰拉大迁徙期间被殖民，并在星际联盟的最后几年里曾驻有星际联盟防卫军的一支驻军. 一座残破但结构完整的布莱恩城堡依然矗立在灌木丛中.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Arluna is a temperate world with vast jungles and an abundance of native life. Once the site of ancient battles, nature has reclaimed the old fortifications and cities.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Arluna是一颗温带星球，拥有广袤的丛林和丰富的本土生命. 这里曾是古代战役的所在地，如今自然已经重新占据了古老的防御工事与城市.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Armaxa system was colonized during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War, and in 3029 became part of the newly formed St. Ives Compact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Armaxa星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，并于3029年成为新成立的圣艾夫斯协约国的一部分.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Armington system was settled at some point during or prior to the Age of War and was part of the growing Taurian Concordat at the time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Armington星系在战争时代期间或之前的某个时候被殖民，当时是不断扩张的金牛协约国的一部分.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Armstrong was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Armstrong是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Arn (Jia Tian 3130+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Arn（Jia Tian 3130+）在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Arnaudville system was colonized during the Star League era and has been one of the great exporters of pasturised milk to the milk drinkers in the Federated Suns for centuries. Milk barons rule here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Arnaudville星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，几个世纪以来一直是向恒星联邦的饮奶者出口巴氏杀菌牛奶的主要出口地之一. 牛奶大享统治着这里.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Arromanches was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Arromanches是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Artru is a barren, icy rock with almost nothing of value; a token staff keeps the massive industrial mining equipment running. It's a major travel link to Hellespont, however, and Hellespont is the headquarters of the rimward branch of the ComStar Explorer Corps.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔特鲁是一块贫瘠冰冷的岩石，几乎没有任何价值；仅有一支象征性的工作人员维持着庞大的工业采矿设备运转。不过它是通往赫勒斯滂的重要交通节点，而赫勒斯滂正是通讯之星探险者军团外围分支的总部所在地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Artru is a barren, icy rock with almost nothing of value; a token staff keeps the massive industrial mining equipment running. It's a major travel link to Hellespont, however, and Hellespont is the headquarters of the rimward branch of the ComStar Explorer Corps.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔特鲁是一块贫瘠冰冷的岩石，几乎没有任何价值；仅有一支象征性的工作人员维持着庞大的工业采矿设备运转。不过它是通往赫勒斯滂的重要交通节点，而赫勒斯滂正是通讯之星探险者军团外围分支的总部所在地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Artru is a barren, icy rock with almost nothing of value; a token staff keeps the massive industrial mining equipment running. It's a major travel link to Hellespont, however, and Hellespont is the headquarters of the rimward branch of the ComStar Explorer Corps.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿尔特鲁是一块贫瘠冰冷的岩石，几乎没有任何价值；仅有一支象征性的工作人员维持着庞大的工业采矿设备运转。不过它是通往赫勒斯滂的重要交通节点，而赫勒斯滂正是通讯之星探险者军团外围分支的总部所在地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Arundel was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Arundel在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ascella is a young, warm planet with no moons. Home to a small industry that produces fusion and electrical plants for civilian and light military vehicles, it also exported large amounts of radioactive materials and heavy metals.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Ascella是一颗年轻、温暖的行星，没有卫星. 这里有一个小型工业，为民用和轻型军用车辆生产聚变与电力装置，同时还出口大量放射性材料和重金属.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Known as the north Donkey of the Cancer constellation in Old Terran, the Asellus Australis system was settled during the First Exodus from Terra.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Asellus Australis星系在古泰拉语中被称为巨蟹座的北驴，是在第一次离开泰拉的大迁徙期间被定居的.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Known as the south Donkey of the Cancer constellation in Old Terran, the Asellus Borealis system was settled during the First Exodus from Terra.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在旧泰拉语中被称为巨蟹座的南驴，Asellus Borealis星系是在第一次从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间被殖民的.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Asgard was one of the first planets colonised, and was part of the original Terran Alliance.  The population have always been reluctant members of the Combine, in spite of generations of brainwashing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Asgard是最早被殖民的行星之一，并且是原始泰拉联盟的一部分. 尽管历经数代洗脑，其民众始终是天龙联合体中不情愿的成员.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ashburton is a minor planet in the FWL, known for its somewhat excentric orbit which produces seasonal extremes and wild weather.  It also houses Ashburton Prison, one of the largest prisons in the FWL.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Ashburton是FWL中的一颗次要行星，以其略显偏心的轨道而闻名，这造成了季节性的极端变化和狂野天气. 它还设有Ashburton监狱，这是FWL中最大的监狱之一.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ashio has a native species which resembles an elephant-sized cow and which is farmed for meat that is almost indistinguishable from Terran beef, making it one of the Inner Sphere's primary beef exporters. The drug Brace is rumoured to be made here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿希奥有一种原生生物，形似大象大小的牛，被饲养取肉，其肉几乎与类地牛肉无法区分，使该行星成为内天体主要的牛肉出口地之一。据传毒品"支撑"也在这里制造。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ashkum is a minor planet on the Fed/Capellan border.  Recently conquered by the Feds, it remains a typical \"border world\" - underdeveloped and over garrisoned.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿什库姆是联邦与卡佩兰边界上的一颗小行星，最近被联邦征服，如今仍是一个典型的“边界世界”——欠发达而驻军过剩。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ashley is an unremarkable self-sufficient planet, notable only because Prince David Varney was killed in a riot here during the Davion Civil Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Ashley是一颗并不起眼、自给自足的行星，唯一值得注意的是，戴维恩内战期间，大卫·瓦尼亲王在这里的一场暴乱中丧生.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A former colony of the  Magistracy of Canopus, this planet was taken over by SLDF forces in 2580 and annexed to the FWL.  The planet itself has significant petrochemical reserves being tapped by several operations.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为船底自治区的前殖民地，这颗行星于2580年被SLDF部队占领，并被并入FWL. 该行星本身拥有大量石化储量，目前正由多个开采项目进行开发.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As Samik was one of the three worlds settled at the same time that formed the nucleus of what become the 17-world United Hindu Collective, which existed for centuries before being absorbed by the Federated Suns.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由于Samik是同时建立殖民地的三颗星球之一，它们构成了后来拥有17个世界的联合印度教集体的核心；该集体在被恒星联邦吞并之前已经存在了数个世纪.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Recently taken from the Combine, Asta is a world that refuses to die, in spite of being ravaged by WMD in the days of the Amaris Empire, and being a battleground recently.  It is a highly agrarian \"breadbasket\" planet.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿斯塔最近刚从联合体手中夺取，是一颗拒绝死去的星球——尽管在阿马里斯帝国时期被大规模杀伤性武器摧残，最近又成为战场。它是一颗高度农业化的“粮仓”星球。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Astrokaszy is hot, dry and windswept despite having a large amount of water. Treasure hunters are still drawn to the planet by rumors of a Star League Defense Force cache of precious metals, hidden during the Reunification War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 尽管拥有大量水资源，Astrokaszy依然炎热、干燥且多风. 有关星际联盟防卫军在统一战争期间藏匿的贵金属秘藏的传闻，仍吸引着寻宝者前往这颗行星.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Asturias is the fifth planet in the Asturias system and for centuries served as the capital of the Castilian Principalities. Asturias was home to one of the few defense industries to be found within Nueva Castile, namely Sanctuary Station.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Asturias是Asturias星系中的第五颗行星，数个世纪以来一直作为卡斯蒂利亚诸公国的首都. Asturias是新卡斯蒂利亚境内为数不多的国防工业所在地之一，即圣所站.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Asuncion is a mineral rich world that is home to Asuncion Industries, a manufacturer that produces small spacecraft and personal vacuum environment survival equipment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Asuncion是一个矿产资源丰富的星球，也是Asuncion Industries的所在地，这家制造商生产小型航天器和个人真空环境生存装备.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Athenry is notable for the fact that almost every plant on this predominantly water planet has a medicinal value, and for the ruins of an earlier civilisation found near the capital.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Athenry的著名之处在于，这颗以水域为主的星球上几乎每种植物都具有药用价值，并且在首府附近发现了早期文明的遗迹.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Athna of the low albedo was established as a graphite mine before being all but abandoned by the Liao after a rebellion. But some of the old domes remain unshattered and scavengers of all sorts can be found within.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 低反射率的阿斯纳是作为石墨矿建立起来的，直到一场叛乱之后被廖氏家族废弃. 但一些老旧的穹顶建筑仍然完好无损，各色拾荒者混迹其中.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Atlas is a marginal system, remarkable only for the ruins of a primitive pre-space civilisation dotted around the planet, and for Atlas Prison, one of the larger facilities in Commonwealth space.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Atlas是一个边缘星系，唯一值得注意的只有散布在行星各处的原始前太空文明遗迹，以及Atlas监狱——共同体境内规模较大的设施之一.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Atocongo is an unimportant little world on the edge of Lyran space.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Atocongo是天琴星域边缘一个无足轻重的小世界.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Atreus is a clan homeworld.  Yes, that's right, you shouldn't be here, and will probably die.  This has been a community service announcement.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿特柔斯是一个氏族母星。是的，没错，你不该在这里，而且很可能会死。这是一条社区服务公告。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Atreus for centuries served as the capital of the Free Worlds League. Atreus is home to a number of important defense industry facilities and is notable for being the location of the headquarters of SAFE, the League intelligence agency.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 数个世纪以来，Atreus一直是自由世界联盟的首都. Atreus拥有众多重要的国防工业设施，并且以作为联盟情报机构SAFE的总部所在地而闻名.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A pleasant world in the heart of the Concordat, Atreus Prime was scarred by an ancient battle between the SLDF and Taurian rebels, well before the Amaris Civil War. A swath of the planet is a barren radioactive wasteland, littered with the shells of dead 'Mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为协约腹地一颗宜人的星球，阿特柔斯主星在阿马里斯内战之前很久，就被SLDF与金牛座叛军之间的一场古老战斗所创伤。该星球的一片区域是荒芜的放射性废土，散落着死寂机甲的残壳。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Atreus Prime
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 阿特柔斯主星

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Now a tropical water world with little to recommend it, Atria was first occupied during the Terran Exodus.  Limited resources, and only survives because of tourism.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如今是一个乏善可陈的热带水世界，Atria在地球大迁徙期间首次有人定居. 资源有限，仅靠旅游业才得以维持.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Atsugi is a self-sufficient but otherwise unremarkable world colonised by the FWL early in the 26th Century.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Atsugi是一个自给自足但除此之外平平无奇的世界，于26世纪初被自由世界联盟（FWL）殖民.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: %%SURVEY INFORMATION CORRUPT%%
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: %%勘测信息损坏%%

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Atzenbrugg is a minimally habitable world with an atmosphere that is breathable with no more than a basic pollen filter, it is regarded as tainted due to the fact that almost all the native life contains varying degrees of hallucinogens.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Atzenbrugg是一个勉强宜居的世界，其大气只需基本的花粉过滤器即可呼吸；由于几乎所有本土生命都含有不同程度的致幻剂，它被视为受污染.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Aubisson, due to being a moderately important agricultural and manufacturing world on the Combine/Commonwealth border, has changed hands numerous times through its history.  Recently \"reclaimed\" from the Commonwealth, for now...
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 奥比松由于地处联合体/联邦边界、是一颗中等重要的农业与制造业世界，在历史上曾多次易手。最近才从联邦手中"收复"，暂时如此……

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An unremarkable, self-sufficient planet only notable because the Capellan's seem to have an interest in it.  Aucara seems to have an unusual amount of \"alleged\" Maskirovka agents captured on it - which the Capellans deny.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一颗平平无奇、自给自足的行星，唯一值得注意之处是卡佩兰人似乎对它有兴趣。奥卡拉上似乎异常多地"抓获"了"据称"的伪装局特工——而卡佩兰人对此予以否认。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: August was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: August是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Augusta itself is a modest planet with no real benefits apart from a breathable atmosphere, however the other 7 planets in the system house a wealth of minerals which support a thriving manufacuring base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Augusta本身是一颗不起眼的行星，除了拥有可供呼吸的大气外并无真正优势，但该星系中的其他7颗行星蕴藏着丰富的矿产，支撑起繁荣的制造业基地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally settled by Jesuits, during the Succession Wars most of the population was killed or driven offworld. A warm, pleasant world, it has seen much of the population loss reversed in the thirty-first century as new immigrants arrived.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初由耶苏会士定居，在继承战争期间，大部分人口被杀或被迫离开星球. 作为一个温暖宜人的世界，随着新移民到来，它在31世纪扭转了大部分人口损失.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A hot and humid world famed for its many rivers and swamps, as well as its dark damp forests. Auldhouse is home to a vast quantity of unique native fauna which Kodiak Pharmaceuticals often tries to exploit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个炎热潮湿的世界，以众多河流、沼泽以及幽暗潮湿的森林而闻名. Auldhouse是大量独特本土动物的家园，科迪亚克制药公司经常试图对其加以利用.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A large temperate world with large amounts of mineral riches, Aur is a gem of the Commonwealth. Home to Edasich Motors, a major manufacturer of Fusion Engines, as well as Interstellar Expeditions.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Aur是一个广袤的温带世界，拥有大量丰富的矿产资源，是共同体的一颗瑰宝. 这里是聚变引擎的主要制造商Edasich Motors以及Interstellar Expeditions的所在地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: SURVEY DATA INCOMPLETE
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 勘测数据不完整
