Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Austerlitz (Scauld 3130+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Austerlitz（Scauld 3130+）在星际联盟时代、再统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Australia is vitally important to the Lyran state despite its unimportant location and relative lack of resources. It is the home of one of the Commonwealth's Mint and Reserve Banks, making it a vital financial center.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 澳大利亚对莱兰国家极为重要，尽管其位置不重要、资源也相对匮乏。它是联邦造币与储备银行之一的所在地，使之成为重要的金融中心。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A warm garden planet that caters to vacationers, Autumn Wind is a popular spot for the richer citizens in the Free Worlds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Autumn Wind是一颗温暖的田园行星，专为度假者服务，是自由世界中较富裕公民的热门去处.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Avawatz is a planet-wide ocean. Gigantic scintillating creatures live in the ocean, moving slowly by using their siphons. Day and night rapidly follow on from each other.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Avawatz是一片覆盖整颗行星的海洋. 巨大的闪烁生物生活在海洋中，利用它们的虹吸管缓慢移动. 白昼与黑夜迅速交替.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Avellaneda was first colonised by a mostly Argentinian population during the First Exodus from Terra.  This warm, mountainous planet is noted in that it contains ruins of a previous pre-spaceflight civilisation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Avellaneda最初是在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间由以阿根廷人为主的人口殖民的. 这颗温暖多山的行星以拥有一个更早的前太空飞行文明的遗迹而闻名.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Avigait is notable in that its dominant fungal lifeform seems to have developed a rudimentary intelligence.  For no explicable reason, the fungus seems to avoid growing near Human habitations.  Currently being studied.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Avigait的显著之处在于，其占主导地位的真菌生命形式似乎已发展出初步智能. 无法解释的是，这种真菌似乎会避免在人类居住地附近生长. 目前正在研究中.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Avior system was colonized during the First Exodus from Terra and was incorporated into the Principality of Regulus prior to the formation of the Free Worlds League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Avior星系在第一次从泰拉向外大迁徙期间被殖民，并在自由世界联盟成立之前被并入Regulus公国.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Avon is the fifth planet in the Avon system. The surface of Avon is host to at least two significant defense manufacturers, with Matabushi Incorporation producing DropShip parts for the Combine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Avon是Avon星系中的第五颗行星. Avon表面至少有两家重要的国防制造商，其中Matabushi Incorporation为天龙联合生产空投船部件.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Avranches system was colonized by the Draconis Combine at some point in the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War but was destroyed in the First Succession War. A recent colonisation effort failed due to the Third Succession War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Avranches星系在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被天龙联合体殖民，但在第一次继承战争中遭到毁灭. 最近的一次殖民努力因第三次继承战争而失败.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Awano was the headquarters of the XIV Corps (Star League) of the Star League Defense Force centuries ago, and caches are found regularly on the world in less habitable areas.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Awano数百年前曾是星际联盟防卫军第十四军的总部，且在该星球较不适宜居住的区域经常能发现物资储藏点.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Awyron was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Awyron于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Axton is the third planet in the Axton system and has been host to both an industrial facility belonging to Wangker Aerospace and a training facility operated by the New Avalon Institute of Science. Axton has two moons named Greenbacck and Jeremiah.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Axton是Axton星系中的第三颗行星，曾同时拥有Wangker Aerospace的一座工业设施以及New Avalon Institute of Science运营的一处训练设施. Axton有两颗卫星，分别名为Greenbacck和Jeremiah.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This system is home to a mineral rich but cold arctic world named Ayacucho.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这个星系中有一个矿产资源丰富但寒冷的极地世界，名为Ayacucho.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Aylmer was colonized during the Star League era at some point after the Reunification War, its ammonia rich soils belie the otherwise barren grey and rocky nature of this world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Aylmer是在统一战争之后的某个时期、于星际联盟时代被殖民的；其富含氨的土壤掩盖了这颗星球在其他方面贫瘠、灰暗且多岩的本质.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ayn Tarma is often described in Colonist's Brochures as a \"lucrative mining world\" - without mentioning that it is vitally dependent on a lifeline of iceships supplied by Curtiss Hydrosystems - the cost of which is enormous.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在殖民者宣传册中，艾恩塔玛常被描述为“利润丰厚的采矿世界”——却只字不提它极其依赖由柯蒂斯水利系统公司供应的冰船生命线，而这条生命线的成本高得惊人。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Azha is important to the CCAF as it possesses an excellent strategic location. The near desert environment makes it difficult to farm, but the vast stores of minerals and metals beneath the surface have given birth to a thriving electronics industry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Azha对卡佩拉邦联武装力量至关重要，因为它拥有极佳的战略位置. 近乎沙漠的环境使农耕十分困难，但地表之下蕴藏的丰富矿物和金属储量催生了一个繁荣的电子产业.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Azur was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Azur在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While habitable and habitated, Babaeski's complete lack of anything remarkable has spared it from conflict, in spite of being a border world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 虽然宜居且有人居住，巴巴埃斯基完全没有任何值得注意之处，这使它虽为边界世界却免于冲突。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A barely inhabited water planet on the fringe of Combine space.  Population is limited to the few islands that rise above the ocean.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 联合体星域边缘一颗鲜有人烟的水世界. 人口仅限于少数高出海面的岛屿.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Somehow, you made it to the deep periphery, and into the heart of Clan territory.  Perhaps you should GTFO before they notice you?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 不知怎么的，你竟然抵达了深空外围，还深入到了氏族领地的核心. 也许你该在他们发现你之前赶紧滚蛋？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An insignificant ball of dirt at the edge of known space.  The only notable thing about this that the habitable zone where Baccalieu orbits is very close to the tiny main-sequence star of the system.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 已知空间边缘一颗无足轻重的泥球. 唯一值得注意的是，Baccalieu在其中运行的宜居带非常靠近该星系那颗微小的主序星.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally a Capellan world, Bacum has been under Federated control for the last 200 years. This isn't likely to change, as there is little to make Bacum significant save its limited production of a particularly fine wine from native berries.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 巴库姆原本是卡佩兰的世界，过去200年一直在联邦控制之下。这大概不会改变，因为巴库姆除了用本地浆果少量生产一种特别优质的葡萄酒之外，几乎没有什么值得一提之处。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A small marginal Martian like planet with negligible resources, formerly claimed by the Taurian Concordant, but most recently little more than a pirate enclave.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一颗小型边缘类火星行星，资源微不足道，曾由Taurian Concordant宣称主权，但最近不过是一个海盗飞地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A dense cluster of stars, within which are located some fifty assorted planets, which has been home to outlaws for centuries. A single planet within the cluster, Badlands, had been colonized by the Taurian Concordat prior to the Reunification War. The Concordat ceded control over the Badlands Cluster during the Third Succession War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个密集的星团，其中分布着大约五十颗各类行星，数个世纪以来一直是亡命之徒的藏身之所. 星团中的一颗行星，Badlands，在统一战争之前已被金牛协约国殖民. 该协约国在第三次继承战争期间放弃了对Badlands Cluster的控制权.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A moderately populated manufacturing and mining world, Bad News has been under Kurita Control for almost 500 years. Currently home to the Nineteenth Galedon Regulars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bad News是一个人口中等的制造业与采矿业世界，近500年来一直处于栗田家族的控制之下. 目前是第十九加勒顿正规军的驻地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Briefly colonised and claimed by both the Rim Worlds Republic and the Lyrans, Baggville now lies abandoned due to limited resources
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Baggville曾被边缘世界共和国和天琴人短暂殖民并宣示主权，如今因资源有限而被废弃.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Colonised by the Feds around 2750, Bahl's Retreat was abandoned some 100 years later.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由联邦约在2750年殖民，巴尔的退隐在约100年后被废弃。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A moderately industrialized agricultural planet, originally colonised during the First Exodus from Terra.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一颗工业化程度中等的农业行星，最初是在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间被殖民的.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This agricultural world is otherwise unremarkable apart from being the former headquarters of Baker Phamacuticals prior to its recent acquisition by Nashan Pharmaceuticals.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这个农业星球除此之外平平无奇，只是在最近被纳尚制药公司收购之前，它曾是贝克制药公司的总部所在地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Long ago, frozen Balawat was struck by a meteor that dug a hole deep in the planet's crust, letting shine its inner light. Now, only in this giant crater, life thrives, including a single large Magistracy port initially established as an art colony and since maintained by the mining industry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 很久以前，冰封的巴拉瓦特被一颗流星击中，在行星地壳上砸出一个深洞，让它内部的辉光透了出来。如今只有在这座巨型火山口里生命才繁盛，其中包括一座大型的卡诺帕辖区港口——最初作为艺术殖民地建立，此后由采矿业维持。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A typical self sufficient world, only noteworthy because it is the home of the Combine's Second Sword of Light, one of the most prestigious units in the DCMS.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一颗典型的自给自足行星，唯一值得注意之处是它是联合体第二光之剑的驻地——那是DCMS中最负盛名的部队之一。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Baliggora is the regional capital of the Baliggora Outworld Province, and apart from the presence of a minor ComStar base, is a typical Rimward world.  Most of the population is concentrated around the slightly warmer equatorial band.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Baliggora是Baliggora外世界省的地区首府，除了驻扎着一个小型ComStar基地外，它是一个典型的边缘向世界. 大部分人口集中在略温暖的赤道带附近.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Balkan was always listed in early Lyran charts as \"Marginally Habitable\".  When the Combine captured it during the 3rd succession war, they soon discovered what a drain on resources it was, and abandoned it shortly thereafter.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在早期莱兰海图中，巴尔干一直被列为“勉强宜居”。当联合体在第三次继承战争中夺取它时，很快发现它是个资源无底洞，随后不久便放弃了它。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ballad system is an anomaly. Right on the very edge of known space, is a reasonably habitable system - but populations placed here inexplicably fail to thrive. The Canopians are currently funding research into this.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: The Ballad system是一个异常. 它恰好位于已知空间的极边缘，是一个相当宜居的星系——但被安置在这里的人口却莫名其妙地无法繁荣. 卡诺皮安人目前正在资助对此的研究.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the more important Hegemony planets, Ballalaba's high concentration of heavy metal deposits have given rise to an extensive mining industry, in spite of its extensive vulcanism.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为霸权较重要的行星之一，巴拉拉巴的重金属矿床浓度极高，催生了庞大的采矿业，尽管那里火山活动频繁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A former Federated Suns world that suffered extensive infrastructure damage during the First Succession War, it now lays abandoned save for the occasional independent mining operation, and pirates of course.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个曾属于恒星联邦的世界，在第一次继承战争中遭受了大规模基础设施破坏，如今已被废弃，只有偶尔的独立采矿作业，当然还有海盗.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another \"quiet and unremarkable\" Lyran world, known for its large areas of strong but slow growing native trees, the production of a particularly smooth single malt whisky, and a native fish similar to the sardine that grows to weigh 600lb.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 又一个"安静而不起眼"的莱兰世界，以其大片生长缓慢却坚固的原生林木、一种格外顺滑的单一麦芽威士忌，以及一种长得像沙丁鱼、却能长到600磅重的原生鱼闻名。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The primarily Scandinavian population of this system have recently become part of the Rassalhague Republic, and have already geared up production of moderately priced flat-packed furniture and mech parts.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该星系以斯堪的纳维亚人为主的居民最近成为了Rassalhague共和国的一部分，并且已经加紧生产价格适中的平板包装家具和机甲部件.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This former Taurean system has long been abandoned due to limited resources and an almost non-existent atmosphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这个昔日的Taurean星系因资源有限且大气几乎不存在而早已被废弃.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Briefly colonised by the Federated Suns after the Reunification War, Banberg was quickly abandoned and now serves as little more than a hole-in-the-wall for pirates escaping local authorities.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 统一战争后，恒星联邦曾短暂殖民Banberg，但很快便将其废弃；如今，这里不过是躲避地方当局的海盗们的一个简陋藏身之处.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the founding systems of the Capellan Co-Prosperity Sphere, Bandora has remained in Capellan hands for its entire history.  Bandora has a little of everything, and remains an important part of the Confederation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为卡佩拉共荣圈的创始星系之一，Bandora在其整个历史中一直掌握在卡佩拉人手中. Bandora包罗万象，并且仍是邦联的重要组成部分.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Banfora system was colonised at some point after the end of the Reunification War. Shortly after it was captured by the FWL from the Capellans during the Succession Wars, Banfora was abandoned.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Banfora星系在统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民. 在继承战争期间被自由世界联盟从卡佩拉人手中夺取后不久，Banfora便被废弃了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Deep in Combine space, Bangor has remained an important mining and manufacturing planet since Star League times. Rumors still claim there is an untouched SLDF cache somewhere on the planet, although officially none has never been found.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在天龙联合体领空深处，自星际联盟时代以来，Bangor一直是重要的采矿与制造行星. 谣言仍声称该星球某处存在一个未被动过的SLDF藏匿点，尽管官方从未发现过任何此类藏匿点.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A Garden Planet deep in Combine space, known for its wide variety of Terran and non-Terran produce.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一颗位于联合体星域深处的花园行星，以种类繁多的地球与非地球农产品而闻名.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Colonised during the Star League Era, Bannerhoft was once a major population centre.  However, the collapse of the Star League lead to extensive pirate and slaver raids, and by the end of the First Succession War it was abandoned.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bannerhoft曾在星际联盟时代被殖民，曾是一个主要人口中心. 然而，星际联盟的崩溃导致了大规模的海盗和奴隶贩子袭击，到第一次继承战争结束时，它已被废弃.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Banori system is home to a centuries old Outworlds Alliance colony. Once invaded by the SLDF, they managed to stave off numerous assaults to retain their independence.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Banori星系是外域联盟一个已有数百年历史的殖民地的所在地. 该殖民地曾遭星际联盟防卫军入侵，却成功抵御了多次进攻，保住了独立.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Barahona was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Barahona在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Baranda system is located in the June Operational Area of the Periphery March of the Federated Suns. The Baranda system was colonized during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Baranda星系位于恒星联邦外缘边区的六月作战区. Baranda星系在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时间点被殖民.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Barcella is an early Kerensky Cluster colony world. The planet became the capital of Clan Nova Cat. It was later colonized by other Clans in the following years, however the Nova Cats hold a large percentage of this world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Barcella是克伦斯基星团中的一个早期殖民地世界. 该行星成为新星猫氏族的首府. 后来在接下来的几年里，其他氏族也殖民了这里，但新星猫氏族拥有这个世界的很大一部分.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally intended by the Rim Worlds Republic to be a \"hedgehog\", a giant fortified firebase that Republican forces could use to slow the advance of any invading force, most fortifications were decimated during the Reunification War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它最初被边缘世界共和国设计为一只"刺猬"——一座巨大的筑垒火力基地，供共和国部队用来迟滞任何入侵部队的推进，大部分工事在统一战争期间被摧毁。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Barlaston system was colonised during the First Exodus from Terra, and is named after the Barlaston family holdings, who own most of the utilities on the surface.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Barlaston星系是在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间殖民的，其名称源自Barlaston家族领地，该家族拥有地表上大部分公用设施.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once the planet's capital city was a sprawling network of tunnels and hab domes in a mega-city named Rough Patch. Only in the past century has terraforming progressed enough to allow colonists on the surface.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该行星的首府曾是一座名为"崎岖地"的超级城市中由隧道与居住穹顶组成的庞大蔓延网络。直到过去一个世纪，地球改造才进展到足以让殖民者住到地表。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: With a population of nearly 3.5 billion and a thriving trade economy, Barras is a critical link between the Capellans and the League. As a consequence, it is also a hotbed of intrigue and espionage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 巴拉斯拥有近35亿人口和蓬勃发展的贸易经济，是卡佩拉人与联盟之间的重要纽带. 因此，它也是阴谋和间谍活动的温床.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Barstow's population was almost wiped out entirely during the First Succession War in a combined Nuclear, Biological and Chemical weapons attack. The tainted atmosphere still persists to this day.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 巴斯特罗的人口在第一次继承战争期间几乎被一场核、生、化联合武器攻击彻底抹去。被污染的大气至今仍然存在。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bartrock was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bartrock在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Baruun Urt system was colonised during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War. It's vast steppes and high gravity breed strong large plains horses which are exported to farmlands across the sector.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 巴伦乌尔特星系在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民。它广袤的草原与高重力培育出强壮的大型平原马，出口到该星区各地的农牧区。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Baryshevo system was colonised during the Star League era at the end of the Reunification War. The Brunswick family has ruled this planet for many generations, serving the LCAF as a reinforced regiment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Baryshevo星系是在星际联盟时代、统一战争末期被殖民的. 布伦瑞克家族统治这颗行星已有许多代，并以一支加强团的编制为LCAF效力.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Basalt was one of the first worlds settled by explorers from the Terran Hegemony. Despite the high gravity, incredible air pressure, and wild weather, the world has long been a source of excellent raw materials.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Basalt是最早由泰拉霸权的探险者定居的星球之一. 尽管有着高重力、惊人的气压和狂暴的天气，这个世界长期以来一直是优质原材料的来源.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled during the first Terran Exodus alongside Panpour and As Samik, Basantapur became the capital of the Collective and gave its name to the treaty that saw the Collective incorporated as a semi-autonomous member of the Federated Suns in 2540.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Basantapur在第一次泰拉大迁徙期间与Panpour和As Samik一同被殖民，后来成为集合体的首都，并以其名字命名了使该集合体于2540年作为半自治成员并入恒星联邦的条约.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Basiliano's location on the border between the Draconis Combine and Lyran Commonwealth gives the small, water-poor world a far greater significance to the Draconis Combine than any inherent worth in the planet itself.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 巴西利亚诺位于龙尼斯联合体与莱兰联邦的边界上，这使这颗缺水的小行星对龙尼斯联合体而言，其意义远超行星本身固有的价值。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bass has an excentric orbit, which results in temps varying seasonally up to +/- 70° from a mean of just 5°C.  Most dwellings are in disused mining shafts, including the \"Dungeons\" - one of Bass's more popular tourist spots for BDSM practitioners.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 巴斯的轨道偏心，导致季节温差可偏离均值5°C达上下70度。大多数住所位于废弃的矿井中，其中包括"地牢"——巴斯最受BDSM爱好者欢迎的旅游点之一。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bassfield is predominately a water world, and boasts some of the most obscure species of fish in known space. It's widely scattered, populated island chains are separated by deep oceans.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 巴斯菲尔德主要是一颗水世界，拥有已知空间中最罕见的一些鱼类。它的岛链分布广泛而零散，彼此被深海分隔。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bastian system was located in the Chirikof Operational Area of the Crucis March within the Federated Suns, close to the Reisterstown and Steeles systems. The Bastian system was settled during the First Exodus from Terra.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bastian星系位于恒星联邦境内克鲁西斯边疆的奇里科夫作战区，靠近Reisterstown和Steeles星系. Bastian星系是在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间被定居的.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bastrop system was located in the Woodbine Operational Area of the Periphery March within the Federated Suns.  Originally part of the Outworlds Alliance, it was ceded to the Federated Suns during the early years of the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bastrop星系位于恒星联邦境内外域边境的伍德拜恩作战区域. 它最初是外围联盟的一部分，在继承战争的早期被割让给恒星联邦.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Batajnica system was the location of at least one habitable world in the Buena Province of the Lyran Commonwealth.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Batajnica星系是天琴共同体布埃纳省至少一颗宜居行星的所在地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Batavia system was the location of at least one habitable world and is located in the Markesan Operational Area of the Crucis March within the Federated Suns.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Batavia星系是至少一个宜居世界的所在地，并位于恒星联邦境内克鲁西斯边区的马凯桑作战区.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Battaraigi was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Battaraigi是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期建立的殖民地，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the poorest and most ignorant worlds in the Davion realm, Baxley contributes more recruits to ComStar than any other world in the Federated Suns, the impoverished and uneducated population seeing the Blessed Order's representives as near gods.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为达维昂领地中最贫穷、最闭塞的行星之一，巴克斯利向康星输送的新兵比联邦太阳任何其他行星都多——贫困而未受教育的民众把受福修会的代表们近乎视为神明。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Baxter is a world that experiences earthquakes and dust storms nearly every day. The resulting tidal stresses caused a great deal of upheaval in Baxter's ecosphere, with much of the land on the planet becoming desert by the thirty-first century.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 巴克斯特是一颗几乎每天都发生地震与沙暴的行星。由此产生的潮汐应力对巴克斯特的生态圈造成巨大动荡，到三十一世纪时该行星大部分陆地已化为沙漠。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bayeux was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bayeux在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In the final years of the Star League, Bayindir hosted a SLDF base, Fort Gates, where the 58th BattleMech Division operated. The unit was successful in defending the world from multiple pirate attacks. The ruins can still be seen to this day.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟的最后几年，Bayindir曾是SLDF基地盖茨要塞的所在地，第58战斗机甲师驻扎于此. 该部队成功抵御了多次海盗袭击，保卫了这颗星球. 其废墟至今仍可见到.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bayis was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bayis在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: SURVEY DATA INCOMPLETE
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 勘测数据不完整

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bearclaw II - more commonly known simply as Bearclaw has been held by - and contested by - several Clans at the same time for the majority of its history as a settled world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bearclaw II——更常被简称为Bearclaw——在其作为定居世界的大部分历史中，一直同时被数个氏族占有并争夺.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Beaumont system was colonized during the Star League era during the buildup to the Reunification War, and fortified rapidly with a Castle Brian, whose ruins now stand looking over Beauchamp City.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Beaumont星系在星际联盟时代、统一战争备战期间被殖民，并迅速以一座布莱恩城堡设防，其废墟如今俯瞰着博尚城.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Beauvais was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Beauvais是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Beckars was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Beckars是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被开拓定居的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of five worlds to be a part of the Stewart Confederation, Bedeque suffered immensely following the withdrawal of Terran authority in the 23rd Century. Statues to David Genovese, saviour of the planet, still stand today across the surface.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为斯图尔特邦联的五个世界之一，Bedeque在23世纪泰伦当局撤离后遭受了巨大苦难. 为纪念这颗行星的救世主大卫·杰诺维斯而立的雕像，至今仍矗立在地表各处.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A tropical world with numerous pharmaceutical industries, Beecher still has hidden ruins and depots dotting the surface from the First Succession War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Beecher是一个拥有众多制药产业的热带世界，其地表至今仍散布着第一次继承战争留下的隐蔽废墟和补给站.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Beehive Cluster is a stellar cluster containing hundreds of stars and is located a little over 800 light-years from Terra. The Beehive Cluster lies on the border of the huge Perseus-Cepherus Cloud Complex and is still largely unexplored.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: The Beehive Cluster是一个包含数百颗恒星的星团，位于距泰拉800多光年处. The Beehive Cluster位于巨大的英仙座-刻甫斯云复合体边缘，且在很大程度上仍未被探索.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Beenleigh system was colonised by the Federated Suns during the Star League era.  A quiet, peaceful little world in a galaxy full of strife.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Beenleigh星系在星际联盟时代被恒星联邦殖民. 一个在充满纷争的银河中安静、和平的小小世界.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another nondescript planet in a galaxy of more interesting planets, Beid is remarkable only by the size of the trees in its tropical forests.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在一个满是更有趣行星的星系中，Beid不过是又一颗不起眼的行星，唯一引人注目的是其热带森林中树木的巨大尺寸.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Beils was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Beils在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Belacruz was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Belacruz在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This Federation planet is known for its quirky designations for its planetary government.  The planetary leader is known as the \"Prince\", although the title is elected and has nothing to do with any royal lineage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这颗联邦行星以其对行星政府的古怪称呼而闻名。其行星领袖被称为"亲王"，尽管这一头衔是选举产生，与任何王室血统无关。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Belamor (Zanzor 2822+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Belamor (Zanzor 2822+) 在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the 12 habitable planets of the New Delphi Compact, Belgae is an agricultural planet with a low technological dependency, in accordance with the Omniss anti-tech philosophy of the region.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Belgae是新德尔斐盟约国的12颗宜居行星之一，是一颗农业行星，技术依赖度低，符合该地区Omniss的反科技哲学.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bell X - more commonly known simply as Bell. Bell has been contested repeatedly during its history as an inhabited world and has been home to significant defense manufacturing facilities. The population was wiped out in 2358 and has been rebuilt.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bell X——更常简称为Bell. 在其作为有人居住星球的历史中，Bell屡次成为争夺之地，并曾是重要国防制造设施的所在地. 其人口于 2358 年被消灭，之后得以重建.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bell (OA) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bell (OA) 是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A nondescript border world between the LC and the FWL, Bella has seen its share of battles over the centuries. Due to this, there is little manufacturing infrastructure on the world, in spite of reasonable mineral reserves.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为LC与FWL之间一个不起眼的边境世界，Bella数百年来也经历过不少战斗. 正因如此，尽管拥有相当可观的矿产储量，这个世界上的制造业基础设施却很少.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Belladonna system was colonized during the First Exodus from Terra or shortly after. It houses a major industrial facility for Cal-Boeing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Belladonna星系是在第一次从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民的. 这里设有Cal-Boeing的一座主要工业设施.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bellatrix has a long and proud history, having been settled in the First Exodus. The system was briefly captured by the Free Worlds League during the Star League era, but was retaken by mercenaries employed by the Capellan Confederation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 贝拉特里克斯拥有古老而光辉的历史，初次迁徙中人们在此定居. 在星际联盟时期，这个星系被自由世界联盟短暂地占领，但是被卡佩拉联邦雇佣的佣兵夺回了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Recently settled after the Fourth Succession War, Belle Isle is a small agricultural colony set up amongst a water world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 第四次继承战争结束后不久才有人定居，Belle Isle是一个建立在水世界中的小型农业殖民地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Recently liberated from mercenaries and religious fanatics, lightly-inhabited Bellerophon is arid and inhospitable, and conflicts over limited agricultural resources are common.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最近才从佣兵和极端宗教分子手里解放的，没多少人定居的柏勒洛丰是片干旱的不毛之地，经常发生争夺有限农业资源的冲突.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Recently liberated from mercenaries and religious fanatics, lightly-inhabited Bellerophon is arid and inhospitable, and conflicts over limited agricultural resources are common.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最近才从佣兵和极端宗教分子手里解放的，没多少人定居的柏勒洛丰是片干旱的不毛之地，经常发生争夺有限农业资源的冲突.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Archaeologists have determined that Bellevue was once a vibrant Terran-like planet with a pre-spaceflight indigenous population, but the ecosystem was destroyed by unknown means.  Many ruins dot the planet.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 考古学家已确定，Bellevue曾是一颗生机勃勃、类似地球的行星，拥有尚未进入太空时代的原住民，但其生态系统被未知手段摧毁. 行星上遍布着许多废墟.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Belluevue was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Belluevue在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Benedict is a fairly typical planet, notable only for a small cadre of religious fanatics who inhabit a large monastery on the northern continent, and for being a regional trade hub.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Benedict是一颗相当典型的行星，唯一引人注目的是北部大陆上一座大型修道院中居住着一小群宗教狂热分子，以及它作为区域贸易枢纽的地位.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Benet system was colonized at some point during or shortly before the Age of War. Benet III was settled in order to take advantage of the metals in the world's crust. These metals are largely platinum and related metals.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 贝内特星系在战火时代期间或稍早的某个时期被殖民。贝内特III的定居是为了开采该行星地壳中的金属。这些金属主要是铂及相关金属。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Notable for the Benfled Cadet Academy and a highly diverse ecosystem compatible with Human life, Benfled has long been a peaceful \"breadbasket\" planet of the Lyran Commonwealth.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 本弗莱德以本弗莱德士官学院和与人类生命相容的高度多样生态系统而闻名，长期以来一直是莱兰联邦和平的“粮仓”星球。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: First colonised during the Terran Exodus, Benjamin has long supported a strong petrochemical and manufacturing industry, and a self-sufficient agricultural base.  Poor environmental practices have lead to the atmosphere becoming tainted.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在泰拉大出走期间首次被殖民，Benjamin长期以来一直支撑着强大的石化和制造业，以及自给自足的农业基础. 糟糕的环保做法导致大气受到污染.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Although Bensinger has been part of the Commonwealth for nearly 300 years, the planet has always had the undertone of rebellion since the days of the Rimworld Republic.  Otherwise, it is a self-sufficient world with a moderate manufacturing base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 尽管Bensinger成为共同体的一部分已有近300年，但自边缘世界共和国时代起，这颗行星始终带着叛乱的暗流. 除此之外，它是一个自给自足的世界，拥有中等规模的制造业基础.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Officially listed as \"marginally habitable\", Bentley is an ice-bound world who's population centres cluster around a barely habitable equatorial band, an a few geothermal hotspots.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 官方列为"勉强可居"的宾利是一颗冰封行星，其人口中心聚集在一条勉强宜居的赤道带以及几处地热热点周围。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Beowulf was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Beowulf在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Benenson is a world with a turbulent past.  Up until some 200 years ago, the planet changed hands so frequently that even some historical documents can't agree on who held it at various times.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 贝嫩森是一颗有着动荡过往的行星。直到大约200年前，这颗行星易手之频繁，连某些历史文献都说不清各个时期究竟是谁占着它。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bergen is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League, exporting goods to other Hanseatic worlds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bergen是组成深空外围国家汉萨同盟的星球之一，向其他汉萨世界出口货物.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A fairly marginal border world, recently retaken from the Feds.  Bergman's only real claim to fame is its hostile environment and ecosystem, and the existence of a smallish prison for some of the Combine's political prisoners.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一颗相当边缘的边界世界，最近刚从联邦手中夺回。伯格曼唯一真正值得一提之处是它恶劣的环境与生态系统，以及一座关押联合体部分政治犯的小型监狱。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: On Bergtatt, a sand-sharp wind has cut mountains into howling arches and singing spires, and the endless noise makes long-term residence impossible. It also makes the planet difficult to scan, which mean it has a steady population of short-term residents on the run.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在博格塔特，一种剧烈的风沙将山脉切成咆哮拱门和鸣震尖塔，这无穷无尽的噪音使得长期定居变得不可能. 这也使得扫描行星变得困难，这意味着它的在逃短期居民人口较为稳定.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bernardo system was colonized during the First Exodus from Terra and was independent prior to joining the Capellan Confederation when the Confederation was founded. Bernardo is home to BattleMech factories for Earthwerks and Kallon Industries.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bernardo星系在第一次泰拉大迁徙期间被殖民，并在卡佩拉邦联成立时加入该邦联之前一直保持独立. Bernardo是Earthwerks和Kallon Industries的战斗机甲工厂所在地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: First colonised in the early 2700's, Bessarabia has been passed back and forth a few times between the Combine and the Commonwealth, before it was claimed by the newly formed FRR.  Notable for its high concentrations of heavy metals.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 比萨拉比亚在2700年代初首次被殖民，此后在联合体与联邦之间几度易手，最终被新成立的FRR占有。它以重金属浓度极高而著称。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The seventh planet of the Beta system is a heavily forested world, still containing the now decaying ruins of the defences originally set up by the Rim Worlds Republic prior to the Lyran Commonwealth taking control of the system in 2775.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Beta星系的第七颗行星是一个森林茂密的世界，仍存有最初由边缘世界共和国建立的防御工事如今已破败的遗迹，这些工事是在天琴共同体于2775年接管该星系之前设置的.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Beta Mensae V system is located close to the Altdorf and Kaznejoy systems. The Beta Mensae V system was colonized at some point prior to the Reunification War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Beta Mensae V星系位于Altdorf和Kaznejoy星系附近. Beta Mensae V星系在统一战争之前的某个时候被殖民.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Beta Regulus was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Beta Regulus在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Beta Salandor is located in the spinward region of the Deep Periphery, in a remote location anti-spinward of the Orion Rift and coreward of Lambda Orionis.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Beta Salandor位于深空外围的顺旋区域，地处Orion Rift的逆旋方向、Lambda Orionis的核心方向这一偏远位置.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Betelgeuse is an important Capellan factory world on the border with the Free Worlds League. Coveted by House Marik, it is often the target of raids. Betelgeuse is home to Warrior House Kamata who vigorously guard the factories on the planet.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Betelgeuse是卡佩拉位于与自由世界联盟边境上的重要工厂星球. 它被马里克斯家族觊觎，经常成为突袭目标. Betelgeuse是卡玛塔武士之家的所在地，他们全力守卫着这颗星球上的工厂.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Beten Kaitos system is located in the Kathil Operational Area of the Capellan March within the Federated Suns. Beten Kaitos is a harsh and marginally habitable world but rich in resources, first discovered by explorers from Muskegon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Beten Kaitos星系位于恒星联邦卡佩拉边疆区的Kathil作战区. Beten Kaitos是一颗环境严酷、仅勉强适宜居住但资源丰富的星球，最初由来自Muskegon的探险者发现.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bethel system is located close to the Andro and Knutdor systems. It held a secret research facility associated with the NAIS which was the target of a Capellan Confederation raid on 9 April 3029.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bethel星系靠近Andro星系和Knutdor星系. 它设有一个与NAIS有关的秘密研究设施，该设施于3029年4月9日成为卡佩拉邦联突袭的目标.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bethonolog system is located in the Magistracy of Canopus. The Bethonolog system is located close to the Obrenovac and Restitution systems. The Bethonolog system was colonised at some point prior to the end of the Age of War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bethonolog星系位于船底自治区. Bethonolog星系靠近Obrenovac和Restitution星系. Bethonolog星系在战争时代结束前的某个时候被殖民.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bettendorf system is located close to the Hoff and Sakhara V systems. Bettendorf was invaded during the first half of the major invasion into the Federated Suns launched by the Draconis Combine in May 2787.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bettendorf星系位于Hoff和Sakhara V星系附近. 在2787年5月天龙联合体对恒星联邦发动的大规模入侵的前半段，Bettendorf遭到入侵.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bex was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bex于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bhaktapur was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bhaktapur在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bharat was originally settled by colonists from Terra's Indian subcontinent. They brought with them many Terran tree species. The world's only military manufacturer is Killosh Industries, notable for producing the Magi tank.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 巴拉特最初由来自地球印度次大陆的殖民者定居。他们带来了许多类地树种。该世界唯一的军工制造商是基洛什工业，以生产法师坦克闻名。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bhykov was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bhykov在统一战争结束后的星盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bicester system is located in the Xinyang Prefecture of the Benjamin Military District within the Draconis March. The system is located close to the Omagh and Yumesta systems, and has terrain suitable for MechWarrior training.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bicester星系位于天龙边区内本杰明军区的新阳府. 该星系靠近Omagh和Yumesta星系，并拥有适合机甲战士训练的地形.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Biegga was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Biegga在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Prior to human habitation Biham had an extremely fragile ecosystem; this ecosystem was brutalised during the human occupation of the world. The corporate headquarters of Yoshimatsu Chemicals and a major plastics and polymers plant are located here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在人类定居之前，Biham拥有一个极其脆弱的生态系统；在这个世界被人类占据期间，这一生态系统遭到了严重破坏. 吉松化学公司的企业总部以及一座大型塑料与聚合物工厂就坐落于此.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bilma was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bilma在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Biloela system is located close to the Bobruisk and Maisons systems. The Biloela system was colonized at some point during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Biloela星系位于Bobruisk星系和Maisons星系附近. Biloela星系在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代期间的某个时候被殖民.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Binyang was one of a number of worlds conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth as part of a two-pronged invasion of the Free Worlds League that threatened to capture the important industrial world of Acrux.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Binyang是天琴共同体在双线入侵自由世界联盟期间征服的众多世界之一，那次入侵曾威胁要夺取重要的工业世界Acrux.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Biota system was located near the Cusset and Rastaban systems. Biota was settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Biota星系位于Cusset星系和Rastaban星系附近. Biota是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候由天琴共同体殖民的.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Birmensdorf system is home to at least one habitable world and is located in the June Operational Area of the Periphery March within the Federated Suns. Birmensdorf was settled during the Age of War by the United Hindu Collective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Birmensdorf星系至少拥有一颗宜居行星，位于恒星联邦内外围边区的六月作战区. Birmensdorf是在战争时代由联合印度教集体殖民建立的.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Birqash system is the location of at least one habitable world or construct and is located in the Sirdar Operational Area of the Capellan March within the Federated Suns. The Birqash system is located close to the El Kerak and Kiserian systems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Birqash星系至少拥有一个可居住世界或设施，位于恒星联邦内卡佩拉边疆区的Sirdar作战区域. Birqash星系靠近El Kerak和Kiserian星系.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bismarck system is home to a tropical world that is known for its lush forests and lumber exports. The Bismarck system was located near the Lengkong and Mankova systems. Bismarck was settled during or shortly before the Age of War
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bismarck星系有一个热带世界，以茂密的森林和木材出口而闻名. Bismarck星系位于Lengkong和Mankova星系附近. Bismarck在战争时代期间或稍早之前有人定居.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bithinia is best known for its tourist resorts which cater to the richest citizens of both the Capellan Confederation and foreigners. There is also significant iron mining on the planet, making Bithinia an important steel supplier.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bithinia最闻名的是其旅游度假胜地，这些度假胜地服务于卡佩拉邦联最富有的公民以及外国游客. 该星球上还有大量铁矿开采，使Bithinia成为重要的钢铁供应地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Biuque system is home to at least one habitable world and is located near the Krievci and Wrociaw systems. Biuque was settled during or shortly before the Age of War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Biuque星系至少拥有一颗宜居星球，位于Krievci星系和Wrociaw星系附近. Biuque是在战争时代期间或稍早之前被殖民的.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bjarred system was located near the New Sarum and Sawyer systems and consists of a class F4V primary orbited by at least five planets. A recharge station was in place at the nadir jump point during the thirty-first century.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bjarred星系位于New Sarum和Sawyer星系附近，由一个F4V型主星和至少五颗环绕它的行星组成. 在三十一世纪时，天底跃迁点处设有一座充电站.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Bjornlunda system is located in the Donegal Province of the Lyran Commonwealth. The Bjornlunda system was located near the Jaumegarde and Turinge systems. Bjornlunda was settled during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bjornlunda星系位于天琴共同体的多尼戈尔省. Bjornlunda星系位于Jaumegarde和Turinge星系附近. Bjornlunda是在第一次从泰拉向外大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民的.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Elysian worlds (Elissa, Mangringaine, and Nyserta) are temperate planets maintained in their pristine wilderness state. The people supported themselves mainly as hunters and gatherers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Elysian诸世界（Elissa、Mangringaine和Nyserta）是温带行星，保持着原始荒野状态. 当地居民主要以狩猎和采集为生.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Black Earth was intended to be a \"hedgehog\", a giant fortified firebase that the Rim Worlds Republic  forces could use to slow the advance of any invading force. Black Earth was conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth during Republic-Commonwealth War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黑土本意是要成为一只"刺猬"，一座巨大的筑垒火力基地，供边缘世界共和国的部队用来迟滞任何入侵部队的推进。黑土在共和国-联邦战争期间被莱兰联邦征服。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Blackjack system was located near the Goat Path and Hot Springs systems and consists of a class G3V primary orbited by at least three planets. Blackjack became infamously known to being the home of the Blackjack School of Conflict.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Blackjack星系位于Goat Path和Hot Springs星系附近，由一颗G3V型主星以及至少三颗环绕其运行的行星组成. Blackjack因作为Blackjack冲突学校的所在地而臭名昭著.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sharp jagged black rocks coat the landscape of this world, known for its stoneworks. Blackstone has been home to many pirate bands over the years.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 尖锐嶙峋的黑色岩石覆盖着这个星球的地貌，这里以其石作闻名. 多年来，Blackstone一直是许多海盗团体的家园.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Blair Atholl was settled during the Star League era, and is damp rainy world where the most prosperous life forms are the various types of fungus. Malthus Gambling Unlimited is rumoured to use the planet as a tax haven.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Blair Atholl是在星际联盟时代有人定居的，是一个潮湿多雨的世界，那里最繁盛的生命形态是各种真菌. 据传，Malthus Gambling Unlimited将该行星用作避税天堂.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A once beautiful world that is now scarred with dead zones from attacks centuries ago during the First Succession War, Blandinsville now relies on a skilled workforce to produce consumer electronics.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Blandinsville曾是一颗美丽的星球，如今却因几个世纪前第一次继承战争期间的攻击而满目疮痍，遍布死区；现在它依靠一支熟练的劳动力队伍生产消费电子产品.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Blandou was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Blandou于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Blida was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Blida在统一战争结束后的某个时候、于星际联盟时代被殖民，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Blommestein was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Blommestein于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战斗中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The world of Blue Diamond was struck by a plague in 2766 that swept through the crops grown on the planet and killed over a third of the population. It is now the site of several medical research facilities dedicated to disease control.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Blue Diamond世界在2766年遭遇了一场瘟疫，瘟疫席卷了该行星上种植的农作物，并导致超过三分之一的人口死亡. 如今，这里是若干致力于疾病控制的医学研究设施的所在地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The preponderance of fresh water on Blue Hole immediately made colonists wealthy as they exported fresh water to any number of worlds in the Lyran Commonwealth. Tourism also forms a large part of the economy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Blue Hole上丰富的淡水资源使殖民者迅速致富，因为他们将淡水出口到天琴共同体的众多世界. 旅游业也构成了经济的重要组成部分.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Blue Sava was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Blue Sava是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争期间因战火而消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Blueys was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Blueys在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled around 500 years ago, Bluford is a small agricultural planet known for its unusual native flora, most of which causes altered mental states in humans.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bluford在大约500年前被定居，是一颗小型农业行星，以其不寻常的原生植物群而闻名，其中大多数会导致人类精神状态发生改变.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally settled by Canadians from Terra, Blumenort is a nondescript temperate planet with minimal mineral wealth. Recently ruins from a previous possibly spacefaring race have been discovered, leading to a tourism boom.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Blumenort最初由来自泰拉的加拿大人定居，是一颗不起眼的温带行星，矿产资源极少. 最近发现了来自先前一个可能具备太空航行能力的种族的遗迹，从而引发了旅游热潮.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Boara was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Boara在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Boardwalk is just the right distance from its huge class O star to make life habitable, barely, on the few islands of this tiny water world.  Only its distance from the jump point makes the planet non-viable as a source of transportable water.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Boardwalk与其巨大的O型恒星之间的距离恰到好处，使得这颗小小水世界上的少数岛屿勉强能够维持生命. 唯一让它无法成为可运输水源的，是它距离跃迁点太远.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Dunklewälderdunklerflüssenschattenwelt the original name, made up when the first settlers tried some plants, was unpronounceable for everyone outside the Lyran Commonwealth. So the planet was renamed in something everyone could pronounce... Bob....
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Dunklewälderdunklerflüssenschattenwelt这个原名，是第一批定居者尝试了一些植物后编造出来的，对天琴共同体以外的所有人来说都难以发音. 于是，这颗行星被重新命名为一个所有人都能念出来的名字……Bob……

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A pleasant temperate world, filled with lush purple forests and generally peaceful reptilian life. Home to SeraVideo Entertainments Incorporated.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个宜人的温带世界，遍布茂密的紫色森林，以及通常性情平和的爬行动物生命. 这里是SeraVideo Entertainments Incorporated的所在地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bodnath was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bodnath在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某时被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战斗中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Boeotia was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Boeotia在统一战争结束后的某个时候于星际联盟时代被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bogard is a self-sufficient planet who's native alpha-carnivore is a large 4 meter long lizard with an amazing ability to blend into the environment due to its chameleon-like ability to change colours.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 博加德是一颗自给自足的星球，其本土顶级食肉动物是一种长达4米的大蜥蜴，因具备变色龙般的变色能力而极善于融入环境。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bogerth was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bogerth是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bogrib was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bogrib是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A dry mountainous world, Bolan was originally settled by people from the Indian subcontinent on Terra. Bolan has served as a regional capital for the Free Worlds League and the Lyrans. Bolan is home to the Melissa Steiner Martial Academy of Bolan.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个干燥的多山世界，Bolan最初由来自地球印度次大陆的人定居. Bolan曾作为自由世界联盟和天琴人的地区首府. Bolan是Bolan的梅丽莎·斯坦纳军事学院的所在地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bonaire was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bonaire于星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战乱中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original colonists of this frozen world died out soon after the colony's founding, but the planet has found new life as a base for pirates that prey on traffic between Liao and the Magistracy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这颗冰封世界最初的殖民者在建殖后不久就灭亡了，但这颗行星在作为海盗基地方面获得了新生命——那些海盗劫掠廖氏与治安官辖区之间的往来交通。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bondurant is a nondescript arid world, home to the Bondurant Tank Academy, arguably one of the best schools for tank operations in the Inner Sphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bondurant是一个不起眼的干旱世界，是Bondurant坦克学院的所在地，该学院可以说是内天体中最优秀的坦克作战学校之一.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bone-Norman was originally settled by the Rim Worlds Republic and was a part of the Apollo Province. It was conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth during the 2773-2775 Republic-Commonwealth War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bone-Norman最初由边缘世界共和国建立定居点，曾是阿波罗省的一部分. 在2773-2775年的共和国-共同体战争期间，它被天琴共同体征服.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bonneau is a small agricultural world deep in Federation space, known for its humid climate and the fact that the entire planet is overrun by a particularly hardy (and tasty) form of mushroom.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bonneau是联邦星域深处的一个小型农业世界，以其潮湿的气候以及整个星球都被一种格外顽强（且美味）的蘑菇所遍布而闻名.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Booker system was settled by the Magistracy of Canopus during the Star League era. It is home to Bermuda Combat Systems, a manufacturer of VTOLs and primitive versions of BattleMechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Booker星系在星盟时代由船底自治区殖民. 这里是Bermuda Combat Systems的所在地，该公司制造垂直起降飞行器和原始型战斗机甲.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The planet Boondock is almost completely covered with ice and snow and only near the equator does the temperature allow human habitation. Boondock supplies a major portion of the Federated Commonwealth's gold.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 本多克行星几乎完全被冰雪覆盖，只有赤道附近的气温才允许人类居住。本多克供应联邦共同体黄金产量的很大一部分。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Recently acquired from the Capellans during the 4th Succession War, Bora sits near the borders of the FWL. The main equatorial continent, Bora Bora, is known for its tourism industry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在第四次继承战争期间刚从卡佩拉人手中获得，Bora位于FWL边境附近. 主要的赤道大陆Bora Bora以其旅游业闻名.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once Borden had vast lakes but now those lakes are dry, with salt beaches. But the land, when watered, is still fertile and the planet supports a specialized black market and a sizable mining community that harvests salt, diamond and corundum.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 博登有过广阔的湖，但是现在那些湖都干涸了，只有盐滩. 但是它的土地在得到灌溉时依然肥沃，而且这颗行星支持着一家专门的黑市，和一个巨大的矿区，那里盛产盐，钻石和刚玉.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As a system originally colonized in the initial exodus from Terra, this rough backwater is easily forgotten.  Small and rocky, the majority of the population is comprised of a single large spaceport and a one-way prison for political dissidents.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为最初在从泰拉出发的初始大迁徙中被殖民的星系，这片崎岖的穷乡僻壤很容易被人遗忘. 它小而多岩，人口中的大多数都集中在一座大型太空港和一座关押政治异见者的有去无回的监狱里.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Borgan's Rift suffers from the crippling of interstellar economies and dramatic technological decline and was regularly pillaged by pirates. Borgan's Rift was sold to Shanti Magliss who built warehouses and distribution centers all over the planet.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 博尔甘裂隙饱受星际经济瘫痪与技术急剧衰退之苦，还常遭海盗劫掠。博尔甘裂隙被卖给了香缇·玛格丽丝，后者在全行星建起了仓库与配送中心。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The population of Borghese was self-sustaining, providing its own food crops and famed for its exotic fish export known as the \"mermaid\" fish. The planet's capital was named Houston, which was also its largest city.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 博尔盖塞的人口曾自给自足，自产粮食作物，并因出口名为"美人鱼"的奇特鱼类而闻名。该行星的首府名叫休斯敦，也是其最大的城市。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As with so many marginal mining colonies, Borka's value dropped off significantly during the Succession Wars; importing food to the cold and barren planet soon became prohibitively expensive, and the League abandoned the world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 就像许多边缘采矿殖民地一样，博尔卡的价值在继承战争期间大幅下滑；向这颗寒冷荒芜的行星进口粮食很快变得贵得离谱，联盟最终放弃了这个世界。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bossangoa was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bossangoa在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某时被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The obsidian sand from Botany Bay enabled them to establish a trade route whereby industrial sand was delivered to Sigurd and Sigurdian dross extractors shipped to Botany Bay for water purification.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 来自Botany Bay的黑耀石砂使他们得以建立一条贸易路线，借此将工业用砂运往Sigurd，并将Sigurd的浮渣提取器运往Botany Bay用于水净化.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bothwell was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bothwell在统一战争结束后的某个时候、星际联盟时代被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bougie was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bougie是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Boulsi was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Boulsi于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The largest agricultural planet within the Lyran Commonwealth, Bountiful Harvest has huge tracts of flat and arable lands and two large oceans, the entire word an agricultural haven able to support its own needs as well as neighboring systems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为天琴共同体内最大的农业行星，Bountiful Harvest拥有大片平坦且可耕种的土地以及两片广阔的海洋；整个星球是一座农业天堂，既能满足自身需求，也能供应邻近星系.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bowang was a major trading hub within the Free Worlds League during the Succession Wars. The planetary leaders, recognizing their ideal position, encouraged a stance of neutrality in all business and political dealings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bowang在继承战争期间是自由世界联盟内的主要贸易枢纽. 行星领导人认识到其理想位置，鼓励在所有商业和政治往来中采取中立立场.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Braben's Frontier was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 布拉本边境在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束之后的某个时候被殖民，却在继承战争的战火中消亡。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Brabent was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Brabent是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once described as \"Not Hell, but you can see it from here\", the large Martian like planet Brailsford would never have been colonised if it were not for its massive mineral reserves.  It also now contains one of the Combine's largest jails.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 曾被形容为"不是地狱，但你能从这儿看到它"，这颗类似火星的大行星布雷斯福德若不是因为其庞大的矿产储量，根本不会被殖民。它如今也拥有联合体最大的监狱之一。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Branzoll was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Branzoll在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Arriving in the early twenty-sixth century, the first settlers established the city of Alaikum, which would survive both the Reunification War and the decline of the Star League, becoming a center of Shi'ite scholarship and learning.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最早的定居者在二十六世纪初抵达，建立了阿莱库姆城；这座城市挺过了统一战争与星盟的衰落，成为什叶派学术与学问的中心。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Braum was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Braum是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Braunschweig is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League, exporting goods to other Hanseatic worlds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Braunschweig是构成被称为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家的诸世界之一，向其他汉萨世界出口货物.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the Combine's most productive breadbasket planets, Braunton acts as a trade hub for the local area as well.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为联合体产量最高的粮仓行星之一，布劳顿同时也充当周边地区的贸易枢纽。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Breed was invaded by the Eleventh Benjamin Regulars. Defending Breed were the Second Robinson Rangers. The campaign was still ongoing, with the Eleventh in control of the cities on Breed while the Rangers dominated the wilderness.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Breed遭到了第十一Benjamin正规军的入侵. 防守Breed的是第二Robinson游骑兵. 战役仍在进行中，第十一Benjamin正规军控制着Breed上的城市，而Robinson游骑兵则控制着荒野.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bremen is the capital world of the Hanseatic League, and contains the main houses of the large trading families as well as the Council of Merchants.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bremen是汉萨同盟的首府星，设有大型贸易家族的总部以及商人议会.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bremen (RW) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bremen (RW) 在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bremond was liberated by the Armed Forces of the Federated Suns in 2798-9, in one of a wave of uncoordinated retaliatory attacks launched in response to the news about the Kentares Massacre, having been occupied by the Combine at some point in 2797.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bremond于 2798 年至 2799 年间被恒星联邦武装部队解放，这是为回应肯塔雷斯屠杀的消息而发动的一波缺乏协调的报复性攻击中的一次；该星系此前曾在 2797 年的某个时候被天龙联合体占领.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Brest was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Brest是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中最终消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Described as \"The happiest place in Lyran space\", Breukelen's native flora release pollens that are mildly euphoric to humans.  This has resulted in a significant tourism industry, and a \"hippy\" culture on the planet.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 被描述为"莱兰空间里最快乐的地方"，布鲁克伦的原生植物会释放对人有轻度欣快作用的花粉。这带来了可观的旅游业，以及行星上的一种"嬉皮"文化。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Brighton was originally settled by miners looking to exploit the copper and silver ores on the world. Brighton's other claim to fame is that it was the site of the only official Capellan political prison.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 布莱顿最初由觊觎该行星铜矿与银矿的矿工建立。布莱顿另一项为人所知之处，在于它是卡佩兰唯一官方政治监狱的所在地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An otherwise unremarkable planet on the spinward edge of the Combine, Brihuega has become known as \"The planet of spies\" due to its \"use\" as a training ground for Commonwealth agents operating out of Farstar.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为联合体朝自转方向边缘一颗不起眼的星球，布里韦加因其被“用作”联邦特工（以远星为基地）的训练场而以“间谍之星”闻名。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Brim system is the location of a habitable world, Brim IV, and is located in the Deep Periphery region
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Brim星系是宜居世界Brim IV的所在地，位于深空外围区域.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A lush, high-gravity world, Bringdam's atmosphere is so dense as to be almost unbreathable. The humidity makes it a poor location for mining, but it is an excellent agricultural world, supplying itself and a number of nearby systems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 布林格丹是一颗植被繁茂的高重力行星，其大气浓密到几乎无法呼吸。潮湿的气候使这里不适合采矿，但它却是一颗绝佳的农业行星，不但自给自足，还供应附近多个星系。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A lush, high-gravity world, Bringdam's atmosphere is so dense as to be almost unbreathable. The humidity makes it a poor location for mining, but it is an excellent agricultural world, supplying itself and a number of nearby systems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 布林格丹是一颗植被繁茂的高重力行星，其大气浓密到几乎无法呼吸。潮湿的气候使这里不适合采矿，但它却是一颗绝佳的农业行星，不但自给自足，还供应附近多个星系。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Brinton is an infamous world due to the plague that bears its name. Centuries ago the Capellans released a bio-weapon on the surface, which continues to be deadly even now. The target of numerous raids, Brinton is now heavily guarded by the Concordat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 布林顿是一个臭名昭著的星球，因为它的名字是瘟疫的名字. 几个世纪以前，卡佩拉人在地表释放出一种生物武器，甚至到现在依然致命. 作为无数袭击的目标，布林顿现在由协约国重兵把守.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Brisbane is a beautiful ocean world with pristine white-sand beaches that conceal a deadly secret: a viral degenerative nerve disease with no cure. Those unlucky enough to contract it gradually lose the use of their limbs and muscles.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 布里斯班是一个美丽的海洋星球，原生态的白沙海滩下掩藏着一个致命的秘密: 那就是某种无法治愈的神经退行性疾病病毒. 那些不幸被感染的患者逐渐失去了对四肢和肌肉的控制.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Colonised during the First Exodus from Terra, Bristol has always been a planet heavily geared towards manufacturing, although the ravages of the Succession Wars has reduced this to one significant arms maker - Jolassa-Kumbold Armored Weapons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bristol是在从泰拉出发的第一次大迁徙期间被殖民的，它始终是一颗高度偏向制造业的行星，尽管继承战争的摧残已使其缩减为一家重要的武器制造商——Jolassa-Kumbold Armored Weapons.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Brixtana is a cold world with windswept tundra and boreal forests. Once the site of an SLDF garrison, it was conquered early in the Reunification War despite dogged resistance by Magistracy-aligned mercenaries.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 布里克斯塔纳是一个寒冷的星球，那里有风袭苔原和北极针叶林. 布里克斯塔纳曾经是一支星际联盟防卫军守备部队的地方，尽管与自治区结盟的雇佣兵顽强抵抗，但它在统一战争中早早就被征服了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Broaddus is a temperate world, with large areas of grasslands ideal for the farming of cattle and other herbivores.  Coastal areas of this almost hillless planet form large areas of marshland, which should be avoided by heavy vehicles (and 'Mechs).
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 布罗德斯是一颗温带行星，有大片适合养牛及其他食草动物的草原。这颗几乎没有丘陵的行星沿海区域形成大片沼泽，重型车辆（以及机甲）应当避开。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Brocchi's Cluster contains what appears to be the remnants of a large planet in the \"green zone\" of this Class M star, which at some point has exploded into a large asteroid belt.  Over 40 inhabited planetoids and constructs exist in the area.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 布罗基星团包含了这颗M级恒星"绿区"中一颗大行星看似爆炸后形成的大片小行星带残骸。该区域存在40多个有人居住的小行星体与构造物。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Brockton is a planet of small settlements and vast untouched wilderness.  The local flora has adapted to cope with the underground fungus that exists across the planet, however this fungal growth makes traditional farming almost impossible.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Brockton是一颗由小型定居点和广袤未受破坏的荒野组成的行星. 当地的植物群已经适应了遍布整个行星的地下真菌，然而这种真菌的生长使得传统农业几乎无法进行.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A rugged, harsh world, Brockway was colonized only due to its rich mineral resources. Originally held by the Concordat, the planet was seized by the Federated Suns after the Reunification War and has been a Davion holding ever since.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 布罗克维是个崎岖，严酷的行星，因其丰富的矿产资源而被殖民. 这颗星球最初为协约国所有，在统一战争后被恒星联邦占领，从那时起就一直为戴维恩所有.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Broken Wheel is a Fed planet on the edge of the Inner Sphere, unremarkable save for the extensive repair and refit facilities that dot the planet.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Broken Wheel是内天体边缘的一颗联邦星球，除了遍布星球的大规模维修与改装设施外，毫不起眼.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The arid world of Bromhead was settled in the first wave of colonization, and was a Taurian holding until the Reunification War. It is now a Davion possession, with a large population in sprawling river-bank cities that nestle in the vast deserts.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在第一波殖民浪潮中，就有人定居在了布罗姆黑德这个干旱的星球，在统一战争之前它都是金牛领土. 现在它是戴维恩的属地，大量人口都在位于大沙漠，而且连绵不绝的河岸城市里.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A major mining and refining planet for the Feds, Brookeland also has a bright Type O star which makes it favoured as a recharge point for jump routes.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为联邦的重要采矿与精炼行星，Brookeland还拥有一颗明亮的O型恒星，这使其成为跳跃航线中备受青睐的充能点.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Another \"Breadbasket\" world deep in Lyran territory, Brooloo is a laid back world of large farms untouched by conflict.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为莱兰领地深处的又一颗"粮仓"行星，布鲁卢是个悠闲的世界，大片农庄从未被战火触及。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Brownsville was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Brownsville在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A former Combine planet recently annexed by the FRR, Bruben is notable only in the fact that it is (more-or-less) self sufficient, with a balanced mix of agriculture and manufacturing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bruben是一颗最近被FRR吞并的前Combine星球，唯一值得注意之处在于它（或多或少）能够自给自足，且农业与制造业保持着均衡的组合.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bruges is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League, exporting goods to other Hanseatic worlds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bruges是属于被称为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家的行星之一，向其他汉萨同盟行星出口货物.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Brundage is a desert world with vast mountain ranges, that can barely support its own population.  Recent rumours of a lost Star League cache has brought treasure seekers to the world, who have so far found nothing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Brundage是一个沙漠世界，山峦广袤，几乎无法养活自身人口. 最近关于一处失落的星际联盟秘藏的传闻引来了寻宝者，但他们至今一无所获.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: No data exists for this planet.  Orbital scans show no significant settlement, or life for that matter.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这颗行星没有任何数据. 轨道扫描显示这里没有显著的定居点，也没有生命.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Brusett is a typical backwater farming planet, near the border with the Taurean Concordant.  Rural, and boring.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Brusett是一个典型的偏远农业星球，靠近与金牛协约国的边境. 充满乡村气息，而且枯燥乏味.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bryant was the subject of an early terraforming project which succeeded. Unfortunately the satellites which stabilized Bryant's changed climate were destroyed during the Amaris Civil War and the climate has now returned to its original hostile state.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 布莱恩特是一项早期地球改造项目的对象，并且成功了。不幸的是，稳定布莱恩特改变后气候的卫星在阿马里斯内战中被摧毁，气候如今已恢复原本的恶劣状态。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally settled by the Outworlds Alliance, Bryceland was ceded to the Combine in 2585, before being lost to the Feds during the Second Succession War.  Bryceland remains home to several Battlemech plants.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初由外域联盟定居，Bryceland于 2585 年被割让给天龙联合，后在第二次继承战争期间被联邦夺走. Bryceland至今仍是数座战斗机甲工厂的所在地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Buchlau was settled for its fish. The planet only has a single continent, Vienna, which is surrounded by a massive ocean. This ocean is teeming with life.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Buchlau因其鱼类而被殖民. 这颗行星只有一个大陆——维也纳，它被一片巨大的海洋所环绕. 这片海洋中生机勃勃.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bucklands - the planet that should have been called Farmlands.  Almost every inch of landmass on this planet is farmed to take advantage of its highly arable soil.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bucklands——本该被称作“农田”的星球. 为了充分利用其极为适宜耕作的土壤，这颗星球上几乎每一寸陆地都被开垦耕种.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Buckminster is a regional capital in the Combine, and remains one of its most important agriculture and production planets.  Only recently has the Second Sword of Light moved off-planet, leaving its defence to the 7th and 8th Alshain Regulars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Buckminster是联合体的一个地区首府，并且仍是其最重要的农业与生产行星之一. 直到最近，第二光之剑才离开该行星，将其防御留给第7和第8 Alshain常备军.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Budingen is a minor mining and manufacturing planet, plagues by brutal storms and frigid winters.  It's importance is more for its proximity to the Outworld Alliance than its actual worth.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 布丁根是一颗次要的采矿与制造行星，饱受残酷风暴与严寒冬季之苦。它的重要性更多来自它靠近外域联盟，而非其自身价值。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In 3020 the Lyran Commonwealth Armed Forces opened the War College of Buena, a military academy that specialized in training MechWarriors and teaching Maintenance Sciences.  Beyond that, the planet is basically mediterranean style farms.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 3020年，天琴共同体武装部队开办了Buena战争学院，这是一所军事学院，专门训练机甲战士并教授维护科学. 除此之外，该星球基本上都是地中海式农场.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This agricultural world has been the target of repeated Marik attempts to conquer it. To protect its food production, most farms were moved underground or to hydroponic offshore platforms. The planet's capital, also called Buenos Aires, is a teeming metropolis of millions.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这颗农业世界一直是马里克反复试图征服的目标。为保护其粮食生产，大多数农场被转入地下或移到水培式海上平台。该行星的首府也叫布宜诺斯艾利斯，是一座拥有数百万人口的繁华大都市。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Buenos Aires
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 布宜诺斯艾利斯

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Burnt Rock was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Burnt Rock是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Burton is a company world, the home of one of the largest Taurian electronics manufacturers. Most of the world's small population consists of employees, staff, and support services for O-P Computer Electronics.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 伯顿是一个公司世界，陶里安最大电子制造商之一的所在地。该世界稀少的人口大多是O-P电脑电子的雇员、职员与配套服务人员。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bushmill was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Bushmill是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Butler is a peaceful earth-like planet, with a diverse manufacturing base.  Plans are in place to build an orbital ship yard, which will no doubt boost Butler's economy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 巴特勒是一颗和平的类地行星，拥有多样化的制造基础。建造轨道船坞的计划已就位，无疑将提振巴特勒的经济。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Butte Hold is a minor planet in the newly formed Greater Valkyrate.  Barely self-sufficient agriculturally, and totally dependent on importation of manufactured goods, it is of little importance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Butte Hold是新成立的大瓦尔基里特中的一颗次要行星. 它在农业上勉强自给自足，并且完全依赖进口制成品，因此无足轻重.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Butzfleth (AKA \"Butt Flesh\"), is a minor FWL planet only important because it contains one of the largest prisons in FWL space.  The inhospitable planet is otherwise only inhabited by miners and local support businesses.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 布茨弗莱斯（又名"屁股肉"）是FWL一颗次要行星，其重要性仅在于它拥有FWL空间内最大的监狱之一。这颗不宜居住的行星除此之外只有矿工和本地配套商家居住。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Bye's Ship was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 拜伊之船是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中灭亡。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A minor planet on the Combine/FRR border, Byesville is only inhabitable at the poles, with the rest of the planet too hot to support human life.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为联合体与FRR边界上的一颗次要行星，拜斯维尔只有在两极才可居住，行星其余部分热得无法支持人类生命。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A desolate system that is devoid of colonists, initially settled during the Star League era, but now lays abandoned in the outskirts of the Draconis Combine
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个没有殖民者的荒凉星系，最初在星际联盟时代有人定居，如今却被遗弃在天龙联合体的边垂.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A system on the edge of human explored space, formally settled by the Taurians during the Star League era, it now lays empty, possibly due to one of the many orbiting asteroids crashing down on the settlers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个位于人类已探索太空边缘的星系，在星际联盟时代由金牛人正式建立了定居点，如今却空无一人，可能是因为众多在轨小行星中的一颗砸向了定居者.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cadiz is a small, tropical planet, known for its endless swamps, and swarms of insects.  Not a nice place to live, unless you are a frog.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cadiz是一颗小型的热带行星，以无尽的沼泽和成群的昆虫而闻名. 除非你是一只青蛙，否则这里可不是个适合居住的好地方.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Recently settled after the Fourth Succession War, Cadiz is a small agricultural world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cadiz是在第四次继承战争后新近有人定居的小型农业星球.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A system initially settled by Davions in the Draconis March. It was immediately found that the local flora was very hostile, with extremely large Venus Fly Traps eating several explorers. It was finally abandoned due to increasing raids by the DCMS.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个最初由戴维恩家族在天龙座边境殖民的星系. 人们立刻发现当地植物群极具敌意，极其巨大的捕蝇草吃掉了数名探险者. 由于DCMS不断升级的袭击，它最终被废弃.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: After the end of the Reunification War, some Kuritans were ashamed of their soldiers' role in the massacres, and sought to get away from the actions of the DCMS. Sadly, the colony failed as the settlers were not used to the harshness periphery.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 统一战争结束后，一些库瑞塔人为其士兵在大屠杀中的角色感到羞耻，试图远离DCMS的所作所为。遗憾的是，该殖民地失败了，因为定居者不习惯外围地区的严酷。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Caesar's Crown is a young star cluster in the anti-spinward Deep Periphery.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凯撒之冠是反自转方向纵深外围中一个年轻的星团。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cahokia IV - more commonly known simply as Cahokia - is the fourth planet in the Cahokia system and has a single moon named Sequoia. Cahokia has been home to a manufacturing plant operated by Achernar BattleMechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cahokia IV——通常简称为Cahokia——是Cahokia星系中的第四颗行星，拥有一颗名为Sequoia的卫星. Cahokia一直是Achernar BattleMechs运营的一家制造工厂的所在地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Caillinius was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Caillinius在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cajamarca is an anomaly - A smallish planet with a high gravity, thanks to its abundant reserves of heavy metals. As a result, mining operations are plentiful, in spite of its hostile environment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cajamarca是个异数——一颗体积较小、却因富含重金属而拥有高重力的行星. 因此，尽管环境恶劣，采矿作业依然十分兴盛.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Calafell is typical of a central Lyran planet - heavily industrialised, but also self-sufficient.  Trade opportunities abound, particularly if you know where to look.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Calafell是典型的天琴中部行星——高度工业化，但也自给自足. 贸易机会比比皆是，尤其是如果你知道该去哪里寻找.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Calchedon was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Calchedon在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A typical Periphery world, Caldarium has just enough resources to be more-or-less self sufficient, but not enough to cause the Lyran Commonwealth to be interested enough to remove the substantial pirate presence to take it over.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一个典型的外围世界，Caldarium的资源刚好足以让它勉强自给自足，却不足以让天琴共同体感兴趣到愿意清除那里规模可观的海盗势力并将其接管.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Caldrea was captured by the Draconis Combine in 2812, using fast-moving BattleMech forces that were able to defeat the defending forces despite the defenders using nuclear weapons in an effort to try and resist the invasion.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2812年，天龙联合体使用快速机动的战斗机甲部队攻占了Caldrea；尽管守军动用核武器试图抵抗入侵，这些部队仍击败了守军.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Caldwell has been a Fed planet for most of the last 450 years.  In spite of being the home to the Fighting Urukhai (under contract to the Feds), rumours abound of a hidden pirate base, if not on-planet, then at least in-system.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Caldwell在过去450年的大部分时间里一直是联邦星球. 尽管这里是好战乌鲁克（受雇于联邦）的驻地，但有关隐藏海盗基地的传闻仍甚嚣尘上——即使不在行星上，至少也在星系内.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Caledea was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Caledea于统一战争结束后的星盟时代某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Caledon suffered heavy damage when House Kurita conquered the planet in 2849 and effectively scorched the planet. The world was slow to recover, and was subsequently ruled from offworld for over a century, first from Hesperus II and then Tharkad.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Caledon在2849年被栗田家族征服时遭受重创，实际上被烧成了焦土. 该星球恢复缓慢，随后一个多世纪里一直由其他星球统治，最初是Hesperus II，后来是Tharkad.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Calingasta was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Calingasta在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Calish is an anomaly - the system has 2 planets in the habitable zone.  The primary planet, Calish III, is an arctic world with a broad band of arable land around the equator, while Calish II is an arid hotbox with large mineral deposits.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Calish是一个异常现象——该星系在宜居带内拥有 2 颗行星. 主行星Calish III是一个极寒世界，赤道周围有一条宽阔的可耕地带，而Calish II则是一个干旱的酷热世界，蕴藏着大量矿藏.
