Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Callison supports a large, relatively prosperous population but lacks in mineral wealth or strategically important heavy industry. Traditionally a part of the FWL, Callison was only incorporated in to the Lyran Commonwealth in 3029.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Callison支撑着庞大且相对富裕的人口，但缺乏矿产资源或具有战略重要性的重工业. 传统上，Callison是自由世界联盟（FWL）的一部分，直到 3029 年才被并入天琴共同体.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Callisto's claim to fame is tourism and retirement.  Rich folks with nothing better to do come and spend 18+ hours a day in one fantasy neural-link game or another.  I bet none of them ever entered data into a spreadsheet either...
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 卡利斯托赖以成名的是旅游和养老。有钱又无事可做的人跑来一天花18小时以上泡在这个或那个幻想神经链接游戏里。我打赌他们中也从没有人往电子表格里输过数据……

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Calloway system was settled during or shortly before the Age of War. 3 moons at Calloway VI reflect so much sunlight that no city on the world has had to install street lamps. Trading is a bedrock of the planetary economy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Calloway星系在战争时代期间或之前不久被殖民. Calloway VI的3颗卫星反射了如此多的阳光，以至于该星球上没有一座城市需要安装路灯. 贸易是该行星经济的基石.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sitting right on the Capellan/FWL border for as long as anyone can remember, Calpaca has remarkably remained a peaceful place of rolling purple hills, where strangely attractive alien sheep roam, herded by macho looking agromechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 自人们记忆所及，卡尔帕卡就紧贴卡佩兰/FWL边界，却出奇地保持着和平，是一片起伏的紫色丘陵，怪异地迷人的外星绵羊在其中游荡，由看起来很有男子气概的农用机甲放牧。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A mining and industrial world of more strategic than economic value, Calseraigne was seized from the Capellans during the Third Succession War by the Free Worlds League. The inhabitants chafe under Marik rule, and unrest and minor sabotage is common.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 卡塞莱涅是一个战略意义重于经济价值的矿业和工业行星，在第三次继承战争期间它被自由世界联盟从卡佩拉人手中夺走了. 居民不忿于马里克的统治，经常会有骚乱和小规模的破坏.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Calvados was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Calvados在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The system is strewn with thousands of asteroids and three large gas giants. The Department of Mega Engineering terraformed one of the moons in the system to serve as a base for system wide asteroid mining operations.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该星系散布着数千颗小行星和三颗巨大的气态巨行星. 巨型工程部对该星系中的一颗卫星进行了地球化改造，将其用作全星系小行星采矿作业的基地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Don't look at me, please. I'm an honest mistake that I had no part in creating.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 请别看我。我是个无辜的错误，我完全没参与创造我自己。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A rugged world with many ruins, Cambiano is home to one the Federations key archaeological sites, the Mighty Nein.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cambiano是一个崎岖且遍布废墟的世界，是联邦重要考古遗址之一——Mighty Nein——的所在地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: SURVEY DATA INCOMPLETE
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 勘测数据不完整

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Cameron system was settled during the First Exodus from Terra, and was a member of the Principality of Regulus prior to the formation of the Free Worlds League in the late twenty-third century.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cameron星系在第一次从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间被殖民，并在二十三世纪后期自由世界联盟成立之前曾是Regulus公国的成员.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An otherwise nondescript planet deep in Lyran space, Cameron is known for its agriculture, and its production of a particularly nice single malt scotch.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cameron是天琴领空深处一颗原本毫不起眼的行星，以其农业和出产一种格外优质的单一麦芽苏格兰威士忌而闻名.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Camlann was one of many worlds to be colonized after the widespread adoption of the Laranth water-purification process in the 2630s, technology that made the terraforming easier by removing the requirement for the importing of pure water by ice ship.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Camlann是2630年代Laranth净水工艺被广泛采用后众多被殖民的星球之一，这项技术消除了用冰船进口纯净水的需求，使地球化改造变得更加容易.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally settled by fanatical Muslims around 2400, Camlann has recently passed from Lyran to Combine hands a few times.  Now \"safely\" in Draconis hands again, Camlann is typical of a border world full of militant religious fanatics... Interesting.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 卡姆兰最初在约2400年由狂热的穆斯林定居，近来在莱兰与联合体之间几度易手。如今又"安全"地回到龙尼斯手中，卡姆兰是典型的充满好战宗教狂热分子的边界世界……有意思。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Typical of a border world, Cammal has seen frequent raids from the Confederation ever since the system was taken over by the Federation during the Second Succession War.  Such raids have always had \"Plausable Deniability\", as such raids always do...
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为典型的边界世界，自该星系在第二次继承战争期间被联邦接管以来，卡马尔一直遭受来自联邦的频繁袭击。这类袭击向来都有"合理的可否认性"，向来如此……

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Campbelton III is the third planet in the Campbelton system and has a single moon named Atholville. Campbelton has been host to at facilities operated by at least one significant defense manufacturing company.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Campbelton III是Campbelton星系中的第三颗行星，拥有一颗名为Atholville的卫星. Campbelton一直是至少一家重要国防制造公司运营设施的所在地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The general rule is that border worlds don't contain significant manufacturing facilities.  Campertown is an exception to the rule, with Sacrada Industries having some important facilities here, manufacturing communications and guidance systems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 通常的规则是边界世界不包含重要的制造设施。坎珀顿是这条规则的例外，萨克拉达工业在这里有一些重要设施，制造通讯与制导系统。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A stop-over point for those heading into the Periphery and Deep Periphery. A large population of retired spacers, combined with the trading and exploration route, made Campoleone a storehouse of knowledge in the Free Worlds League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对于前往外围和深空外围的人来说，这里是一个中途停留点. 大量退役宇航员，加上贸易与探索航线，使Campoleone成为自由世界联盟中的一座知识宝库.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Canal system is located near the Moriguchi and Sweet Water systems. During the final years of the Star League, Canal was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Canal星系位于Moriguchi和Sweet Water星系附近. 在星际联盟的最后几年，Canal驻扎着星际联盟防卫军的一支驻军.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Candiear is a very \"liberal\" planet, who's fertile farmlands are just as likely to be producing plants for \"recreational purposes\" as they are food.  The net result is a distinct \"hippy\" feel to the planet, and a small tourist trade.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 坎迪尔是一颗非常"自由主义"的行星，它肥沃的农田既可能种出供"消遣用途"的植物，也可能种出粮食。净结果是该行星有一种鲜明的"嬉皮"气氛，以及一点旅游生意。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The ruins of a Star League-Era manufacturing facility lay seemingly dormant and neglected.  A careful eye might notice the occasional heat signature, but no inhabitants ever intentionally make themselves known.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星际联盟时代制造设施的废墟看似沉寂荒废、无人问津. 细心留意的话，或许会注意到偶尔出现的热信号，但从未有居民刻意暴露自己的存在.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Canopus IV has served as the planetary capital of the Magistracy of Canopus since the founding of the nation, and was heavily-industrialized for a Periphery planet
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 自建国以来，Canopus IV一直是船底自治区的行星首府，并且以一颗边缘星球而言，其工业化程度很高.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Being deep in Fed space has allowed Capac a \"more or less peaceful\" existence over the years, which is one of the reasons it was chosen to house a large prison complex.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 多年来，身处联邦空间的深处让卡帕克享有"大致和平"的存在，这也是它被选来安置一座大型监狱建筑群的原因之一。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The former capital of the Capellan Confederation, Capella remains an important industrial planet with orbital shipyards.  Additionally, the Capellan War College remains one of the premier centres of learning in the Confederation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为卡佩拉邦联的前首都，卡佩拉仍是一颗拥有轨道船坞的重要工业行星. 此外，卡佩拉战争学院仍是邦联中首屈一指的学术中心之一.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Caph has large swath of tropical rainforests, fertile lands and large amounts of mineral wealth. Sections of the planet were rendered uninhabitable during the First and Second Succession Wars, but Caph maintains many other Star League era facilities.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Caph拥有大片热带雨林、肥沃的土地和大量矿产资源. 在第一次和第二次继承战争期间，该行星的部分区域变得无法居住，但Caph仍保留着许多其他星际联盟时代的设施.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Capolla's thick surface jungle hides significant mineral wealth. The residents have long-standing political ties with their neighbours on Terra Firma, and the two planets tend to wield their economic and political power together.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 卡波拉厚重的表层丛林隐藏着可观的矿产财富。居民与他们在特拉菲尔马的邻居有着长期的政治纽带，两颗行星往往联手运用其经济与政治力量。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Capra was the headquarters world of the XXIII Corps (Star League) of the Star League Defense Force during the final years of the Star League.  As a result, there are the usual rumours of a \"hidden cache\" that always surround former SLDF bases.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 卡普拉在星盟最后几年是星盟防卫部队第二十三军（星盟）的总部世界。因此，围绕前SLDF基地总会有那种关于"隐秘储藏库"的老套传言。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Capricorn was once a significant manufacturing planet for Wu Industries, however they discontinued operations in 2612 due to depleted mineral reserves increasing the cost of production.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Capricorn曾是吴氏工业的重要制造星球，然而由于矿物储量枯竭导致生产成本上升，该公司于2612年停止了运营.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cap Rouge has three continents named beauport, Sainte-Foy and Sillery.  Hero Training Institute, a military academy specializing in training MechWarriors and Aerospace personnel, is located on Sillery.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cap Rouge拥有三块大陆，分别名为beauport、Sainte-Foy和Sillery. 英雄训练学院是一所专门训练机甲战士和航空航天人员的军事学院，位于Sillery.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Caracol was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Caracol在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: During the final years of the Star League, Carbonis' was the home of an insurgent movement that targeted both Confederation and SLDF troops. Carbonis was the site of Fort Dunedin, a Star League era base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星盟的最后几年，卡波尼斯是一支叛乱运动的据点，同时针对联邦与SLDF部队。卡波尼斯也是邓尼丁堡的所在地，一处星盟时代的基地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Carcassonne was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Carcassonne是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: SURVEY DATA INCOMPLETE
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 勘测数据不完整

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cardff was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cardff在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Caria was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Caria在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Caripare is a garden planet, who's lush vegetation and highly arable soil have made it almost vital to the survival of surrounding planets. Further, its warm waters support a wide variety of aquatic life, most of which is edible.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 卡里帕雷是一颗花园行星，其葱郁植被与高度可耕的土壤使它几乎对周边行星的存续至关重要。此外，它温暖的水域支撑着种类繁多的水生生物，其中大多可食用。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A largely peaceful and well-industrialized planet with a terrestrial climate, Carlisle was home to a large planetary militia as well as supplemental defense forces controlled by the owners of the factories located on the planet.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Carlisle是一个总体和平、高度工业化且拥有类地气候的星球，拥有庞大的行星民兵，以及由该星球上工厂所有者控制的辅助防御部队.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: During the Star League era, Carmacks was considered a major commercial and transport hub. This concentration of wealth and its location attracted numerous bandit raids which kept its SLDF defenders active.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星盟时代，Carmacks被视为主要的商业与运输枢纽. 财富的集中及其地理位置招来了大量匪帮劫掠，使其SLDF守军疲于应对.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Carmelita was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Carmelita是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争期间消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Carmen is a small Capellan planet of little apparent importance.  Ruins of a pre-human civilisation still dot the planet, which scientists believe was wiped out over 200000 years ago by an unknown event.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Carmen是卡佩拉的一颗小型行星，表面上无足轻重. 前人类文明的遗迹仍散布在这颗行星上，科学家认为该文明在20多万年前被一场未知事件毁灭.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Storms and befouled air make Carmichael a miserable place. The Taurian inhabitants fought a long, brutal guerilla war against the SLDF during the Reunification War, but ultimately lost; since then, the world has been a Davion holding.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 风暴和污浊的空气使得卡迈克尔成了一个悲惨的地方. 在统一战争期间，金牛住民与星际联盟防卫军进行了一场漫长而残酷的游击战争，但最终失败了; 从那时起，该星球就一直是戴维恩的土地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Carnac was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Carnac于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Carnwath is a relatively unimportant world with a hot, humid climate. The world is known primarily for two things; its tropical fruit exports and its infamous swarms of stinging insects.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Carnwath是一颗相对不重要的星球，气候炎热潮湿. 这颗星球主要以两件事闻名: 热带水果出口，以及声名狼藉的刺人昆虫群.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A double sun and Carse's unusual orbit provided four cycles of seasons. During a Cold Cycle, the temperature plummeted, oceans froze, and only DropShips and the largest air vehicles could survive the heavy winds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 双日和卡尔斯不寻常的轨道带来了四个季节循环。在寒季，气温骤降，海洋封冻，只有空投艇和最大的飞行器能在狂风下幸存。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Carsphairn has very fertile soil but it wracked by dangerous storms. Over the centuries large weatherproofing domes have been built over the best farmland, ensuring a good harvest each year.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Carsphairn拥有非常肥沃的土壤，但饱受危险风暴的侵袭. 几个世纪以来，最好的农田上方建起了巨大的防风雨穹顶，确保每年都有好收成.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The fourth planet in the Carstairs system is named New Tucson. It is site of a major copper mining operation by FrictionTechInc, who often hire small mercenary outfits for protection.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Carstairs星系中的第四颗行星名为New Tucson. 这里是FrictionTechInc大型铜矿开采作业的所在地，该公司经常雇佣小型雇佣兵部队提供保护.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Cartago system was colonized at some point during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was the subject of the Cartago Conflict in the early 2400s. It had been incorporated into the Federated Suns by the end of the Age of War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cartago星系在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民，并在2400年代初成为Cartago冲突的焦点. 到战争时代结束时，它已被并入恒星联邦.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Carthage is so far out in the distant Periphery, and so isolated, that despite its pleasant climate it remains only lightly settled by eccentrics, adventurers, and criminals. Its single spaceport is little more than a concrete pad with a few service buildings.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 迦太基在遥远的外围，与世隔绝，尽管它气候宜人，仍然只有少许怪人，冒险家和罪犯居住. 它唯一的一座太空港不过是一块混凝土板和一些服务建筑.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Recently settled after the Fourth Succession War, Carvajal is a small agricultural colony set up amongst a fertile volcanic plain.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在第四次继承战争后不久才建立定居点的Carvajal，是一个坐落在一片肥沃火山平原之中的小型农业殖民地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Located in a central area between several factions, the Carver system has been in the hands of many different rulers. As such, its populace has little allegiance to any faction, and generally try to do the best for themselves.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Carver星系位于几个派系之间的中心地带，曾落入许多不同统治者的手中. 因此，其民众对任何派系都几乎没有忠诚可言，通常只求为自己谋取最大利益.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cascade was always a FWL planet, and given its limited resources it has remained peaceful in spite of its border position with the Lyrans.  Several strange ruins have been found on the planet, hinting of a (now dead) former civilisation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cascade一直是自由世界联盟（FWL）的星球；由于资源有限，尽管地处与天琴人接壤的边境，它仍一直保持和平. 在这颗行星上发现了数处奇怪的遗迹，暗示着一个（现已消亡的）古代文明.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Despite being similar to Terra, Caselton is too dry and too cold to easily grow crops. Similarly it has enough minerals to support its population, but not enough to export.  It has an asteroid belt (the Cassini Belt) that is mined for minerals.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 尽管与泰拉相似，Caselton过于干燥、过于寒冷，难以轻松种植作物. 同样，它的矿物足以维持其人口，但不足以出口. 它有一条小行星带（卡西尼带），人们在那里开采矿物.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Casere system was colonised at some point prior to the end of the Reunification War and by the Star League era was a part of the Draconis Combine, where it remained until the formation of the Free Rasalhague Republic.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Casere星系在统一战争结束前的某个时候被殖民，到星际联盟时代时已成为天龙联合体的一部分，并一直如此，直到自由拉萨尔哈格共和国成立.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cassias is a tropical world located on the Draconis Combine/Federated Suns border. It also acted as the border between the \"Outback\" and the more densely populated inner systems of the Federated Suns.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 卡西亚斯是一颗位于龙尼斯联合体与联邦太阳边界上的热带行星。它同时也充当了联邦太阳"内陆"与人口更稠密的内部星系之间的分界。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This aquatic world is famed for its bountiful, deadly oceans. The population is clustered on volcanic island chains along the equator, while the oceans are ruled by a vast array of native predatory life forms.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这颗丰水星球因其广阔，致命的海洋而闻名. 人口聚集在赤道沿线的火山岛链上，而海洋则被大量的土著食肉生物所统治.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Castile is the fourth planet in the system and is home to the only BattleMech manufacturing at King Dumount Defense Facility in the Nueva Castile region.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Castile是该星系的第四颗行星，也是新卡斯蒂利亚地区King Dumount Defense Facility唯一战斗机甲制造业务的所在地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Castor has been the site of regular raids and battles between the Lyran and Free Worlds Armed Forces for the last two centuries. Famously, a raid from the Kell Hounds in 3011 destroyed a stockpile of ancient nuclear warheads on Castor.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 过去两个世纪里，Castor一直是天琴与自由世界武装部队之间定期突袭和战斗的发生地. 其中尤为著名的是，3011年凯尔猎犬的一次突袭摧毁了Castor上的一批古代核弹头储备.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Castrovia was a member of the Sian Commonwealth prior to the formation of the Capellan Combine in the mid-twenty-fourth century. Many educational institutes offer extensive archaeological courses surveying the planets many ruins.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在二十四世纪中叶卡佩拉联合体成立之前，Castrovia曾是锡安共同体的成员. 许多教育机构提供广泛的考古课程，考察该行星上的众多遗迹.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cate's Hold was settled as a gambling and resort world, but soon became a critical logistical center for the Magistracy in the Reunification War. Recent prospectors have discovered caches of SLDF technology and radioactive ores, once more drawing interest to the planet.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凯特之握最初作为赌博与度假星球被殖民，但很快成为卡诺帕斯行政区在统一战争中的关键后勤中心。近期的勘探者发现了SLDF技术储藏与放射性矿石，再次引起对该星球的兴趣。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Catroxx was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Catroxx于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cavalor was settled after the Reunification War, as the Capellans sought to reinforce their borders with the Magistracy and the Free Worlds League. Since that time, fertile soil and plentiful resources have caused the population of the world to explode.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 卡瓦罗尔是在统一战争后，因为卡佩拉人企图加强他们与船底自治区和自由世界联盟的边界而被殖民的. 从那时起，肥沃的土壤和丰富的资源导致星球人口激增.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Naming conventions on Cavanaugh appear to have been strongly influenced by the tales and legends of King Arthur.  Steer clear of Camellot though - it is a silly place.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cavanaugh上的命名惯例似乎深受亚瑟王传说与传奇的影响. 不过要避开Camellot——那是个愚蠢的地方.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cayuga was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cayuga在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ceará was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Ceará 在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cebalrai is a border world, and its surface has the scars of numerous battles between the Combine and the Commonwealth to show for it.  The atmosphere is thin, but breathable.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cebalrai是一个边境世界，其表面布满了联合体与共同体之间无数次战斗留下的疮痍. 大气稀薄，但可以呼吸.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ceiba was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Ceiba是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Celano is a warm temperate planet with ample water sources apparently settled at some point in the early 3000s. Despite the plentiful water, the vicious storm systems that occur frequently on the world have made survival a challenge.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Celano是一颗水源充足的暖温带行星，显然在3000年代初的某个时候有人定居. 尽管水源充沛，但频繁肆虐该星球的猛烈风暴系统使生存成为一项挑战.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Celebes was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Celebes在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Celentaro is one of the core Taurean planets first colonised around 2700.  Like most Taurean planets, it is mostly self-sufficient, and not particularly notable for anything.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Celentaro是金牛的核心行星之一，最初于约2700年殖民. 与大多数金牛行星一样，它基本自给自足，并无特别值得一提之处.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Centavido was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Centavido是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cephi is a currently uninhabited planet, with little known about it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cephi是一颗目前无人居住的行星，人们对它知之甚少.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ceram was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Ceram在统一战争结束后的某个时间点、于星际联盟时代被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: \"Cerberus Lives!\". System was colonized prior to the end of the Age of War. A regional capital and the most heavily industrialized planet within the Outworlds Alliance. See the \"Treaty of Cerberus\", year 2585
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: "刻耳柏洛斯长存！"。该星系在战火时代结束之前被殖民。它是外域联盟内的一个区域首府，也是工业化程度最高的行星。参见2585年的"刻耳柏洛斯条约"

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cerignola was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cerignola是在统一战争结束后的星盟时代某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cerillos is one of the so-called \"Southwestern Worlds\", an association of three worlds in the Free Worlds League. These agrarian worlds have a unique culture descended from North American Indian and Hispanic peoples.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 塞里略斯是所谓"西南世界"之一，那是自由世界联盟中三颗行星的联合体。这些农业世界拥有一种源自北美印第安与西班牙裔民族的独特文化。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: During the Star League era, the planet Cerulean was the site of a research facility dedicated to finding new water purification technologies.  While much of this research has been abandoned over the years, it continues on a smaller scale to this day.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时代，Cerulean行星曾是一座致力于寻找新型水净化技术的研究设施所在地. 尽管多年来这项研究的大部分已被放弃，但它至今仍以较小规模继续着.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ceuta was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Ceuta在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Chaffee system is the location of at least one habitable world and as at 3095 was an independent system located in the Deep Periphery.  Little is known about it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Chaffee system是至少一个宜居世界的所在地，并且截至3095年，它是位于深空外围的一个独立星系. 人们对它知之甚少.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The thin atmosphere and vivid sunsets here inspired artists from all the Terran colonies... before being utterly forgotten and abandoned.  With no atmosphere to speak of, some of the ruins still show signs of habitation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这里稀薄的大气层和绚丽的日落曾启发了来自所有地球殖民地的艺术家……直到这里被彻底遗忘并遭废弃. 由于几乎谈不上有什么大气，一些废墟至今仍显现出有人居住的痕迹.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Chagos is a fairly self-sufficient planet, with a relatively peaceful history.  The planet is primarily water, however it is dotted with numerous small islands with quite fertile soil, formed by the planets extensive vulcanic action.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Chagos是一个相当自给自足的星球，历史相对和平. 该星球主要被水覆盖，但点缀着众多小岛，这些小岛由这颗星球广泛的火山活动形成，拥有相当肥沃的土壤.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Chahar worked hard to bring corporations to the planet, and by 3025 it had succeeded. Not only is it the home of Dobless Information Services, but Trellshire Heavy Industries built a weapons plant near its capital city.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Chahar努力将企业引入这颗行星，到3025年时已成功. 这里不仅是Dobless Information Services的总部所在地，Trellshire Heavy Industries还在其首府附近建造了一座武器工厂.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Chaine Cluster is a collection of 7 stars in a very close proximity - Turpin, Corell, Aeryn, Alnabog, Hillburg, Brekke, and Dark Mist.  While it has had several colonisation attempts, the area is mostly inhabited by pirates.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Chaine Cluster是由7颗距离非常近的恒星组成的集合——Turpin、Corell、Aeryn、Alnabog、Hillburg、Brekke和Dark Mist. 虽然曾有过数次殖民尝试，但该地区大部分居民是海盗.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A somewhat anomalous little planet in the middle of Federation space, Chakachamma is actually a moon orbiting a gas giant which is in the outer edge of the habitable zone of its class A star.  The result is a icy planet with widely varying temps.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Chakachamma是联邦星域中部一颗略显异常的小星球，实际上它是一颗卫星，环绕着一颗气态巨行星运行，而这颗气态巨行星位于其A型恒星宜居带的外缘. 其结果是一颗温度变化剧烈的冰封星球.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A tropical world, Chalouba is known for its large generally hostile insects, and constant rumors of a Lostech cache hidden during the days of the Star League by the 9th Army and the XVIII Corps.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个热带世界，Chalouba以其体型巨大且通常具攻击性的昆虫而闻名，并且一直有传言称，在星际联盟时期，第九集团军和第十八军藏匿了一处失落科技储藏库.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A recent Federated acquisition from the 4th Succession War, Chamdo has a cool temperate climate suitable for agriculture, and high mountains filled with minerals.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Chamdo是第四次继承战争中联邦新近吞并的星系，拥有适宜农业的凉爽温带气候，以及蕴藏丰富矿产的高山.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Champadanga is an icy world, where temperatures reach up to 150°C. Whilst it is rich with raw materials under the ice, the only settlements are those in sheltered chasms powered and heated by enormous Star League era steam generators.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Champadanga是一颗冰封世界，温度可达150°C. 尽管冰层下蕴藏着丰富的原材料，但唯一的定居点位于受遮蔽的峡谷中，由星际联盟时代的巨型蒸汽发电机供电和供暖.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This cold and rocky world is choked by silt and ash in the air from the constant volcanic activity. Inhabitants live in hab-spheres, emerging only to work in the extensive mines or research the local silicon-based life forms.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这个寒冷的岩质星球塞满了持续性火山活动带来的泥沙和火山灰. 居民在球型居住舱中生活，只在广阔的矿山中工作，或研究当地的硅基生命时出现.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Chandler and its orbital moon Bing are home to a thriving financial sector, once a major part of the Combine. Financial transponders are often dispatched from here to nearby worlds to ensure regulatory compliance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Chandler及其轨道卫星Bing是蓬勃发展的金融部门的所在地，这里曾是联合体的重要组成部分. 金融应答器经常从这里被派往附近世界，以确保监管合规.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Chanute has a strange past. Once settled by religious pilgrims during the Exodus, it became a God Cult when one of the self proclaimed leaders thought he could order the tides back. He could not.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Chanute有着一段离奇的过往. 大迁徙期间，这里曾由宗教朝圣者定居，后来却变成了一个神教，只因其中一位自封的领袖以为自己能喝令潮汐退去. 他做不到.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Not many people have heard of Chapineria, but almost everyone in the Combine wears one of their reknown trillion unit export rugged shoes and boots.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 没有多少人听说过Chapineria，但联合体里几乎每个人都穿着他们那著名的、出口量达万亿双的耐用鞋靴.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Massive planetwide forests cover this oxygen rich tropical world, a veritable breadbasket if ever there was one.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 广袤的全球性森林覆盖着这颗富氧的热带世界，若世上真有粮仓，那便是此地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An almost uninhabitable dustball that was gifted to Tibetan pilgrims during the age of Exodus, Charity remains barely habitable to this day. The Combine operate a large prison complex here for undesirables.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个几乎无法居住的尘球，在出埃及时代被赠予西藏朝圣者，Charity至今仍勉强可居住. 联合体在这里运营着一座大型监狱综合体，用于关押不受欢迎的人.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Recently settled after the Fourth Succession War, Charleston is a small mining colony set up amongst a large mountain range.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 第四次继承战争后不久才有人定居，Charleston是一个建立在大山脉中的小型采矿殖民地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Charleywood was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Charleywood在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An arable world with bands of temperate climate across the planet. Bottles of Chateau are exported across the Lyran Commonwealth, and include some of the finest wines in the Inner Sphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一颗可耕种的星球，整个星球分布着温带气候带. Chateau瓶装酒出口到整个天琴共同体，其中包含内天体最优质的葡萄酒.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Chatham is home to a number of major manufacturing concerns both on the surface of the world and in orbit. Centuries of manufacturing have tainted the atmosphere, causing it to have some of the worst air in the entire Inner Sphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Chatham是众多大型制造企业的所在地，这些企业既位于行星表面，也位于轨道上. 数个世纪的制造活动污染了大气，使这里的空气在整个内天体中都属于最糟糕之列.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Chaumont was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Chaumont在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Chaville was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Chaville是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Chebanse system was colonized at some point during the First Exodus from Terra, and is a dangerous and icy world. The dangers mean nothing to the brave Chebanse, who often free climb glaciers or swim in the sub arctic waters with fanged wildlife.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Chebanse星系在第一次从泰拉向外大迁徙期间的某个时候被殖民，是一个危险且冰封的世界. 危险对勇敢的Chebanse人来说不值一提，他们常常徒手攀爬冰川，或是在满是长着尖牙的野生动物的亚北极水域中游泳.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Chengdu was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Chengdu于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Colonised shortly before the Age of War, Chenier is a nondescript planet notable only for some truly ancient ruins, and a large research complex devoted to studying them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在战争时代前不久被殖民，Chenier是一颗平平无奇的行星，唯一值得注意的是若干极其古老的遗迹，以及一座专门用于研究这些遗迹的大型研究设施.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Chennai was little more than a communications outpost and refueling point for the Capellans, and as the Succession Wars ground on, even that role stopped being worthwhile, and the world was abandoned to pirates and other criminals.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 金奈仅仅是卡佩拉人的通讯前哨和燃料补给点，随着继承战争的长期持续，就连这点价值也渐渐丧失，最终这颗星球被遗弃，落入了海盗和其他罪犯之手.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Overrun by Yakuza and otherwise unremarkable is probably the best way to describe Cheriton.  Then again that could be said for most Combine planets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 被极道肆虐，除此之外平平无奇，大概是对Cheriton最恰当的描述. 不过话说回来，大多数联合体星球都可以这么说.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Chertan is water-poor but mineral rich. It was a significant manufacturing center during the Star League Era but has declined over the last few centuries due to both a decline in interstellar trade and frequent raids from the Lyran Alliance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Chertan缺水但矿产丰富. 在星际联盟时代，它曾是一个重要的制造中心，但由于星际贸易的衰退以及天琴联盟的频繁袭击，在过去的几个世纪里已经衰落.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Chesterton was the capital of one of the earliest interstellar states to form in the Inner Sphere, the Chesterton Trade League and remains an important administrative world even to this day.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Chesterton曾是内天体中最早形成的星际国家之一——Chesterton贸易联盟——的首都，至今仍是一个重要的行政星球.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Chhaprauli was colonized during the Star League era by mining concerns looking to cash in on the planet's easily accessible germanium and iridium. The mining boom ended along with the Star League and the planet has been marginal ever since.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 恰帕劳利在星盟时代由矿业公司殖民，他们想利用该行星易于开采的锗和衣获利。采矿热随星盟一同结束，此后该行星一直处于边缘地位。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Elements of the 211th Jump Infantry Division were stranded here for awhile after their JumpShip sprung a helium leak centuries ago, leaving valuable Star League technology on the icy surface.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 第211跳跃步兵师的部分部队在几个世纪前因他们的跃迁舰发生He泄漏而在此滞留了一段时间，并在冰封的地表上留下了宝贵的星际联盟科技.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Chichibu's first settlers were wiped out by a virulent strain of smallpox. Since HPG communication hadn't been invented at the time, the rescuers and medical aid for these settlers arrived too late. Since then, nothing exciting has happened here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 秩父最早的定居者被一种致命的痘病毒消灭。由于当时尚未发明超脉冲通讯，为这些定居者准备的救援与医疗援助来得太迟。此后，这里再没发生过什么激动人心的事。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Chillon was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Chillon在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Chilung system was colonised during the First Exodus from Terra and was an independent system prior to being incorporated into the Free Worlds League at some point during the Age of War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Chilung星系是在从泰拉出发的第一次大迁徙期间被殖民的，并且在战争时代的某个时候被并入自由世界联盟之前，一直是一个独立星系.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Chimpaw was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Chimpaw在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Colonised at some point prior to the Reunification War, the aging structures of Chinmen Tao reflect the lack of support the world receives from the rest of the Draconis Combine. Many citizens resort to joining the DCMS in order to escape their world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Chinmen Tao在统一战争之前的某个时期被殖民，其老化的建筑反映出这个世界从天龙联合其他地区获得的支援何等匮乏. 许多公民为了逃离自己的星球，只得加入天龙联合军.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An otherwise bleak world, Chirala still bears the marks of warfare from half a millenia ago when the Star League marshalled their forces upon the world before their strike against the Outworlds Alliance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Chirala是一个在其他方面都荒凉的世界，但仍留有五百年前战争的痕迹，当时星际联盟在向外世界联盟发动打击之前，曾在此星球集结兵力.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally settled as a mining colony, Chirikof IV exported germanium to Galax well into the thirty-first century. As expansion efforts along the Taurian border grew, Chirikof became more and more important as a travel stop. Ships and crews use Chirikof as a base station during their explorations, which stimulated the Federated Suns' leadership to build space stations and permanently station military forces there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 奇里科夫IV最初作为采矿殖民地被定居，直到三十一世纪仍向加拉克斯出口锗。随着沿陶里安边界的扩张努力增长，奇里科夫作为旅行落脚点越来越重要。舰船与船员在探索期间以奇里科夫为基地，这促使联邦太阳领导层在那里建造太空站并常驻军事力量。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled originally as Chisholm, the planet was renamed as Elgin in honour of Captain Edward Elgin who defended the world against the Free Worlds League in 2878. Most recently it became the capital of the short lived Tikonov Free Republic, whose mark many buildings still bear.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初作为Chisholm定居，这颗行星后来更名为Elgin，以纪念在 2878 年抵御自由世界联盟、保卫该世界的Edward Elgin上尉. 最近，它成为短命的Tikonov自由共和国的首都，许多建筑至今仍带有其印记.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Chita was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Chita是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Chitwan was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Chitwan在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Choex was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Choex是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A minor and unimportant system deep in Davion space, the Cholame system was colonized at some point during the First Exodus from Terra. A Battle of Cholame, six week fight between AFSS and DCMS fleets with more than 200 warships destroyed in total on both sides, took place in 2790 at this otherwise unremarkable system.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cholame星系是戴维恩星域深处一个次要且不起眼的星系，在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间的某个时候被殖民. 2790年，在这个原本平平无奇的星系爆发了Cholame战役，这是AFSS与DCMS舰队之间为期六周的战斗，双方共有超过200艘战舰被摧毁.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The infamous world of Chorley, known mainly for its production of ration packs amongst Combine troops, is a bleak world that harvests fungi to fill its nutritional needs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 臭名昭著的Chorley星球主要因生产供联合体部队使用的口粮包而闻名，这是一个荒凉的世界，靠采集真菌来满足自身的营养需求.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Chota was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Chota是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Choudrant system was colonized during the First Exodus from Terra and by the end of the Age of War had been incorporated into the Federated Suns.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Choudrant星系在第一次从泰拉向外大迁徙期间被殖民，到战争时代末期已被并入恒星联邦.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Chouli was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Chouli在统一战争结束后的某个时候于星际联盟时代被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Christiania was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Christiania在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The aerospace weaponry produced on Chukchi by Maxell Metals are considered be essential to the defense of the Commonwealth, though the citizens of Chukchi III are far from pleased to be the ones supplying it. Heavy pollution from the industrial activities on the surface ensure there is a low level of discontent amongst the population at all times.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Maxell Metals在Chukchi生产的航空航天武器被认为对共同体的防御至关重要，尽管Chukchi III的公民远不乐意成为供应这些武器的人. 地表工业活动造成的严重污染，使得民众中始终弥漫着低度的不满情绪.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Chupadero in the modern day is highly loyal to the Combine, seemingly to make up for its origins as an Age of War prison colony. The locals pride themselves on being able to repair and use equipment many would have scrapped decades ago.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 如今的Chupadero对天龙联合体极为忠诚，似乎是为了弥补其作为战争时代监狱殖民地的出身. 当地人以能够修理并使用许多人在几十年前就会报废的装备为荣.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Ciampino system was colonized during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War. Relatively unpopulated, its chief exports are rare fungi and spores used within the pharmaceutical industry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Ciampino星系是在统一战争结束后、星际联盟时代被殖民的. 该星系人口相对稀少，其主要出口产品是用于制药业的稀有真菌和孢子.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cielo is a System that was Recently brought into the Bigger Picture. Though not much is Known about it on Starmaps, there might be a Lot of Potential in this Planet.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cielo是一个最近才被纳入更大格局的星系. 尽管星图上对其知之甚少，但这颗行星可能蕴藏着巨大的潜力.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cilvituk was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cilvituk在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Cimeron system was colonized during the Star League era after the end of the Reunification War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cimeron星系是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代被殖民的.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The second settlement of Ciotat, built upon the ruins of the first settlement that was destroyed in the age of war, is home to many deep boreholes built to harvest the raw materials contained within the icy permafrost. Seismic activity on the planet makes mining dangerous but also ensures a ready supply of new rich deposits.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Ciotat的第二座定居点建在战争时代被摧毁的第一座定居点的废墟之上，这里有许多深钻孔，用于开采蕴藏在冰封永久冻土中的原材料. 星球上的地震活动使采矿十分危险，但也确保了新的富矿藏源源不断.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Circe system is the location of a habitable world, Circe I, and is located in the Deep Periphery region. The Circe system consists of a G2Ia class primary orbited by four worlds
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Circe system是宜居世界Circe I的所在地，位于深空外围区域. Circe system由一颗G2Ia级主星和环绕它的四颗行星组成.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Circinus IV is the capital of the Circinus Federation. Has two moons named Bronco and Raxx. The Capital city is called Clayborne Remembered. C. J \"Bob\" McIntyre is name of their \"president\"
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 奇尔奇努斯IV是奇尔奇努斯联邦的首都。它有两颗卫星，名为野马和拉克。首府城市叫"克莱伯恩纪念城"。C·J"鲍勃"·麦金泰尔是他们"总统"的名字

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cirebon is home to a large chemical industry that imports rare earths from Alula Australis, which feeds its nascent aerospace and computer industries.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cirebon拥有庞大的化学工业，从Alula Australis进口稀土，这些稀土供给其初生的航空航天和计算机产业.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Claxton's industry consists of heavy industrial mines throughout its rich crystalline fields. Smaller settlements subsist of the mining and export industries that have arisen here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 克拉克斯顿的工业由遍布其丰富水晶矿田的重工业矿场构成。较小的定居点靠这里兴起的采矿与出口产业维生。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Claybrooke is a wealthy industrial and agricultural world. Ruled by a military dictatorship installed by Marik intelligence operatives, the world has become increasingly aligned with the Duchy of Andurien.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 克雷布鲁克是个富裕的工农业星球. 该地由马里克情报人员扶植的军政府统治，已经越来越向安杜瑞恩公国看齐.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Named after the great prairies located upon the world, Clearfield offers mostly flat terrain ideal for pastoral farming.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Clearfield因该星球上广阔的大草原而得名，其地形大多平坦，非常适合畜牧业.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Colonised by the Rim Worlds Republic during the Star League era, Clermont produces substantial electronics used in heavy machinery across the Commonwealth.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时代由边缘世界共和国殖民，Clermont生产大量电子产品，供整个共同体的重型机械使用.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled during the early days of human colonization, Clinton is probably best known for being the home of Snord's Irregulars, and the impressive museum of historical artifacts they have amassed over the past several decades.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 克林顿在人类殖民早期被定居，最为人所知的可能是斯诺德非正规军的驻地，以及他们过去几十年间积累起来的令人赞叹的历史文物博物馆。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Clipperton has one of the few active manufacturing centers of Dropships and Jumpships remaining in the Inner Sphere. The colony itself largely exists to support this industry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Clipperton拥有内天体仅存的少数仍在运作的降落飞船和跳跃飞船制造中心之一. 殖民地本身在很大程度上就是为了支持这一产业而存在.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Clovis system was colonized during or shortly before the Age of War and by the end of the era had been incorporated into the Federated Suns. After that planet was conquered twice during First and Third Succession Wars by Draconis Combine but was liberated by AFFS after a short period of occupation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Clovis星系在战争时代期间或之前不久被殖民，到该时代结束时已被并入恒星联邦. 此后，该行星在第一次和第三次继承战争期间两次被天龙联合体征服，但在短暂占领后被AFFS解放.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Zhaomaon system was colonised in the Star League era, but abandoned during the Third Succession War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Zhaomaon星系在星际联盟时代被殖民，但在第三次继承战争期间被废弃.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cogdell is a world possessed of considerable quantities of potable water, flourishing forests and rich farmland was settled by a group of convicts who were extorted to the world by a Periphery world. Colonists were able to survive and were absorbed by Federated Suns before Third Succession War. Capital city: Hangman's Death.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 科格德尔是一颗拥有相当数量可饮用水、繁茂森林和肥沃农田的世界，由一群被某个外缘世界敲诈流放到此的罪犯定居。殖民者得以存活下来，并在第三次继承战争之前被联邦太阳吸收。首府城市：绞刑之死。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The largest industry on Cohagen during the Star League era was salt mining. The huge salt plains that cover the world were so large that they were recognizable from space. The salt plains were also incredibly flat leaving vast swathes of unbroken terrain covering the planet.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时代，Cohagen上最大的产业是盐矿开采. 覆盖这颗星球的巨大盐原面积如此之大，以至于从太空中都能辨认出来. 这些盐原还极其平坦，使得大片连绵不断的地形覆盖着整个星球.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The northern continent of Cohay was heavily wooded and prone to raging forest fires during dry seasons. During the Star League era it was common for the Ninth Avalon Hussars, as the local garrison, to deploy to help fight the forest fires.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cohay的北部大陆森林茂密，在旱季很容易发生肆虐的森林大火. 在星盟时代，作为当地驻军，第九阿瓦隆骠骑兵团经常出动协助扑救森林大火.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once a shining jewel of the Federated Suns, Colchester was devastated during the First Succession War leaving lasting ecological damage.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Colchester曾是恒星联邦的一颗璀璨明珠，但在第一次继承战争中遭到毁灭，留下了持久的生态破坏.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Recently settled after the Fourth Succession War, Colchis is a small agricultural colony set up amongst a water world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Colchis是在第四次继承战争后不久才被殖民的，是一个建立在水世界中的小型农业殖民地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled as part of the Rim Worlds Republic, the world was seized by the Lyran Commonwealth in 2775. Coldbrook mainly exports machinery adapted for low temperatures to nearby worlds thanks to its industrial base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为边缘世界共和国的一部分被殖民后，该星球于2775年被天琴共同体夺取. 得益于其工业基础，Coldbrook主要向附近世界出口经过低温适配的机械.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cole Harbour became famous during the Reunification War as the location of the Star League Defense Force headquarters of the task force assigned to conquer the Magistracy of Canopus, and was one of the locations where massive vaults of Star League equipment were found, contributing to the richness of the planet.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cole Harbour在统一战争期间因作为被指派征服船底自治区的特遣部队的星际联盟防卫军总部所在地而闻名，并且是发现大量星际联盟装备储藏库的地点之一，这为这颗星球的富饶作出了贡献.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the major trading ports between the Lyran Commonwealth and the Free Worlds League, Colfax is a cosmopolitan metropolis.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为天琴共同体与自由世界联盟之间的主要贸易港之一，Colfax是一座国际化大都市.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Colia is a breadbasket world that has been settled since the time of the First Exodus. Although invaded during the First Succession War, it avoided the devastation that came with most conquests at that time.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Colia是一个粮仓星球，自第一次大迁徙时期以来便已有人定居. 尽管它在第一次继承战争期间遭到入侵，却避开了当时大多数征服所带来的毁灭.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Colinas is a prairie like world that has been settled since the time of the First Exodus. Agricultural exports are its main source of economy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Colinas是一个类似草原的世界，自第一次大迁徙时期以来就有人定居. 农产品出口是其经济的主要来源.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This system is uninhabited, but contains two fairly promising worlds for colonization.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 此星系无人居住，但拥有两颗颇具殖民前景的行星.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A, hot, dry world which is nearly uninhabitable near the equator, Colmar's only reason for existing as a colony is its impressive quantities of mineral and chemical resources, buried under its silicate crust.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 科尔马是一颗炎热干燥、赤道附近几乎无法居住的星球，它之所以成为殖民地，唯一原因是其硅酸盐地壳下埋藏着数量可观的矿物与化学资源。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Coloma is a dry world that has been settled since the time of the First Exodus. Although invaded during the First Succession War by the Draconic Combine, its civilian populace rose up against the invaders and assisted in the liberation of their world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Coloma是一个干旱世界，自第一次大迁徙时期起就有人定居. 尽管在第一次继承战争期间遭到天龙联合体入侵，但其平民奋起反抗入侵者，并协助解放了自己的世界.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Colorado was historically the world with the richest germanium deposits in the entire of the Federated Suns. This led to extensive strip mining that slowly transformed the planet into an ecological disaster. Nowadays deposits are becoming more and more scarce.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Colorado在历史上曾是整个恒星联邦中锗矿藏最丰富的星球. 这导致了大规模的露天开采，慢慢将这颗行星变成了一场生态灾难. 如今，矿藏正变得越来越稀少.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Columbine is a desert mining world, dominated by equatorial rocky deserts and dry-weather grasslands in the temperate zone. Valuable deposits of rare earth elements and fissile materials make the inhospitable world a viable colony.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 哥伦拜恩是一个沙漠矿业星球，以赤道地区的戈壁和温带地区的干旱草原为主. 稀土元素和裂变材料的宝贵矿藏使这颗不适宜居住的星球成为一个切实可行的殖民地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mining operations in this unimaginatively-named system are coordinated from Gulf Breeze Station in the asteroid belt, but a ground colony does exist on the fifth planet. LosTech prospectors can sometimes be found here, excavating centuries-old ruins.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在这个名字毫无想象力的星系中，采矿作业由小行星带中的Gulf Breeze Station进行协调，但第五颗行星上确实存在一个地面殖民地. 这里有时能发现失落科技勘探者，他们在发掘数百年前的废墟.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Conakry's colonization in 2614 was made possible by advances in terraforming technology, the effects of which have mostly stuck despite the Star League's fall. The locals claim to have the best jollof rice in the Inner Sphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 科纳克里于2614年的殖民得益于地球改造技术的进步，其效果在星盟覆灭之后大多仍然保留。当地人声称拥有内天体最好吃的乔洛夫饭。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Despite initial Lyran influence during the First Succession War, Concord has been a staple of the Free Worlds League for centuries, supplying nearby worlds with much needed medical and agricultural supplies.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 尽管在第一次继承战争期间最初受到天琴影响，Concord数百年来一直是自由世界联盟的中坚，为邻近星球提供急需的医疗和农业补给.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Conley's Patch was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 康利地块是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中灭亡。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Previously the home of the 17th Star League Defense Fleet, the orbital drydocks and shipyard remain... but in a state of disrepair.  While a prime candidate for a refurbished Star League shipyard, the ruins remain untouched and thick with rust.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这里曾是第17星际联盟防卫舰队的母港，轨道干船坞和造船厂依然存在……但已年久失修. 尽管这里是翻新为星际联盟造船厂的上佳之选，这片废墟却依旧无人触碰，锈迹厚重.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Initially colonised and part of the Capellan Confederation for centuries whilst maintaining good trade links with nearby worlds, during the Third Succession War the planet overthrew its government and joined the Free Worlds League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该行星最初被殖民，并作为卡佩拉邦联的一部分长达数百年，其间与邻近星球保持着良好的贸易联系；在第三次继承战争期间，该行星推翻了其政府并加入了自由世界联盟.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Most of Conroe is covered by glaciers and ice flats, with civilization existing in the taigas near the equator or pockets of geothermal warmth. It hosts frequent military training maneuvers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Conroe的大部分区域被冰川和冰原覆盖，文明存在于赤道附近的泰加林或地热温暖地带. 这里经常举行军事训练演习.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Constance was colonised towards the end of the Reunification War, and maintained a Star League garrison until the final days of the Star League. It's industrial base mainly consists of automotive and mining equipment manufacturers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 康斯坦斯在统一战争末期被殖民，并维持了一支星际联盟驻军直到星际联盟最后的日子。其工业基础主要由汽车与采矿设备制造商构成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: By 2890 the world was marked as associated with the short lived \"Duchy of Don't\", though by 3022 it was no longer in the maps
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 到2890年，这颗行星被标记为与短命的"唐特公国"有关联，而到3022年它已不再出现在星图上

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Conwy was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Conwy是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cooperland was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cooperland是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争期间因战火而消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Coopertown was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Coopertown在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某时被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Coraines system was either colonised by the Outworlds Alliance during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Coraines星系要么是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被外域联盟殖民的.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Corbeanca is often described as a tax haven, due to its lax administrative control and rumours of knock backs. Tourism remains high though, with vast resorts located on its many shores.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Corbeanca常被称为避税天堂，因为其行政管控宽松，且有回扣传闻. 不过，旅游业依然兴旺，众多大型度假胜地遍布其许多海岸.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cor Caroli is a mineral rich world featuring an even more mineral rich asteroid belt in close orbit. Despite the constant presence of a Lyran 'Mech Regiment on the planet, constant raids have degraded the planets mining capability significantly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 猎犬座α是一颗矿产丰富的世界，其近轨道上还有一条矿藏更丰富的小行星带。尽管该行星上常驻着一个莱兰机甲团，持续不断的袭击仍显著削弱了它的采矿能力。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Founded and named after the Corwin Diverse Agricultural Group, a 22nd-century corporation (now long defunct), Cordiagr has been a bountiful breadbasket for Capella and other nearby worlds for eight centuries.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cordiagr由Corwin Diverse Agricultural Group创立并以其命名，该集团是22世纪的一家公司（现已消亡已久）；八个世纪以来，Cordiagr一直是卡佩拉及其他邻近世界丰饶的粮仓.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An often contested world by the Umayyad Caliphate over the centuries, Nueva Castile reclaimed Córdoba after capturing BattleMech technology in 2850.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 数个世纪以来，Córdoba一直是乌玛雅王朝频繁争夺的星球；在2850年获得战斗机甲技术后，新卡斯蒂利亚收复了Córdoba.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Corella system was colonized during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the St. Ives Mercantile League prior to the formation of the Capellan Confederation in the mid-twenty-fourth century becoming a breadbasket world and a trading hub for the region.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Corella星系在第一次从泰拉进行的大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民，并在24世纪中叶卡佩拉联盟成立之前曾是圣艾夫斯商业联盟的成员，成为该地区的粮仓世界和贸易中心.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Home to defense contractor Hollis Industries, Corey is a heavily industrialised world which has been the target of substantial attacks in previous Succession Wars. An industrial recovery is underway, whilst the threat of warfare ensures that the world is heavily defended.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 国防承包商Hollis Industries的所在地，Corey是一个高度工业化的世界，在以往的继承战争中一直是大量攻击的目标. 工业复苏正在进行中，而战争威胁确保该世界处于重兵防御之下.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Corfu was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Corfu于统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某时被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The gem caves of Coriscana are a wonder that brings rich tourism to the world, which is otherwise unremarkable. A black market in rare crystals has emerged in recent years.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Coriscana的宝石洞穴是一处奇观，为这个在其他方面平平无奇的世界带来了繁荣的旅游业. 近年来，稀有水晶的黑市已然兴起.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Star League's plan to terraform Cork to fully habitable status was meant to take about 300 years. The destruction of the Succession Wars ensured Cork would revert to its desolate state. Only dusty artifacts remain.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星盟把科克改造为完全宜居行星的计划原定耗时约三百年。继承战争的破坏使科克注定退回荒凉状态。只剩下蒙尘的遗物。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Initially settled by the Taurian Concordat, Corodiz was conquered centuries ago by the Capellans in a particularly brutal campaign which included civilian massacres and torture. Its position as a crossroads between three powerful states makes it politically unstable.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 科罗迪兹最初由金牛协约国殖民，几个世纪前，经由一场特别残酷的战役而被卡佩拉人征服，这场战役中有平民遭到屠杀和折磨. 科罗迪兹的位置处在三个强国间的十字路口上，这使它在政治上很不稳定.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Coromodir is the center of power of the Aurigan government. Two habitable worlds house nearly three billion people, and at the heart of Coromodir 6 is the vast Taurian fortress that serves as both capital and last bastion of defense. Both House Arano and House Espinosa consider Coromodir their ancestral home.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 科罗摩迪尔是御夫座政府的权力中心. 两颗宜居星球定居着近30亿人口，而在科罗摩迪尔6号的核心则是巨大的金牛要塞，它既用做首都，也用作最后的防御工事. 阿拉诺家族和埃斯皮诺萨家族都将科罗摩迪尔视为他们的母星.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Coromodir is the center of power of the Aurigan government. Two habitable worlds house nearly three billion people, and at the heart of Coromodir 6 is the vast Taurian fortress that serves as both capital and last bastion of defense. Both House Arano and House Espinosa consider Coromodir their ancestral home.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 科罗摩迪尔是御夫座政府的权力中心. 两颗宜居星球定居着近30亿人口，而在科罗摩迪尔6号的核心则是巨大的金牛要塞，它既用做首都，也用作最后的防御工事. 阿拉诺家族和埃斯皮诺萨家族都将科罗摩迪尔视为他们的母星.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Coromodir is the center of power of the Aurigan government. Two habitable worlds house nearly three billion people, and at the heart of Coromodir 6 is the vast Taurian fortress that serves as both capital and last bastion of defense. Both House Arano and House Espinosa consider Coromodir their ancestral home.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 科罗摩迪尔是御夫座政府的权力中心. 两颗宜居星球定居着近30亿人口，而在科罗摩迪尔6号的核心则是巨大的金牛要塞，它既用做首都，也用作最后的防御工事. 阿拉诺家族和埃斯皮诺萨家族都将科罗摩迪尔视为他们的母星.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Corridan IV was a keenly-sought colony world, with an ecosystem that was perfect for humans and their crops, with one small exception - The water supply was filled with lethal levels of heavy metals and a bacteria that would make every living plant or animal on the world toxic to humans. Eventually new water filtration technology was discovered that turned Corridan into a rich world. It's main exports are still from Water Pure Industries.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 科里丹IV曾是一颗备受追捧的殖民世界，其生态系统对人类及作物都完美适宜，只有一个小例外——水源中充满了致命浓度的重金属，以及一种会让世界上每一种动植物都对人类有毒的细菌。最终人们发现了新的水过滤技术，把科里丹变成了一颗富裕的世界。其主要出口仍来自净水工业公司。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Corsica Nueva is unremarkable, except that it is home to a vast asteroid belt, with a Star League era asteroid base named Mizutoshi which is under the control of the Seimeiyoshi-rengo, the Draconis Combine's federation of gangs which operates a thriving black market.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 新科西嘉本身并无特别之处，只是它拥有一片辽阔的小行星带，其中有一座星际联盟时代的小行星基地，名为水户，目前由清明吉联合（Seimeiyoshi-rengo）控制——这是龙脉联合体各帮派的联合组织，经营着兴旺的黑市。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Corydon system was colonized during the First Exodus from Terra and had been incorporated into the Federated Suns by the end of the Age of War. Captured by DCMS in 2789, it was liberated again by AFFS in 2806 during first major counter-offensive against the Draconis Combine in First Succession War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Corydon星系在第一次从泰拉向外大迁徙期间被殖民，到战争时代结束时已被并入恒星联邦. 2789年，该星系被天龙联合体军队占领；2806年，在第一次继承战争中针对天龙联合体的首次大规模反攻期间，又被恒星联邦武装部队解放.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cosenza is known mainly for its beautiful planetary rings, that are visible at all times during the day on its otherwise inhospitable surface.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cosenza主要因其美丽的行星环而闻名，在它那原本不宜居住的地表上，这些行星环白天始终可见.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Cotocallao system was settled at some point during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was an independent system within the Capellan Zone prior to the formation of the Capellan Confederation in the mid-twenty-fourth century and conquered by AFFS in 2864.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cotocallao星系在第一次从泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民，并在二十四世纪中叶卡佩拉邦联成立之前是卡佩拉区内一个独立星系，于2864年被AFFS征服.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Coudoux was home to a Star League Defense Garrison during the last days of the Star League, which makes the world a prime target for treasure hunters.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟的最后岁月里，Coudoux曾是星际联盟防卫驻军的驻地，这使该星球成为寻宝者的首要目标.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Cosenza system was at some point during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was an independent system within the Capellan Zone prior to the formation of the Capellan Confederation in the mid-twenty-fourth century. Was conquered by Federated Suns during Second Succession war.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cosenza星系在第一次泰拉大迁徙期间或之后的某个时间点，并且在二十四世纪中叶卡佩拉邦联成立之前，是卡佩拉区域内的一个独立星系. 第二次继承战争期间被恒星联邦征服.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Courchevel is a heavily mined planet, with large plains broken up by massive rifts. One such plain is the Graveyard, a vast arid plain with rock formations shaped like gravestones.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Courchevel是一颗被大规模开采的星球，广阔的平原被巨大的裂谷分割. 其中一片这样的平原名为“墓地”，是一片广袤干旱的平原，遍布形似墓碑的岩层.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Courtney was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Courtney在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Coventry is a major industrial world and has served as the administrative capital of a province within the Lyran Commonwealth.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Coventry是一颗主要的工业星球，并一直作为天琴共同体内一个行省的行政首府.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Covington system was colonized during the First Exodus from Terra and was a founding member of the Crucis Pact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Covington星系在第一次从泰拉向外大迁徙期间被殖民，并且是克鲁西斯公约的创始成员.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Coyle was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Coyle在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cranston was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cranston是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Crawford was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Crawford是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Crawford's Delight was founded by the aforementioned magnate Crawford, who uncovered massively mineral deposits within the mountains. One famous mountain is the Gatshadow, a vast black obsidian mountain that towers above the city of Westruun.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 克劳福德之乐由前述大享克劳福德建立，他在群山中发现了庞大的矿藏。其中一座著名的山是盖特影子山，一座巨大的黑色黑耀石山，高耸于西特伦城之上。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cree was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cree是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The vast jungles of Crellacor are home to savage alien hunters and other primitive beings. Its great jungles are also known as \"Fortress Green\" thanks to the defensive possibilities they offer.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 克雷拉科尔广袤的丛林是野蛮外星猎手和其他原始生物的家园。它的大片丛林也被称为"绿色堡垒"，因为它们提供了防御上的种种可能。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cresson was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cresson在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Crestoblus was founded during the age of war, and was one of the worlds conquered by the Federated Suns during the War of Reunification. It escaped damage for the most part and has remained a solid member of the Outworlds Alliance for centuries.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Crestoblus建立于战争时代，是统一战争期间被恒星联邦征服的星球之一. 它大体上未受破坏，数百年来一直是外世界联盟的坚定成员.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Vaj system, better known by its main planets name of Crevedia, is located within the Donegal province.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Vaj星系，更常以其主行星Crevedia之名而闻名，位于Donegal省内.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Crichton was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Crichton是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Crimond was discovered as the result of a misjump by the Gak's Revenge, a JumpShip. The team found a world filled with rare gemstones, minerals and ores but with a toxic soil. Never the less, over centuries the population of Crimond has become wealthy and rival any within the Commonwealth.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 克里蒙德是因跃迁舰“加克复仇号”的一次跳跃失误而被发现的。搜索队发现了一颗满是稀有宝石、矿物与矿石、但土壤有毒的星球。尽管如此，几个世纪以来克里蒙德的居民已变得富有，可与联邦内任何人匹敌。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Home to major manufacturers and a Star League era megaplant owned by StarCorps Industries, Crofton supplies the AFFS with a large portion of their materiel.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Crofton是多家主要制造商以及StarCorps Industries旗下的一座星际联盟时代巨型工厂的所在地，为AFFS供应其很大一部分物资.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cronulla was colonised during the first exodus from Terra, and joined the short lived Sian Commonwealth prior to the formation of the Capellan Confederation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cronulla在第一次从泰拉向外大迁徙期间被殖民，并在卡佩拉邦联成立之前加入了短暂的锡安共同体.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Crossing system was colonized during or shortly before the Age of War and was a planet suitable for agriculture but poor on minerals. Planet border position in Draconis March is a cause of heavy military traffic in the system.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: The Crossing星系在战争时代期间或之前不久被殖民，是一颗适宜农业但矿产贫乏的行星. 该行星在天龙边区的边境位置是该星系军事交通繁忙的原因.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The colony on Cruz Alta became self sufficient after the Reunification War, and has grown into a thriving community of landowners.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cruz Alta上的殖民地在统一战争后实现了自给自足，并已发展成为一个繁荣的土地所有者社区.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cryfder was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cryfder是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Csesztreg was settled for its vast expanses of heavy metals. These metals were a key component of industry, but it wasn't until the Jamerson-Ulikov water purification technique was perfected that this world could be safely inhabited.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 切斯特雷格因其广袤的重金属矿藏而被殖民。这些金属是工业的关键组成部分，但直到贾默森-乌里科夫净水技术完善之后，这颗行星才能安全居住。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Csomad was colonised after the Age of War, and was briefly a member of the Taurian Concordat prior to the reunification war. Mostly self sufficient, the world spends most of its resources on imported food.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Csomad在战争时代之后被殖民，并在统一战争之前短暂地成为金牛协约国的一员. 该星球基本自给自足，却将大部分资源用于进口粮食.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ctesiphon was the site of a surface trading post located close to the jump point in the Deep Periphery, though little more is known about it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Ctesiphon曾是深空外围中靠近跃迁点的一处地表贸易站的所在地，但除此之外人们对它知之甚少.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Culmia was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Culmia在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled after the Reunification War by the widows of those lost during said war, Cumberland still maintains its matriarchal traditions. The societal tenets of Cumberland are designed in a way that children inherit their mother's surname.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 坎伯兰在统一战争之后由那场战争中失去丈夫的寡妇们建立，至今仍保持其母系传统。坎伯兰的社会准则规定，孩子继承母亲的姓氏。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Cumbres system was colonized during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the Protectorate of Donegal, prior to the formation of the Lyran Commonwealth in the mid-twenty-fourth century.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cumbres星系是在第一次从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民的，并且在24世纪中叶天琴共同体成立之前，曾是多尼戈尔保护国的一员.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Curaumilla is home to numerous ice wine vineyards, which are exported across the Free Worlds League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Curaumilla拥有众多冰酒葡萄园，其冰酒出口至自由世界联盟各地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cursa had long been abandoned as too marginal a colony to sustain, but played a role in the war between ComStar and the Free Worlds League. The world was used as bait for a trap, chosen because of its lack of strategic value.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 长期以来，科尔萨因为太过边缘，难以维持而被遗弃，但是它在通讯之星和自由世界联盟的战争中发挥了作用. 这颗星球曾被选作陷阱的诱饵，因为它缺乏战略价值.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once named Cussar, the world was renamed Barlow's Folly after a band of insurgents sabotaged DCMS forces for decades during the First Succession War and was then lampooned when finally defeated.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这颗行星原名库萨尔，在第一次继承战争期间一伙叛军在此数十年间持续破坏DCMS部队，最终被击败并遭到嘲讽之后，被改名为巴洛的愚行。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alien bacteria and vegetation on Cusset has made settlement difficult here, but pharmaceutical companies continue to pour money into research and development here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cusset上的外星细菌和植被使这里很难建立定居点，但制药公司仍不断在这里投入资金进行研发.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Custozza was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Custozza在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cygnus has a distinctive feature: a flower dubbed the 'tundra witch', whose pollen has hallucinogenic properties. As a consequence the local megafauna - a kind of native caribou - is prone to massive stampedes in springtime.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 天鹅座有一个独特之处：一种被称为"冻原女巫"的花，其花粉具有致幻性。因此当地的巨型动物群——一种原生驯鹿——在春天容易爆发大规模狂奔。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Colonised centuries ago for its rich mineral deposits, the planet was devastated during the Succession Wars which has caused severe climate changes. The population has diminished rapidly as the ice age advances.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 几个世纪前，这里因其丰富的矿藏而被殖民，但这颗星球在继承战争期间遭到严重破坏，导致了剧烈的气候变化. 随着冰河期推进，人口迅速减少.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Liao, named after the Capellan namesake, has served as a capital for many years until its devastation during the Succession Wars reduced it to a backwater. It still maintains its importance to the Capellan Confederation however.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Liao，以卡佩拉的同名者命名，多年来一直是首府，直到继承战争期间的毁灭使其沦为穷乡僻壤. 然而，它对卡佩拉联盟的重要性依旧未减.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cyrenaica is home to numerous native truffle farms, which are exported across the Draconis Combine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cyrenaica拥有众多原生松露农场，出产的松露出口至天龙联合体各地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Cyrton is known for being lawless, and a thriving pharmaceutical trade.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Cyrton以无法无天和繁荣的制药贸易而闻名.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Czarvowo is known for its kilometers of mudflats and its mudskiff racing.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Czarvowo以其绵延数公里的泥滩和泥地滑行艇竞速而闻名.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Dabih was originally settled sometime during the twenty-fifth century by Muslim colonists. After ekeing out a hard existence, technological progress allowed resource extraction of the petroleum under the surface, which increased quality of life for all.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Dabih最初是在二十五世纪的某个时候由穆斯林殖民者定居的. 在艰难维持生计之后，技术进步使得能够开采地表下的石油资源，从而提高了所有人的生活质量.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Dagda system consists of an F9V class primary named \"Tuath\" orbited by eight worlds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 达格达星系由一颗名为"图阿斯"的F9V级主星及环绕它的八颗行星组成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Dagda (LC) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Dagda (LC) 在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被定居，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Despite the harsh climate on Dahar IV, the plentiful deposits of ores and minerals attracted colonists to the planet. Local engineers create some of the most advanced mining equipment found anywhere in the Inner Sphere, equipment which is then licensed to other worlds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 尽管Dahar IV的气候严酷，但丰富的矿石和矿物矿藏仍吸引殖民者来到这颗行星. 当地工程师制造出内天体中任何地方都能见到的一些最先进的采矿设备，随后这些设备被授权给其他世界.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This frozen world is made habitable by the constant geothermal activity that convulses its surface. This also makes it a source of highly valuable radioactive ores, and the Magistracy keeps a garrison on the planet to protect its interests there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这个冰封星球由于持续的地热活动而变得适宜居住，这种地热活动也使其地表剧烈震动. 这也使它成为极其重要的放射性矿石的来源，自治区在这颗行星留有一支守备部队，以保护在那里的利益.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Dainmar Majoris
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 丹马尔马约里斯

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled after the Reunification War, Dalcour served as the headquarters of the XII Corps until the final days of the Star League. Caches are rumoured to be hidden amongst the icy hills.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 统一战争后有人定居，Dalcour曾一直是第十二军的总部，直到星际联盟的最后岁月. 据传，储备库藏匿在冰封丘陵之间.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Dalian was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Dalian在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: During the Star League era, Dalkeith was home to billions. The First Succession war devastated the planet, killing billions and leaving the atmosphere still polluted today.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时代，Dalkeith是数十亿人的家园. 第一次继承战争摧毁了这颗行星，导致数十亿人死亡，并使其大气至今仍处于污染之中.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Dalmantia was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Dalmantia在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Dalton is a water rich planet with stormy weather, and a merit based government allowing excellence in every craft.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Dalton是一颗水资源丰富、风暴频发的星球，其政府以功绩为基础，使各行各业都能精益求精.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Damevang was the site of numerous battles during the First Succession War, though only limited nuclear weapons were deployed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Damevang在第一次继承战争期间是众多战斗的发生地，不过只部署了有限的核武器.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Damian was one host to a Star League Defense Garrison, which has led numerous historians and treasure seekers to the planet to search for caches. None have been found however.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Damian曾是一支星际联盟防御驻军的驻地，这吸引了众多历史学家和寻宝者前往该行星搜寻秘藏. 然而，至今尚未发现任何秘藏.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The thick forests of Danais allow for a thriving lumber industry upon the world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Danais茂密的森林使得这颗星球上的木材产业蓬勃发展.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Deneshmand is home to numerous agricompounds that utilise Inner Sphere technology to boost their yields.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Deneshmand是众多农业园区的所在地，这些园区利用内天体技术来提高产量.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ninety percent of the population of Dania lives an agricultural lifestyle maintained by technology of an equivalent to that found on Terra in the late eighteenth  century, a consequence of the heavy influence of the Omniss philosophy within the New Delphi Compact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Dania百分之九十的人口过着一种农业生活方式，这种生活方式由相当于泰拉十八世纪晚期技术的科技维持，这是新德尔斐盟约国Omniss哲学产生重大影响的结果.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Daniels is home to numerous pharmaceutical companies that harvest the psychedelic hallucinogenic fauna found on the surface.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Daniels拥有众多制药公司，它们采集在地表发现的致幻迷幻动物群.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Danli was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Danli是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Dansur was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Dansur是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Dante is the center of the Omniss movement that rejects all non-essential technologies. Communications are sporadic with the system however, and ship traffic suggests more population than what is officially reported.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Dante是Omniss运动的中心，该运动拒绝一切非必要技术. 然而，与该星系的通信时断时续，而舰船往来表明其人口比官方报告的更多.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Danxian is a relatively unimportant industrial base, though its lax trading laws means certain goods may be easier to acquire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Danxian是一个相对无关紧要的工业基地，不过其宽松的贸易法规意味着某些商品可能更容易获取.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Danzig is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League, exporting goods to other Hanseatic worlds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Danzig是构成被称为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家的星球之一，向其他汉萨同盟星球出口商品.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Orbital bombardment of Daol during the First Succession War destroyed its climate in a planet-wide firestorm. The ejecta from the mass driver strikes formed a dangerous field of debris in orbit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在第一次继承战争期间，对道尔的轨道轰炸产生了全球性的风暴性大火，摧毁了星球的气候. 质量加速器攻击产生的抛射物在轨道上形成了危险的碎片区域.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Dar-es-Salaam is the center of the Muslim faith within the Lyran Commonwealth.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Dar-es-Salaam是天琴共同体境内穆斯林信仰的中心.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Darius produces mid tech boats and yachts for export to nearby worlds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Darius生产中等科技船只和游艇，用于出口到附近星球.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US:
The Dark Nebula is not a system, but an area of space—a vast cloud of ionized gas near the Periphery border of the Trellshire Province of Lyran Commonwealth's Tamar Pact (later Clan Jade Falcon occupation zone), roughly between the systems of Somerset, Apollo, and Wotan. The coordinates given designate the nebula's approximate center point.

The nebula interferes with sensors and communications and gives off intense radiation. There are several white and red dwarf stars in the nebula, as well as seventeen known pulsars.

A Star League naval base, Camelot Command, was hidden in a hollowed-out asteroid around one of the red dwarf stars. After the facility's rediscovery in 3050, \"Dark Nebula\" was often used to refer to Camelot Command or the specific star within the nebula that the facility orbits, though this is technically incorrect.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN:
