Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Koury是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某时被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Kowloon was a part of the Apollo Province of the Rim Worlds Republic and was conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth during the 2773-2775 Republic-Commonwealth War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Kowloon曾是边缘世界共和国的阿波罗省的一部分，并在2773-2775年的共和国-共同体战争期间被天琴共同体征服.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Krakatau was an early mining and industrial colony, but heavy pollution poisoned the air and heated up the climate to uninhabitability. By the fall of the Star League, the colony was importing all its food, and stopped being economically viable.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 喀拉喀托是个早期的矿业和工业殖民地，但严重的污染使空气有毒，使气候升温，变得不适合居住. 在星际联盟垮掉之前，这个殖民地的所有食品都来自进口，经济也无法自持.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Kreller was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Kreller是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A lightly industrialised world, Alshain Weapons does maintain a small repair facility on the surface.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在这个轻度工业化的世界上，Alshain Weapons确实在地表维持着一个小型维修设施.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era, Krievci is known for its raw fish delicacies.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Krievci于星际联盟时代由天琴共同体殖民，以生鱼佳肴闻名.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A hidden colony until the Reunification war, Krimari is home to numerous manufacturing complexes from Detroit Consolidated MechWorks and Novis AT-H.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在统一战争之前，Krimari一直是一个隐秘的殖民地；如今，这里是Detroit Consolidated MechWorks和Novis AT-H众多制造综合体的所在地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Krin is a prosperous world along the Capellan/League border. The 4th Tau Ceti Lancers have recently been redeployed to the world to recover after suffering significant losses against House Davion forces over the last decade.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 克林是卡佩兰与联盟边界上一颗繁荣的星球。第4金牛座塞提枪骑兵最近被重新部署到该星球，以在近十年对戴维恩家族部队的惨重损失后恢复元气。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Kristiandsund was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Kristiandsund在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era, Krung Thep is known for its street food.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时代由天琴共同体殖民建立，Krung Thep以其街头小吃闻名.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ksabi operates at a mid 20th century level of development. It is the only one of twelve in the Axumite Providence to be governed as a theocracy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Ksabi的发展水平相当于20世纪中叶. 在阿克苏姆天命国的十二个星系中，它是唯一一个实行神权统治的.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Kublenz was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Kublenz于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled as an science outpost as part of the Principality of Rasalhague, it remained sparsely populated until the Star League era where upon a proper colony was established.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为Rasalhague公国的一部分，该地最初是作为科学前哨站建立的；在星际联盟时代建立正式殖民地之前，它一直人口稀少.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Free World League during the Star League era, Kujari is known for its narcotic plant life.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Kujari在星际联盟时代由自由世界联盟殖民，以其麻醉性植物而闻名.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Kumqwat was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Kumqwat在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Kupang (CC) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Kupang (CC) 在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Kupang (RW) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Kupang (RW) 是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期建立的殖民地，但在继承战争的战事中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled during the Exodus from Terra, the initial colony remained independent for over a century before being annexed into the Draconis Combine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在从泰拉大迁徙期间建立定居点，这个最初的殖民地保持独立了一个多世纪，随后被并入天龙联合体.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: During the era of the Terran Alliance, Ares was one of the founding members of the Capellan Co-Prosperity Sphere negotiated by the Capellan ruler Jurdan Aris between 2220 and 2225. In exchange for the continued free and open exchange of information with Capella, Kurragin and the other nations of the pact - which included Ares and Bandora - would come to the defense of Capella if it found itself under attack from hostile parties.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在泰拉联盟时代，Ares是卡佩拉Co-Prosperity Sphere的创始成员之一，该共荣圈由卡佩拉统治者Jurdan Aris在2220年至2225年间谈判促成. 作为与拉佩拉继续保持自由、开放信息交流的交换条件，Kurragin以及该协定的其他成员国——包括Ares和Bandora——将在拉佩拉遭到敌对势力攻击时前来保卫卡佩拉.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Colonized during the Second Exodus, Kurvasa accepted refugees from across Capellan space. Its canyon-cities are sprawling and riotous with different cultures and traditions, and farming on the fertile mud-flats supports all 700 million residents.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 库尔瓦萨是在二次大迁徙期间被殖民的，它接受了来自卡佩拉太空的难民. 其峡谷城市连绵不绝，杂糅了不同的文化和传统，而肥沃的泥滩农田则支撑着全部7亿居民的生活.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled at the start of the Star League era, Kutludugun is known for its raw fish and sugared potato delicacies.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Kutludugun在星际联盟时代初期有人定居，以生鱼和糖渍土豆等美味佳肴而闻名.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Recent investments in Kuzuu have modernised many of the old buildings and the population has swelled due to mass immigration from nearby worlds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最近对Kuzuu的投资使许多老旧建筑实现了现代化，而来自附近世界的大规模移民也让人口激增.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth in the early years of the Star League, Kvistgard is a world rich with nitrates.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟早期，天琴共同体在Kvistgard建立了殖民地，这是一颗富含硝酸盐的星球.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Many of the industrial areas on Kwamashu are powered by the highly unstable radioactives that are found in the planet's crust.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 夸马舒的许多工业区都由该行星地壳中发现的极不稳定放射性物质供电。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Kwangchowwang was a part of the Apollo Province of the Rim Worlds Republic and was conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth during the 2773-2775 Republic-Commonwealth War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Kwangchowwang曾是边缘世界共和国阿波罗省的一部分，并在2773-2775年的共和国-联邦战争期间被天琴共同体征服.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Defiance Industries is the sole major exporter on Kwangjong-ni, utilising salvaged machinery from an underwater facility that was destroyed during the Amaris Civil War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Defiance Industries是Kwangjong-ni上唯一的主要出口商，利用从阿马里斯内战期间被摧毁的水下设施中打捞出的机械.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Kyeinnisan is better known as the Gambler's World. Within the many lavish, smoke filled casinos and gambling halls, every game of chance known to man can be found as well those willing to bet it all for a chance at wealth.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 凯尼尼桑更以"赌徒世界"闻名。在许多奢华、烟雾缭绕的赌场与赌厅里，人类所知的一切博彩游戏都能找到，还有那些愿意为一线致富机会押上一切的人。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: During the Star League era, Kyrkbacken was a heavily industrialised world. Unfortunately during the Second Succession War, it was devastated and now has reverted to a mostly agrarian economy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时代，Kyrkbacken曾是一个高度工业化的世界. 不幸的是，在第二次继承战争期间，它遭到严重破坏，如今已倒退为以农业为主的经济.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: La Blon is primarily a water world, with popular beach resorts on the 3 island landmasses on its surface. One of its moons, Ivanov, also supports a large mining operation. La Blon saw a great deal of fighting during the 3020's.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 拉布隆主要是一颗水世界，其地表3块岛屿陆地上有很受欢迎的海滩度假地。它的一颗卫星伊万诺夫也支撑着一处大型采矿作业。拉布隆在3020年代经历了大量战斗。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Labouchere was settled during the golden age of the Star League, becoming self sufficient within decades.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Labouchere在星际联盟的黄金时代被殖民定居，并在数十年内实现了自给自足.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Labrea was settled during the golden age of the Star League, becoming self sufficient within decades.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Labrea于星际联盟的黄金时代被殖民，并在几十年内实现了自给自足.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lacadon was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lacadon是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民定居的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lackhove was one of seven worlds settled by colonists from the Rim Worlds Republic between 2334 and 2338 as an attempt by Maxwell Rowe to create a buffer zone between the Republic, the Draconis Combine and the Tamar Pact.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lackhove是2334年至2338年间由来自边缘世界共和国的殖民者定居的七个世界之一，这是麦克斯韦·罗试图在该共和国、天龙联合体和塔玛协定之间建立缓冲区的一次尝试.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lackland is almost entirely oceanic apart from a few archipelagoes. The local population finds life on this quiet planet idyllic, despite the chronic inability of any industry to turn a profit.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lackland除少数几处群岛外几乎全是海洋. 尽管任何产业都长期无法盈利，当地居民仍觉得在这颗宁静星球上的生活宛如田园诗般美好.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Laconis is a cold, watery world, and between the chilly temperatures and the annual hurricane season, most of the 75 million inhabitants live below-ground. Taurus Majoris Mining is the world's largest employer, but many other smaller industrial firms have relocated to the prosperous world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 拉科尼斯是一颗寒冷多水的世界，介于低温与年度飓风季之间，7500万居民大多生活在地下。陶里安大矿是该世界最大的雇主，但许多其他较小的工业公司也迁到了这颗繁荣的世界。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled during the Exodus from Terra, the initial colony remained part of the Tamar Pact for decades before joining the Commonwealth.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在从泰拉大迁徙期间建立定居点后，最初的殖民地数十年来一直是Tamar协定的一部分，后来才加入共同体.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lahti was settled during the golden age of the Star League, becoming self sufficient within decades.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lahti在星际联盟的黄金时代被殖民，并在几十年内实现了自给自足.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Laiaka's atmosphere requires some basic filtration systems in order to be breathed by humans, but its vast oceans are teeming with life. Most of the planet's population are thus fishermen and kelp farmers and provide food to other nearby worlds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 莱亚卡的大气需要一些基础过滤系统才能供人呼吸，但它广袤的海洋生机勃勃。因此该行星大部分人口是渔民与海带养殖者，为附近其他世界供应食物。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: La Ligua was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: La Ligua在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lamar was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lamar在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Large earthquakes caused by Lambrecht's sun were ironically the reason for the heavy fortification of the world. Castle Brian's inner cores were designed with this level of seismic activity in mind, contributing to their sturdiness.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 讽刺的是，正是兰布雷希特的恒星引发的大地震，成了该星球被重兵设防的原因。布莱恩城堡的内核在设计时就考虑了这种级别的地震活动，这也成就了它们的坚固。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Labrea was settled towards the end of the Exodus from Terra, but did not become self sufficient until the Star League era.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Labrea是在从泰拉大迁徙接近尾声时被殖民的，但直到星际联盟时代才实现自给自足.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lamu (Tunlmar 2822+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lamu（Tunlmar 2822+）是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally settled as part of the Marik Commonwealth, it became a garden world amidst the Free Worlds League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初作为马里克共同体的一部分被殖民，后来成为自由世界联盟中的一颗花园世界.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The first colony of Lancaster was founded by Scots-Irish refugees fleeing from the war between the Stewart Confederation and the Free Worlds League in 2305. Unfortunately for the colonists, they were forced to relocate to the world of Loxley.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lancaster的第一座殖民地由苏格兰-爱尔兰难民建立；他们在2305年为躲避斯图尔特邦联与自由世界联盟之间的战争而逃亡. 不幸的是，这些殖民者被迫迁往Loxley星球.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lande was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lande在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Landfall system was colonized at some point during the reign of the Star League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Landfall星系在星际联盟统治期间的某个时候被殖民.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The surface of Landmark is largely barren rock outside of the sheltered coastal valleys. This is due to the constant, planet-encircling windstorm scouring higher elevations. As a result, the planet is notably secure, and many industrial concerns conduct secret research there.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 兰德马克地表除了沿海受到遮蔽的山谷外，大部分都是贫瘠的岩石. 这是由于环绕行星的风暴不断侵蚀着高海拔地区. 因此，该行星非常安全，许多工业公司在那里进行秘密研究.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: According to the latest Interstellar Expeditions maps, Landrum is located in the anti-spinward region of the Deep Periphery between the Vul Rift and the Cygnus Loop.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 根据最新的星际探险组织星图，Landrum位于Vul Rift与Cygnus Loop之间的深空外围逆旋区域.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: During the final years of the Star League, Land's End served as the base of operations for the 310th Dragoon Regiment of the Star League Defense Force. It is quite desolate on the Periphery of known space.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星盟的最后几年，陆斯恩德充当星盟防卫部队第三一〇龙骑兵团的作战基地。它位于已知空间的外缘，相当荒凉。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Langhorne was originally a part of the Timbuktu Province of the Rim Worlds Republic and was conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth during the 2773-2775 Republic-Commonwealth war.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Langhorne原本是边缘世界共和国的Timbuktu行省的一部分，并在2773-2775年的共和国-共同体战争期间被天琴共同体征服.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Laong was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Laong在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lapida II was settled for its vast mineral wealth. The centuries of removing and refining those minerals and ores, combined with the lax environmental protection mandated by the Combine government, have created a nearly toxic atmosphere. Despite this the world remains a major manufacturing world with industrial complexes that create a variety of military and civilian equipment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lapida II因其丰富的矿产资源而建立殖民地. 几个世纪以来对这些矿物和矿石的开采与精炼，再加上Combine政府强制推行的宽松环境保护政策，共同造就了近乎有毒的大气. 尽管如此，这个世界仍是一个主要的制造业世界，其工业综合体生产各种军用和民用装备.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Landfall system was colonized at some point towards the end of the Exodus from Terra. Much of its industry was destroyed during the First Succession War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Landfall星系是在从泰拉大迁徙接近尾声的某个时候被殖民的. 它的许多工业在第一次继承战争期间被摧毁.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Larsha is a linchpin of Capellan control over the Rimward portion of the Sian Commonality. Over a billion inhabitants call the pleasant Terran world home, living in four major metropolises, and they're defended by a 'Mech battalion headquartered in the planet's extensive fortifications.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 拉尔沙是卡佩兰对罗罗共同体核心方向部分控制的关键。超过十亿居民以这颗宜人的类地世界为家，住在四座大都市里，并由一个驻扎在该行星庞大防御工事中的机甲营防守。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Last Chance system was settled by the Rim Worlds Republic during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War. It's name refers to two previously failed expeditions to the system.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最后机会星系在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期由边缘世界共和国殖民。它的名字指的是此前两次前往该星系失败的远征。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Last Chance
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最后的机会

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Prisoners were forced to create the infrastructure for the colony on Last Frontier for the Draconis Combine during the Star League era.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时代，囚犯们被迫为天龙联合建造Last Frontier殖民地的基础设施.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The heavy jungles of Lastpost are filled with rare fauna and flora, much of which is used in the planets burgeoning pharmaceutical industry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lastpost的茂密丛林中遍布珍稀动植物，其中许多被用于该行星蓬勃发展的制药业.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Las Tunas was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Las Tunas在统一战争结束后的某个时候、星际联盟时代被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An unremarkable world, it was used as a logistics base by the II Corps of the Star League Defense Force during Operation Union Hold.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一颗平平无奇的行星，在联合坚守行动期间曾被星际联盟防卫军第二军用作后勤基地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by colonists from the Sian Commonwealth, it was annexed into the Capellan Confederation centuries ago.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由来自锡安共同体的殖民者定居，数个世纪前被并入卡佩拉邦联.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by refugees during the Age of War, Launam is a mostly pacifistic society.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战争时代，Launam由难民定居，是一个大体上奉行和平主义的社会.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A pirates love this place, so be careful. Local militia is a garbage too. A wild place, I would say.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 海盗们很喜欢这个地方，所以小心点. 当地民兵也是一群废物. 要我说，这地方很野蛮.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星盟时代由莱兰联邦开拓定居。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally part of the Federation of Skye, it became part of the Lyran Commonwealth when it formed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它最初是Skye联邦的一部分，在天琴共同体成立时成为其一部分.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Layover is a rich world with a toxic atmosphere that is also site of numerous Star League era manufacturers, such as Kallon Weapon Industries, Quikscell Company and Kodiak Incorporated.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Layover是一颗富饶的星球，大气有毒，同时也是众多星际联盟时代制造商的所在地，例如Kallon Weapon Industries、Quikscell Company和Kodiak Incorporated.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Leamington was a self sufficient independent world for centuries before joining the Federated Suns.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Leamington在加入恒星联邦之前，数百年来一直是一个自给自足的独立星球.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Basically a giant rock in space, Le Blanc was settled by miners looking for mineral wealth. Just barely enough atmosphere existed to allow the miners to breathe without a respirator.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 基本上是太空中一块巨大的岩石，Le Blanc由寻找矿产财富的矿工定居. 那里的大气勉强足以让矿工无需呼吸器就能呼吸.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The first colony on Lee was founded by settlers from New Macao, and Lee was a member of the Capellan Hegemony during the four decades the Hegemony existed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lee上的首个殖民地由来自New Macao的定居者建立，在卡佩拉霸权存续的四十年间，Lee一直是该霸权的成员.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era due to rich crystalline deposits.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 天琴共同体在星盟时代因蕴藏丰富的晶体矿藏而在此建立定居点.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Leh was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Leh在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Federated Suns during the Star League era due to rich nitrate deposits.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时代，因拥有丰富的硝酸盐矿藏，恒星联邦在此建立了殖民地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Leiston was an independent colony before being annexed by the Draconis Combine in the Age of War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Leiston曾是独立殖民地，直到战争时代被天龙联合体吞并.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The population of Lemnos lives an agricultural lifestyle maintained by technology of an equivalent to that found on Terra in the late eighteenth or early nineteenth century, a consequence of the heavy influence of the Omniss philosophy within the Compact
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lemnos的居民过着农业生活方式，其维持技术相当于泰拉在十八世纪末或十九世纪初的技术，这是盟约国内部Omniss哲学影响深重的结果.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Free Worlds League during the Star League era due to rich nitrate deposits.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星际联盟时代，自由世界联盟因这里丰富的硝酸盐矿藏而在此建立了定居点.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Prisoners were forced to create the infrastructure for the colony on Leoben for the Draconis Combine during the Star League era.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时代，囚犯们被迫为天龙联合体在Leoben上的殖民地建设基础设施.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: León is a mineral rich cool world that has changed hands often over the centuries.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: León是一个矿产资源丰富、气候寒冷的星球，数百年来曾多次易手.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Free Worlds League during the Star League era due to rich crystalline deposits.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时代，自由世界联盟因其丰富的晶体矿藏而在此殖民.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The jungles of Lesalles are renowned for the size of their trees where their average height is measured around 150 meters. It is in and within these jungles that the Lesallian Mailsloth is found.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lesalles的丛林以其树木的巨大体型而闻名，平均高度约为 150 米. 正是在这些丛林之中，才能找到Lesallian Mailsloth.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled only for its galactic location, Les Halles is a frozen world that acts as a waypoint for nearby worlds. Only a narrow strip of land around the equator is free of ice, while the rest of the world is covered in glaciers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Les Halles仅因其银河位置而被定居，是一个冰冻世界，作为附近世界的航路中转站. 只有赤道周围一条狭窄的陆地带没有冰，而星球其余部分都被冰川覆盖.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era due to an abundance of arable land.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由于可耕地充足，在星际联盟时代由天琴共同体殖民定居.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lesnovo is part of the Rim Commonality, a small power bloc in the Free Worlds League. It's soils are relatively weak, but the world produces enough to feed its billions of souls.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 列斯诺沃是边缘共同体的成员，那是自由世界联盟中的一个小型势力集团。它的土壤相对贫瘠，但该星球产出足以养活其数十亿居民。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Leviathans Rest is located in the rimward region of the Deep Periphery beyond the Perses-Cepherus Cloud Complex and is one of the most distant systems from Terra to have been identified by Interstellar Expeditions.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Leviathans Rest位于深空外围靠边缘的区域，在英仙座-仙王座星云复合体之外，是Interstellar Expeditions已识别出的距离泰拉最遥远的星系之一.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Alphard Trading Corporation has a small manufacturing and repair facility on the icy world Leximon which is supplemented by Lothian light industry base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Alphard Trading Corporation在冰冷的星球Leximon上设有一个小型制造与维修设施，并由Lothian轻工业基地作为补充.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lexington served as the headquarters of the entire XXXIII Corps (Star League) during the final years of the Star League. There were also massive supply dumps storing material for the SLDF as well as a SLDF fort, Fort Ballycastle, built in the center of a vast forest made up of imported Terran trees.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lexington在星际联盟的最后几年里曾是整个第XXXIII军（星际联盟）的总部所在地. 那里还设有为星际联盟防卫军储存物资的大型补给库，以及一座星际联盟防卫军要塞——Ballycastle堡，它建在一片由引进的地球树木构成的广袤森林中央.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the founding worlds of the Capellan Confederation, Leyda served as a SLDF supply depot during the Reunification War. A pleasant water world with several major cities, it is a favored vacation spot for the wealthy and noble.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 莱达是卡佩拉联邦的创始星球之一，它在统一战争期间充当了星际联盟防卫军的补给站. 这是个拥有多个大城市的宜人丰水星球，是富人和贵族的首选度假地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Draconis Combine during the Star League era due to rich crystalline deposits.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星际联盟时代，因拥有丰富的晶体矿藏，天龙联合体在此建立了殖民地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lhasa was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lhasa在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Despite supporting sizable forests in its higher elevations, Liezen must periodically import water from offworld to feed its agricultural lowlands. It is otherwise an unremarkable world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 尽管Liezen的高海拔地区生长着大片森林，但它仍必须定期从外星输入水，以供养其农业低地. 除此之外，这是一颗平平无奇的世界.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Home to the Bashir College of Literature, the world of Lihue produces some of the finest authors in the Federated Suns.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lihue是巴希尔文学院的所在地，这里培养了恒星联邦一些最优秀的作家.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The capital city of Lima, Decatur, bears the architecture of both the Combine and Federated Suns due the world changing hands many times over its history.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lima的首府Decatur，因该星球在历史上多次易手，兼具天龙联合体与恒星联邦的建筑风格.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The frosty climate of Lindassa is inhospitable without specialist survival gear. Much of the population resides in the cities.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lindassa的严寒气候若无专业生存装备便难以生存. 大部分人口居住在城市中.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Linden was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Linden在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: After much of the initial colony was destroyed by the SLDF, the Magistracy rebuilt the capital city of Cowin in a new location.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在最初的殖民地大部分被SLDF摧毁后，Magistracy在新地点重建了首府城市Cowin.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lindsay is a hot, damp world with a thick continuous cloud layer fed by a ring of volcanic activity that nearly encircles the planet. Local farmers take maximal advantage of the short dry season to plant and harvest; in the rainy season, extensive flooding restores the rich, fertile soil.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 林赛是一个炎热而又潮湿的星球，它拥有一层厚厚的，接连不断的云层，该云层由几乎环绕着整个行星的一圈火山活动产生. 当地农民最大限度地利用了短暂的旱季进行播种和收获; 在雨季，洪水的大面积泛滥使土地恢复了肥沃.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ling was the site of the famous Deep Raid of 2987 by Lyran Commonwealth forces. This raid destroyed a new BattleMech production facility that was being built on the world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Ling是2987年天琴共同体军队发动著名“深袭”的地点. 这次突袭摧毁了该星球上正在建造的一座新型战斗机甲生产设施.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This barren, empty world is a testament to the devastation of the Succession Wars; the military installations here were bombarded from orbit, and the climate was irreparably damaged by the orbital strikes.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这颗贫瘠，空荡荡的星球证明了继承战争的毁灭性; 这里的军事设施遭到轨道轰炸，气候也因轨道打击而受到无法挽回的破坏.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled in the years leading up to the formation of the Star League by the Federated Suns, Linneus is known for its silicon manufacturies.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 恒星联邦在星际联盟成立前的数年间于Linneus建立了定居点，而Linneus以其硅制造厂闻名.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled in the years leading up to the formation of the Star League by the Draconis Combine, Linqing is known for its silicon manufacturies.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟成立前的数年间，Linqing由天龙联合体建立殖民地，并以其硅制造厂闻名.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lintz was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lintz在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lipton is a moderately prosperous world that acts as a trade hub for traffic between the two halves of the newly formed Federated Commonwealth and the Free Worlds League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lipton是一个中等繁荣的世界，充当新成立的联邦共同体两半与自由世界联盟之间往来交通的贸易枢纽.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Listowel was devastated during the Second Succession War, leaving many cities devastated over the planet centuries later.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Listowel在第二次继承战争期间遭到严重破坏，数个世纪后，该星球上的许多城市仍满目疮痍.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This ice-locked world is pierced by deep, man-made boreholes that allow geothermal heat and power to escape from the core, sustaining a bustling mining and manufacturing industry in the temperate zones created around the holes.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这颗冰封的星球被深深的人造钻井钻穿，从而使地热和地热能源从地核中泄出，它们在钻孔周围形成的温暖地带支撑着繁荣的矿业和制造业.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: During the final years of the Star League, Ljugarn was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Ljugarn曾是星际联盟防卫军一支驻军的驻地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Loburg is heavily settled, but most of its natural resources come from the second planet in the system. Named Hiburg, this planet possesses no atmosphere and crushing gravity. Despite this, workers spend several weeks there mining resources before transferring back to Loburg.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Loburg人口稠密，但其大部分自然资源都来自该星系中的第二颗行星. 这颗行星名为Hiburg，没有大气层，重力极其骇人. 尽管如此，工人们仍会在那里花上数周时间开采资源，然后再转送回Loburg.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lochmantle, a swampy world, was made habitable by massive pumping stations that reclaimed fertile, viable land from the muck. During the Second Succession War, those pumping stations were destroyed, and the colony is now slowly sinking.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 洛赫曼特尔是个湿地星球，靠大规模泵站从淤泥中开垦出肥沃，可行的陆地，而变得宜居. 在第二次继承战争期间，那些泵站遭到摧毁，而殖民地现在则在慢慢下陷.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lockdale was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lockdale是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lockton was a very inhospitable world over 40 days from the jump point that relies heavily on water imports from Oasis, one of its moons. The only landmass was home to Helios, the capital city, and was also named Lockton.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lockton是一个极不宜居的世界，距离跃迁点超过 40 天，严重依赖从其卫星之一Oasis进口水. 其唯一的陆地上坐落着首都Helios，这片陆地也被命名为Lockton.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Loeches Trade School is one of the business schools, offering practical uses rather than academic courses in business and marketing. It's Phillip Cowin Campus is renown for its alumni being some of the wealthiest in the Free Worlds League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 洛埃切斯商学院是众多商学院之一，在商业与营销方面提供实用课程而非学术课程。其菲利普·科温校区以培养出自由世界联盟中最富有的一批校友而闻名。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by colonists from Celtic nations during the Exodus from Terra, it remained independent for over a century before joining the Federated Suns.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在从泰拉大迁徙期间，来自凯尔特诸国的殖民者在此定居，它在加入恒星联邦之前保持独立了一个多世纪.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Logan Prime system was colonised during the First Succession War by refugees fleeing the conflict.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Logan Prime星系在第一次继承战争期间由逃离冲突的难民殖民.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by eccentric billionaire Euan Logan, Logan's Land was originally a hedonistic paradise.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 洛根之地由古怪的亿万富翁伊万·洛根殖民，最初是一处享乐主义天堂。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Logres was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Logres在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Loikaw was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Loikaw是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lokoja was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lokoja在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Draconis Combine  Star League era due to rich crystalline deposits.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星际联盟时代，天龙联合体因这里蕴藏丰富的晶体矿藏而在此殖民.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An extremely hospitable world according to the climate, Londerholm does have a very dense molten iron core which creates a crushing gravitational field of 150% times that on Terra.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 从气候上看，Londerholm是一个极其宜居的世界，但它确实拥有一个极为致密的熔融铁核心，由此产生了相当于泰拉的150%、令人难以承受的重力场.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lone Star was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lone Star是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居的，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Loongana is a relatively uninteresting world with a thin atmosphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Loongana是一个相对无趣的世界，拥有稀薄的大气层.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Loparri is a core world within the Outworlds Alliance. When Operation UNION HOLD began in 2581, it was the third world to be hit by SLDF forces, with countless civilians massacred.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Loparri是外域联盟境内的一个核心世界. 当UNION HOLD行动于 2581 年开始时，它是第三个遭到SLDF部队攻击的世界，无数平民惨遭屠杀.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The desert world of Lopez is an unlikely colony; however, it is the only planet on which the banth, a flying reptile very similar to Terran legends of dragons, can be found. Care, training, and conservation of these dragons forms the foundation of the planet's economy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 沙漠世界洛佩兹是个不太可能的殖民地；然而它是唯一能找到班斯的地方——一种与类地传说中的龙极为相似的飞行爬行动物。对这些龙的照料、训练与保育构成了该行星经济的基础。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The icy world of Lordinax is rumoured to have entire mountains made of iron.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 据传，冰封世界Lordinax拥有完全由铁构成的山脉.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A self sufficient world with a burgeoning mining industry. It's nearby asteroid field is full of mineral rich asteroids.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一颗自给自足的世界，采矿业蓬勃发展。它附近的小行星带满是矿产丰富的小行星。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The second planet in the badlands cluster that was colonised briefly by the Taurean Concordant.  Due to limited resources and a generally hostile environment led to the planet being abandoned.  Now its a haven for pirates.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: badlands cluster中的第二颗行星，曾被金牛协约国短暂殖民. 由于资源有限以及环境总体恶劣，这颗行星被废弃. 如今它是海盗的避风港.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lost was originally a part of the Finmark Province of the Rim Worlds Republic and was conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth during the 2773-2775 Republic-Commonwealth War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lost最初是边缘世界共和国芬马克省的一部分，并在2773-2775年的共和国-共同体战争期间被天琴共同体征服.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Kept hidden for over a century by the Taurian Concordat, Lothair first appeared on interstellar maps shortly before the Reunification War, but by that point was already a heavily-populated world with a rapidly growing industrial base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 被金牛协约国隐藏了一个多世纪后，Lothair在统一战争前不久首次出现在星际地图上，但到那时，它已经是一个人口稠密、工业基础快速发展的世界.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth, it has changed hands multiple times over the years.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由天琴共同体拓殖，多年来多次易手.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An icy, harsh world, Lothario is home to a number of dangerous species including predators that were born at the same size as an adult Kodiak bear.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lothario是一个冰冷严酷的世界，栖息着许多危险物种，其中包括一出生就与成年科迪亚克熊一样大的掠食者.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Lovinac system was a treasure trove of Star League buildings when it was reclaimed in 2784, which spurred architectural development on numerous worlds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lovinac星系在2784年被收复时是星际联盟建筑的宝库，这推动了众多星球上的建筑发展.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Loxley is the site of major manufacturing facilities belonging to Norse-Storm Technologies Incorporated and Blue Shot Weapons.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Loxley是Norse-Storm Technologies Incorporated和Blue Shot Weapons旗下主要制造设施的所在地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Fidelity Space complex in orbit of this arid world is the sole employer for many of the skilled workers on Loyalty.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 位于这颗干旱星球轨道上的Fidelity Space综合体是Loyalty上许多熟练工人的唯一雇主.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Loysville is a temperate, pleasant world largely populated by fishers, farmers and those working in the tourist industry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Loysville是一颗气候温和、宜人的星球，人口主要由渔民、农民和旅游业从业者组成.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Luanda was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Luanda在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by colonists from the Isles nations during the Exodus from Terra, it remained independent for over a century before joining the Federated Suns.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在泰拉大迁徙期间，来自群岛诸国的殖民者在此定居；该星系保持独立了一个多世纪，之后加入恒星联邦.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the earliest worlds in the Terran Alliance, it was the site of a massacre during 2244 which caused a mass depopulation until the dawn of the Star League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为泰拉联盟最早的一批行星之一，它在2244年发生了一场大屠杀，导致人口大规模减少，这种情况一直持续到星际联盟诞生.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lucknow's mining facilities, buried deep in the glacial ice that covers the planet, were lost when the geothermal power plants stopped working, and no parts or technicians were available to restore them.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 勒克瑙的采矿设施深埋在覆盖该行星的冰川中，在地热电厂停止运作、又没有零件或技师可用以恢复它们时便被废弃。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Luderitz was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Luderitz在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Turanian Transport Company, a planetary freight and passenger shipping company, has a large office here on Ludwig due to the abundant radioactive material mining industry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 图拉尼亚运输公司是一家行星货运与客运航运公司，由于放射性材料采矿业发达，它在Ludwig这里设有一间大型办事处.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era due to rich mineral deposits.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由于矿藏丰富，天琴共同体在星际联盟时代在此建立了定居点.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lübeck is one of the worlds that forms part of the Hanseatic League. There are two worlds in this system, Quarantine, and Lübeck - Quarantine is used as a customs holding point before allowing access to Lübeck.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lübeck是组成汉萨同盟的星球之一. 该星系中有两颗星球: Quarantine和Lübeck——Quarantine被用作海关滞留点，在获准进入Lübeck之前使用.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lukla was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lukla在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The rich mineral veins that run through the mudflats of Lum are a vital source of material for the burgeoning economy. A Brian Cache was found nearby, making Lum an important world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 贯穿Lum泥滩的丰富矿脉是蓬勃发展经济的重要物资来源. 附近发现了一处布莱恩储藏库，这使Lum成为一颗重要的星球.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An arctic world that was settled by the Lothian League as refugees fled the First Succession War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一颗极寒星球，当难民逃离第一次继承战争时，洛锡安联盟在此建立了殖民地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by colonists from the British Isles during the Exodus from Terra, it remained independent for over a century before joining the Free Worlds League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在泰拉大迁徙期间，来自不列颠群岛的殖民者在此定居；它保持独立了一个多世纪，之后才加入自由世界联盟.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lurgatan was once a mining colony, with deep-core boreholes to reach the fissile minerals under the crust. The cost of maintaining the colony in the thin, cold atmosphere was eventually too much for the value of the minerals, and the world is mostly abandoned.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 勒戛坦曾是个矿业殖民地，用深入地心的钻井去获取地壳之下的裂变材料. 相较矿藏的价值，在稀薄寒冷的大气下维持殖民地的成本还是太高了，于是这颗星球多半被废弃了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lushann has a semi-arctic global climate, but due to its former geologic past, it enjoys an abundance of oil deposits, of which the planet's primary industry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 卢尚拥有半北极的全球气候，但由于它过去的地质历史，它拥有丰富的石油储量，这也是该行星的主要产业。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lushun (Jibbet 3130+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lushun（Jibbet 3130+）于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Luthien, as well as being the capital of the Draconis Combine, is the state's largest industrial world, with large tracts of land devoted to huge industrial complexes.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 卢西恩既是龙脉联合体的首都，也是该国最大的工业世界，大片土地被划给巨大的工业联合体。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Luxani was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Luxani在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Luxen is one of the few worlds to have escaped the horrors of the Succession Wars. Totally untouched by the vast conflicts, Luxen is home of the Canopian Medical Sciences Research and Training Complex.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Luxen是少数几个躲过继承战争恐怖的世界之一. 完全未受这些大规模冲突波及的Luxen，是卡诺普斯医学科学研究与训练综合体的所在地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Luzerne became a favored spot for those in the Draconis Combine looking to escape the ravages of warfare that have plagued the Inner Sphere for millennia.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 对于天龙联合中那些想要逃离困扰内天体数千年的战祸的人来说，Luzerne已成为一个备受青睐的地方.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Federated Suns during the early years of the Star League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟初期由恒星联邦建立定居点.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lynchburg was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lynchburg是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星盟时代由莱兰联邦开拓定居。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lynn is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League, exporting goods to other Hanseatic worlds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lynn是构成被称为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家的诸世界之一，向其他汉萨同盟世界出口商品.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lyons is a volcanic world that supports a significant agricultural industry. The planet briefly was home to a base for the famous Kell Hounds mercenary company, but is now protected by the 17th Donegal Guards RCT.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lyons是一颗火山星球，支撑着规模可观的农业产业. 这颗星球曾短暂作为著名的凯尔猎犬佣兵团的基地所在地，但如今由第17多尼戈尔卫队团级战斗队守卫.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This former Capellan colony is spread across three tropical moons of the system's large gas giant. Each moon is independent and civil conflict between the moons makes the system a tense and dangerous place.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这个前卡佩兰殖民地散布在该星系巨大气态巨行星的三颗热带卫星上。每颗卫星各自独立，卫星之间的内战使该星系成为一个紧张而危险的地方。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Lywick (Ferreusvirgo 3130+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Lywick（Ferreusvirgo 3130+）是在统一战争结束后、星际联盟时代的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ma'anshan was originally a part of the Finmark Province of the Rim Worlds Republic and was conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth during the 2773-2775 Republic-Commonwealth War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 马鞍山原本是边缘世界共和国的芬马克省的一部分，在2773-2775年的共和国-联邦战争期间被莱兰联邦征服。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Machapuchre was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Machapuchre是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Machida was a part of the Apollo Province of the Rim Worlds Republic and was conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth during the 2773-2775 Republic-Commonwealth war.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Machida曾是边缘世界共和国阿波罗省的一部分，并在2773-2775年的共和国-共同体战争期间被天琴共同体征服.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The world was formerly known as Drekos before it was changed by the Apple Computers Interstellar company during the days of the Star League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该星球以前名为Drekos，后在星盟时期被Apple Computers Interstellar公司改名.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Brigadier Corporation has a moderately sized orbital facility above Mackenzie which produces small craft and offers jump ship repairs to those with the C-Bills to pay their rates.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 准将公司在Mackenzie上方拥有一座中等规模的轨道设施，该设施生产小型航天器，并为那些付得起其费用的C币持有者提供跃迁舰维修服务.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mackolla was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mackolla在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Draconis Combine during the Star League era.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时代由天龙联合体建立定居点.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As a core planet in the Taurian Concordat, MacLeod's Land was once devastated in the Reunification War. More recently, its Terran-like geography and distributed population has made it a budget location for holovid shoots.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为陶里安协约国的核心行星，麦克劳德之地曾在统一战争中遭到摧毁。更近些时候，它类似类地的地理与分散的人口使它成为全息影像拍摄的廉价取景地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by colonists from the British Isles during the Exodus from Terra, it remained independent for over a century before joining the Federated Suns
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在从泰拉出发的大流亡期间，来自不列颠群岛的殖民者在此定居；它保持独立了一个多世纪，之后才加入恒星联邦.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Free Worlds League during the early years of the Star League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 于星际联盟早期由自由世界联盟建立定居.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星盟时代由莱兰联邦开拓定居。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The mining colony of Madras has a thin atmosphere, but its high gravity causes air to pool in the lowlands, where the pressure makes it tolerable without specialized suits. The pooling air is moderately toxic, thanks to a concentration of particulate matter.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 马德拉斯的矿业殖民地有着稀薄的大气，可它的高引力导致空气积聚在了低地，那儿的气压不用专用着装也能忍受. 积聚的空气有一定毒性，这要归功于悬浮颗粒的聚集.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Tamar Pact before the Lyran Commonwealth began.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在天琴共同体成立之前，由Tamar Pact殖民定居.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Maharet was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Maharet在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mahone's sun is a very small point in the sky and daylight on the planet has a distinct blue tint.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 马洪的太阳在天空中只是极小的一个点，该行星的日光带有明显的蓝色调。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mahrah was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mahrah在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the three inhabited worlds of the Pleiades, Maia is the moon of a gas giant, and the gravity well of the planet has caused extensive vulcanism on the chilly, forested moon. Research and manufacturing dominate Maia's sprawling industrial cities.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为昴宿星团三颗有人居住行星之一，迈亚是一颗气态巨行星的卫星，而行星的引力井在这颗寒冷、林木覆盖的卫星上造成了广泛的火山活动。研究与制造主导着迈亚那些庞大蔓延的工业城市。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星盟时代由莱兰联邦开拓定居。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Maison was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Maison在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Maisons was a colony world settled by the Lyran Commonwealth late in the Star League era, and has had a slew of corrupt politicians.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Maisons是天琴共同体在星际联盟时代末期建立的一颗殖民星球，并且曾出现过大量腐败政客.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Malacca was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Malacca是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居的，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Maladar was one of the main trading words of the St. Ives Mercantile League until being annexed by the Capellan Confederation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Maladar曾是St. Ives商业联盟的主要贸易世界之一，直到被卡佩拉邦联吞并.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Malador Cluster is a significant astronomical feature in the anti-spinward Deep Periphery. Located a little over 1,100 light-years from Terra, the Malador Cluster is relatively close to the Vul Rift and the Deep Periphery colonies known as Landrum and Doggerbank.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Malador Cluster是逆旋向深层外围中的一处重要天文特征. 它位于距泰拉略超过1，100光年的地方，相对靠近Vul Rift以及被称为Landrum和Doggerbank的深层外围殖民地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Malaga was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Malaga在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Malagrotta system is home to a titanium-rich planetoid, the airless moon of Fontana. The system has been heavily contested nearly from the time of settlement, a dispute which helped provoke the Reunification War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Malagrotta星系拥有一颗富含钛的小行星体，即无大气的Fontana卫星. 自定居以来，该星系几乎一直饱受争夺，这场争端助推了统一战争的爆发.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Malazan was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Malazan是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Maldive is a casualty of the Succession Wars. Its position on the border of Davion and Liao space made it a frequent target for orbital strikes, and its fragile ecosystem collapsed entirely. It's now a wasteland, inhabited only by scavengers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 马尔代夫是继承战争的牺牲品。它地处达维昂与廖氏空间的边界，使其成为轨道打击的频繁目标，它脆弱的生态系统彻底崩溃。如今它是一片废土，只有拾荒者居住。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by colonists during the Exodus from Terra, it was annexed in the 26th century by the Draconis Combine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 殖民者在从泰拉出发的迁徙期间定居于此，该星系于26世纪被天龙联合体吞并.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Malibu was one of four worlds acquired by the Rim Worlds Republic in an attempt to make a heavily fortified world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Malibu是边缘世界共和国为打造一个高度设防世界而获取的四个世界之一.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Named after the scientist who saved the initial colony from disease, Mallory's World was once a lush garden world until the brutal fighting during the Succession Wars turned three of its continents into barren wastelands.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 马洛里世界以那位从疾病中拯救了最初殖民地的科学家命名，曾是一颗葱郁的花园世界，直到继承战争中的残酷战斗把它三块大陆变成荒芜的废土。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Remember The Great Exodus? Well, the Third Ceti Hussars, formed from Star League Defense Force troops, was ones who preferred to stay in the Inner Sphere. And this is their home world now.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 还记得大逃亡吗？由星际联盟防卫军部队组建的第三Ceti骠骑兵，就是那些更愿意留在内天体的人. 而这里现在是他们的母星.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Elysian world of Manaringaine is a temperate planet maintained in a pristine wilderness state. The people supported themselves mainly as hunters and gatherers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Manaringaine是一个Elysian世界，是一颗温带行星，保持着原始荒野状态. 当地居民主要以狩猎和采集为生.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Manassas is the home of a large Interstellar Expeditions exploration office, and many expedition crews form here before setting off into the void. The planet itself is a sickly yellow from orbit, due to its tainted atmosphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Manassas是Interstellar Expeditions一个大型勘探办公室的所在地，许多探险队在此组建，随后启程进入虚空. 由于大气受到污染，这颗行星从轨道上看呈病态的黄色.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Manaus was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Manaus是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mandal was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mandal是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Founded by religious separatists from Herotitus, Mandalas is a marginal agricultural world that relies on manual labor as much as industrial farming techniques. As resources dwindle, civil unrest and religious sectarianism are creating social turmoil.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 曼荼罗是由来自希罗提多的宗教分裂分子建立的，它是一个边缘农业星球，对体力劳动和工业化耕作技术同样依赖. 随着资源的减少，内乱和教派门户之见正在造成社会骚动.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星盟时代由莱兰联邦开拓定居。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Federated Suns during the Star League era.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时代由恒星联邦殖民.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The capital city named Glory of Liao sums up the world of Mandate, filled with vanity projects and aristocrats retreats.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 名为Glory of Liao的首都概括了Mandate世界，这里充斥着面子工程和贵族们的退隐之所.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mandeville was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mandeville在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被拓殖，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Manennaia was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Manennaia是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mangor was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mangor在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某时得到殖民，但在继承战争期间的战斗中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mangzhangdian has a long year with high annual variance of climate -- very hot summers and cold winters. Thanks to these extremes, the original Capellan colonial structures have long since collapsed into ruin, leaving a marginal pastoral world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 芒章店的一年非常漫长，而且一年中的气候偏差非常严重——极端炎热的夏天和极端寒冷的冬天. 由于这些极端气候的关系，最初的卡佩拉殖民地建筑物早已化为废墟，留下了一个边缘的田园星球.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mangzhangdian has a long year with high annual variance of climate -- very hot summers and cold winters. Thanks to these extremes, the original Capellan colonial structures have long since collapsed into ruin, leaving a marginal pastoral world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 芒章店的一年非常漫长，而且一年中的气候偏差非常严重——极端炎热的夏天和极端寒冷的冬天. 由于这些极端气候的关系，最初的卡佩拉殖民地建筑物早已化为废墟，留下了一个边缘的田园星球.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled during the Exodus from Terra, it was originally part of the Marik Commonwealth before the formation of the Free Worlds League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在从泰拉向外迁徙期间被殖民，在自由世界联盟成立之前，它最初是马里克共同体的一部分.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mankova is covered with dense jungles with a multitude of wildlife. The most notable species is the Conqueror Worms that can slowly digest metal by means of secreted acid.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mankova被茂密的丛林覆盖，野生动物种类繁多. 最著名的物种是征服者蠕虫，它们能通过分泌酸液缓慢消化金属.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Manksville was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Manksville在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被建立，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mannedorf has two continents; Meilen, where the capital city Zurich is located, and Schifffahrtsgesellschaft. It is a large world, largely covered by arctic plains and at one point was home to numerous SLDF caches.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mannedorf拥有两个大陆: Meilen——首都Zurich所在地——和Schifffahrtsgesellschaft. 这是一个庞大的世界，大部分被极地平原覆盖，并且曾经是众多SLDF藏匿点的所在地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Free Worlds League  during the Star League era, Manotick offers many agricultural benefits for farmers thanks to the vitae of the soils.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时代由自由世界联盟建立定居点，得益于土壤的生机，Manotick为农民提供了诸多农业优势.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Federated Suns during the start of the Star League era.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时代初期，由恒星联邦建立定居点.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Free Worlds League during the start of the Star League era.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 自由世界联盟在星际联盟时代初期于此建立殖民地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Manteno is experiencing a period of sometimes violent geologic activity which has disrupted lives and industries on the planet. Many of the wealthiest have already emigrated.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Manteno正经历一段时而剧烈的地质活动期，这已扰乱了该星球上的生活和产业. 许多最富有的人已经移居他乡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mantharaka is only marginally habitable, with barren rocky highlands and cold, arid lowlands, but the vast and easily-accessible deposits of titanium-bearing ores have made it a viable mining colony, regardless.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 曼萨拉卡勉强适宜居住，它拥有贫瘠的岩质高地和寒冷，干旱的低地. 但尽管如此，其广阔且易于开采的含钛矿床使它成为一个切实可行的采矿殖民地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Manx was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Manx是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mao was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mao是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The wide plains of Mara, with fertile soils, allow the world to produce food for many neighboring planets. This fertile soil also permits allows a wide variety of tree species to flourish.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mara广袤的平原土壤肥沃，使这颗星球能够为众多邻近行星生产食物. 这片肥沃的土壤也让多种树木得以繁茂生长.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Marantha is the fourth planet in the system and is the location of a notable military academy as well as manufacturing facilities operated by the Alliance Aerospace Group.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Marantha是该星系中的第四颗行星，也是著名军事学院以及由联盟宇航集团运营的制造设施所在地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mararn is a hot, dry world with an overabundance of deserts. Much of the population lives in sparse settlements in the more temperate areas.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mararn是一个炎热干燥的世界，沙漠过多. 大部分人口生活在较为温和地区中稀疏的定居点里.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Marathon was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Marathon在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A terrestrial style world, Marawi is often used by aerotech fighters as a training area. During the Star League era the Fourth Rasalhague Regulars were based here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Marawi是一个类地世界，常被航空航天战斗机用作训练区. 在星际联盟时代，第四拉绍哈格正规军曾驻扎于此.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Marcus is a harsh world, but one rich in heavy metal and radioactive metal ores. It was once home to the primary UrbanMech production facility, but that factory was destroyed during the Second Succession War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Marcus是一颗环境恶劣的星球，但盛产重金属和放射性金属矿石. 它曾是主要的UrbanMech生产设施所在地，但那座工厂在第二次继承战争期间被摧毁了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Marduk has the dubious honor of being the first planet to be attacked in what would become known as the Second Hidden War.  It is also home to Norse BattleMech Works, a Star League era construction facility.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Marduk有着一个并不光彩的殊荣: 它是在后来被称为第二次隐秘战争的冲突中，第一颗遭到攻击的行星. 这里也是Norse BattleMech Works的所在地，一座星际联盟时代的建造设施.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Marfik is a hot world that lacks a thick atmosphere and an ozone layer. As a result the surface of the world is constantly bombarded by radioactivity and cosmic rays. Colonists quickly set up new cities underground or under protective domes.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Marfik是一个炎热的世界，缺乏厚厚的大气层和臭氧层. 因此，这个世界的地表不断遭受放射线和宇宙射线的轰击. 殖民者迅速在地下或防护穹顶下建立了新的城市.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled during the Exodus from Terra, Mariefred was originally independent for over a century before joining the Lyran Commonwealth.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mariefred是在从泰拉大迁徙期间有人定居的，最初独立了一个多世纪，之后才加入天琴共同体.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Federated Suns during the Star League era.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时代由恒星联邦殖民.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The planet Marik was settled in 2139 by Antonin Marik acting under authority of the Terran Alliance, was the former capital of the Republic of Marik. These days it is still a wealthy world, but has been eclipsed by Atreus.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Marik行星于2139年由Antonin Marik在泰拉联盟的授权下建立定居点，曾是Marik共和国的前首都. 如今它仍是一个富裕的星球，但已被Atreus盖过风头.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Maripa was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Maripa在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Marisura was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Marisura在统一战争结束后的某个时期、星际联盟时代有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Free Worlds League during the Star League era.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星盟时代由自由世界联盟建立定居点.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The world of Marius' Tears was originally named Herculaneum. The world was renamed after Imperator Marius died in a climbing accident on Herculaneum in 3048 and was renamed by his son.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 马里乌斯之泪这颗行星原本名叫赫库兰尼姆。3048年，马里乌斯统帅在赫库兰尼姆的一次攀爬事故中身亡后，他的儿子将这颗行星改名。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the first worlds settled by the Azami, Markab is very similar to Terra's Middle East and North African regions. The land is dry and windblown, forming a single supercontinent. The economy is mainly formed from the exploitation of the petrochemicals under the desert.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为阿扎米最早定居的世界之一，马尔卡布与类地的中东和北非地区非常相似。土地干燥多风，形成一整块超级大陆。其经济主要由开采沙漠之下的石化资源构成。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled during the Star League era, during the First Succession War the planet and population was ravaged by DCCS forces until it was liberated many years later.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星盟时代有人定居，第一次继承战争期间，这颗行星及其居民遭到DCCS部队的揉躏，直到多年后才获得解放.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Marknick has only recently been marked for colonisation by settlers from the Taurian Concordat.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Marknick直到最近才被来自金牛协约国的定居者列为殖民目标.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Marlette was once the capital of the Marlette Association, a small post-Terran Alliance interstellar polity. To this day it retains its status as a Regional capital.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Marlette曾是Marlette Association的首府，这是一个后泰拉联盟时代的小型星际政体. 时至今日，它仍保留着区域首府的地位.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The name of the system comes from a bubble of interstellar dust and gas which floats nearby. Originally a scientific colony, its fortune changed with the discovery of the local Meat Tree, a citrus fruit with the same taste and consistency of cooked beef.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该星系的名字来源于附近漂浮的一团星际尘埃和气体. 它最初是一个科学殖民地，随着当地“肉树”的发现，它的命运发生了改变. 那是一种柑橘类水果，味道和口感与煮熟的牛肉相同.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Federated Suns during the Star League era due to the discovery of a local plant which can act as an aphrodisiac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时代，恒星联邦因发现一种可作为催情剂的当地植物而在此建立了定居点.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Marsalle was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Marsalle是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The world of Marshall, and nearby moon Xian, both have breathable atmospheres and livable environments, but tectonic activities render settlement dangerous.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Marshall行星及其附近的卫星Xian都拥有可供呼吸的大气和宜居的环境，但构造活动使定居变得危险.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The thick marshland that covers much of the surface of this world is where Marshdale gets its name.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 覆盖这颗星球大部分表面的茂密沼泽地，正是Marshdale得名的由来.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mas was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mas在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The self sufficient world of Masterson was part of the Capellan Commonality before the formation of the Confederation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Masterson这个自给自足的世界在邦联成立之前曾是卡佩拉共同体的一部分.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Masterton was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Masterton是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Home to a ruined Castle Brian named Wazukana Fortress, Matamoras is a desolate world after the damage taken during the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Matamoras是名为Wazukana Fortress的废墟布莱恩城堡的所在地，在继承战争期间遭受破坏后，它已成为一片荒凉的世界.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Matar was annexed by the Draconis Combine due its strategic position between Izurkun and Proserpina.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Matar因其在Izurkun和Proserpina之间的战略位置而被天龙联合体吞并.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The 3rd Jump Infantry Division often trained in the wooded areas of Matheran during the Star League era.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时期，第3跳跃步兵师经常在Matheran的林区进行训练.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The precious metals mining centeron Matsu forms the basis for much of the employment on Matsu
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Matsu的贵金属采矿中心构成了Matsu大部分就业的基础.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Matsuida hosts a large and important fishing industry. Some of the fishing vessels on-planet host prisoners who volunteer for the deadly jobs in exchange for having their sentences shortened.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Matsuida拥有庞大且重要的渔业. 该星球上的一些渔船上关押着囚犯，他们自愿从事这些致命的工作，以换取缩短刑期.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Desolate Mattisskogen once had specialized shipbuilding facilities that were bombed to the ground during the Second Succession War. There are still remnants of the base underground, in highly unstable tunnels.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 荒凉的马蒂斯库根曾经有过专业的造船设施，在第二次继承战争期间被炸为白地. 在高度不稳定的隧道里仍留有基地地下部分的遗迹.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Tri-Area Spaceport on Mauckport is home to many vices for passing transport and freighter crews.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mauckport上的三区太空港是过往运输与货运船员沉溺于诸多恶习的场所.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This harsh rocky desert world is a source of gemstones and not much else. It was annexed into the Draconis Combine at some point before the Star League era.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这个环境恶劣、岩石遍布的沙漠星球是宝石的来源，除此之外别无他物. 在星际联盟时代之前的某个时候，它被并入了天龙联合体.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mauna Loa was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mauna Loa在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled during the exodus from Terra, it remained independent for over two hundred years before finally joining the Free Worlds League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在从泰拉大迁徙期间建立定居点，此后保持独立两百多年，最终加入自由世界联盟.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mavegh was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mavegh在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Named after the renown biologist who saved the colony from starvation, Maxie's Planet is home to Maxie's Militia, a fierce light brigade.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 以一位从饥荒中拯救了殖民地的著名生物学家命名，马克西行星是马克西民兵的驻地，那是一支凶悍的轻装旅。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled during the Succession Wars by refugees seeking an escape from the conflict.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 于继承战争期间，由寻求逃离战乱的难民定居.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Maxwell is known throughout the Free Worlds League for two things: Exporting food and capable Parlimentarians. The mostly mountainous terrain makes farming the few flat areas critically important, and it also makes most land vehicles useless.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Maxwell在整个自由世界联盟中因两件事闻名: 出口粮食和拥有能干的议员. 其地形大部分为山地，这使得耕种少数平坦地区至关重要，同时也使大多数地面车辆毫无用处.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mayenne was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mayenne在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: During the Star League era, the world was chosen by DoME, Department of Mega-Engineering, as a candidate for terraforming. The extensive costs of the terraforming were greatly offset by the massive mineral wealth discovered on world as well as in the planet's two moons
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星盟时代，该世界被巨型工程部（DoME）选为地球改造的候选地。地球改造的高昂费用被该世界以及其两颗卫星上发现的庞大矿产财富大大抵消

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled during the exodus from Terra, it remained independent for over two hundred years before finally joining the Federated Suns.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在从泰拉流亡期间有人定居，此后保持独立两百余年，最终加入恒星联邦.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mazdru was never more than a scientific outpost, established to investigate the rare planetary ring system that surrounds it. Sometime in the past fifty years, the Capellans evacuated all remaining personnel and abandoned the outpost.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 马兹德鲁一直只是座科学聚落，旨在调查它周围罕见的行星环系统. 在过去五十年里的某个时候，卡佩拉人撤出了所有剩下的人员并废弃了这座聚落.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The turbulent weather patterns on McAffe have been known to create lethal storms known to the locals as Rakshasa.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: McAffe上狂暴的天气模式已知会催生致命风暴，当地人称之为“罗刹”.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Draconis Combine during the Star League era.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时代由天龙联合体建立定居点.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by independent colonists during the Exodus from Terra, the population was annexed into the Draconis Combine over a hundred years later. During the Succession Wars, the world changed hands many times.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间，独立殖民者在此定居；一百多年后，其人口被并入天龙联合体. 在继承战争期间，这颗星球多次易主.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: No records indicate who McEvans was, or what their sacrifice might have been. The surface of this arctic world is bare of any sign of prior human colonization, aside from the ruins of a single colony DropShip half-buried in ice.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 没有记录表明麦凯文斯是谁，或者他们的牺牲是什么. 在这个极地星球的地表上，除了一艘半埋在冰里的殖民空投艇的遗迹以外，没有任何早先人类殖民的迹象.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: McEvedy's Folly was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 麦克维迪的愚行在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束之后的某个时候被殖民，却在继承战争的战火中消亡。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Often described as a neglected colony, the world is an unremarkable agrarian world, featuring two major continents: Berkeley in the north, and Rhindoe to the south.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 常被描述为一个被忽视的殖民地，这颗星球是一个不起眼的农业星球，拥有两大主要大陆: 北部的Berkeley和南部的Rhindoe.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Around 2163 McHenry was a newly-opened colony world, and the destination for a group of almost 100,000 colonists whose JumpShip malfunctioned in the nearby Muskegon system, leading eventually to the founding of the Muskegon Empire.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大约在2163年，McHenry是一颗新开辟的殖民地世界，也是近10万名殖民者一行的目的地；他们的跃迁舰在附近的Muskegon星系发生故障，最终促成了Muskegon帝国的建立.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: McKellan was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: McKellan在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: McKenna served as the headquarters for the XIX Corps of the Star League Defense Force prior to the fall of the Star League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟覆灭之前，McKenna曾作为星际联盟防卫军第19军的司令部.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The headquarters of McRae Quik Construct are situated here, which is the civil and commercial construction division of Federated Suns based Green Star Corporation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: McRae Quik Construct的总部坐落于此，它是总部位于恒星联邦的Green Star Corporation的民用与商业建筑部门.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally a member of the Tamar Pact, it joined the Lyran Commonwealth due to increased aggression from the nearby Draconis Combine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它最初是Tamar Pact的成员，因附近天龙联合体日益加剧的侵略而加入了天琴共同体.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: During the Reunification War, the world of Meadowvale acted as a Star League Defense Force marshalling yard and was a key world in the supply chain for the task force based around the SLDF's VII Corps tasked with conquering the nearby Magistracy of Canopus.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在统一战争期间，草甸谷这颗行星充当星盟防卫部队的集结场，并且是基于SLDF第七军、负责征服附近卡诺帕治安官辖区的特遣部队补给链中的关键世界。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mearra was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mearra在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某时被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mechdur is a bustling trade and industrial hub, with three different starports, over a billion inhabitants, and gleaming cities in the heart of its vast grasslands. Ruled by a group of oligarchs, it is in many ways the heart of the Aurigan region.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 梅卡杜是个繁华的贸易和工业枢纽，有三座不同的星港，超过10亿的居民，以及处在广阔草原心脏地带的华丽城市. 它由一群寡头统治，从很多方面来看都是御夫座地区的心脏.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mechdur is a bustling trade and industrial hub, with three different starports, over a billion inhabitants, and gleaming cities in the heart of its vast grasslands. Ruled by a group of oligarchs, it is in many ways the heart of the Aurigan region.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 梅卡杜是个繁华的贸易和工业枢纽，有三座不同的星港，超过10亿的居民，以及处在广阔草原心脏地带的华丽城市. 它由一群寡头统治，从很多方面来看都是御夫座地区的心脏.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Medellin was conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth during the 2773-2775 Republic-Commonwealth war in a violent battle that rendered the main colony uninhabitable. The colonists moved to a new location, Tabatinga, which exists to this day.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Medellin在2773-2775年的共和国-共同体争期间被天琴共同体征服，一场激烈的战斗使主殖民地无法居住. 殖民者迁往新地点Tabatinga，该地至今仍存在.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Medron was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Medron是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Medzev was an independent world for centuries before joining the Lyran Commonwealth.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在加入天琴共同体之前，Medzev曾是一个独立世界长达数个世纪.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Megarez was an agrarian world of little strategic importance during the reunification war, but it had one strength - the SLDF did not know about it. Exports to worlds under attack helped the Magistracy of Canopus survive the onslaught.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Megarez在统一战争期间是一个战略意义不大的农业世界，但它有一个优势——SLDF不知道它. 向遭受攻击的星球出口帮助船底自治区挺过了猛攻.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Megaris was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Megaris是在统一战争结束后的某个时候、于星际联盟时代有人定居的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Meghy was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Meghy在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Megiddo was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Megiddo是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: After the Davion Civil War Meglan was renamed Victoria by the victorious First Prince Alexander Davion. The world was a shining jewel until the First Succession War, where Draconis Combine troops unleashed massive chemical and nuclear attacks upon the world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 戴维恩内战之后，Meglan被获胜的第一亲王亚历山大·戴维恩更名为Victoria. 这个世界曾是一颗璀璨的明珠，直到第一次继承战争期间，天龙联合体军队对该世界发动了大规模化学与核攻击.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Having been conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Second Succession War, the Eridani Light Horse mercenary unit recaptured Megrez for the Free Worlds League in 2854
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Megrez在第二次继承战争期间被天琴共同体征服后，埃里达尼轻骑兵佣兵部队于2854年为自由世界联盟重新夺回了它.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Draconis Combine during the Star League era.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时代由天龙联合体建立定居点.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The mountainous islands of Meinacos form a natural barrier for invaders.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Meinacos的多山岛屿对入侵者构成了天然屏障.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Meinhof was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Meinhof于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Federated Suns during the formation of the Star League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星盟成立期间，由恒星联邦殖民定居.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Federated Suns during the formation of the Star League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星盟成立期间，由恒星联邦殖民定居.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Melcher was devastated during the First Succession War, with much of the population killed during a five year occupation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Melcher在第一次继承战争期间遭到严重破坏，大部分人口在五年占领期间丧生.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Melidron is located in the rimward region of the Deep Periphery, close to the Flying Bat Nebula and the Perses-Cepherus Cloud Complex. It is uninhabited.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Melidron位于深空外围的靠外缘区域，靠近飞蝠星云和英仙座-仙王座星云复合体. 该星系无人居住.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Melilla was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Melilla是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Melissia was a part of the Apollo Province of the Rim Worlds Republic and was conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth during the 2773-2775 Republic-Commonwealth war. It is the headquarters of Grumman Industries, creators of the Marksman tracked vehicle.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Melissia曾是边缘世界共和国阿波罗省的一部分，并在2773-2775年的共和国-共同体战争期间被天琴共同体征服. 它是格鲁曼工业的总部，该公司是Marksman履带式车辆的创造者.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Melk was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Melk在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Melville was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Melville是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Memmingen was settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era as a fortified world. It was eventually conquered at great loss of life during the Second Succession War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Memmingen在星际联盟时代由天琴共同体殖民，作为一座要塞化世界. 它最终在第二次继承战争期间被攻占，并付出了惨重的伤亡.
