Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Memphis is situated in the Outback of the Federated Suns, and is oft neglected.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Memphis位于恒星联邦的边远地区，常遭忽视.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Though initially settled by the Taurians, Mendham was seized by the Capellans in a brutal war of aggression which saw civilian massacres. The world was later conquered by Davion, and is now a thriving industrial center, though its orbit is choked with battle debris.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 虽然最初是金牛人在门德姆定居，但在一场残酷的侵略战争后它就被卡佩拉人夺走了，这场战争中有平民遭到了屠杀. 后来这颗星球被戴维恩征服，现在是个欣欣向荣的工业中心，不过它的轨道挤满了战斗的残骸.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Menion was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Menion是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled as an independent world, within a century it lay within the Capellan zone and was annexed. It is an oft disputed world, with much of its population holding no loyalty to the owning house.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为独立世界被殖民，不到一个世纪便落入卡佩拉区域并被吞并. 这是一个频繁被争夺的星球，其大部分人口对统治它的家族毫无忠诚.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Menkar has thus far escaped much of the horrors of war, and its government has adopted a surrender first policy to ensure the world is spared devastation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Menkar迄今为止避开了战争的大部分恐怖，其政府采取了“投降优先”政策，以确保这个世界免遭毁灭.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This lush jungle world is the home base of McCarron's Armored Cavalry, a storied mercenary unit allied with the Capellans. Sprawling megacities coexist with the deep rainforests, and the wealthy planet is always heavily defended by the Cavalry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这颗郁郁葱葱的丛林世界是麦卡伦装甲骑兵的基地，那是一支与卡佩兰结盟的传奇雇佣兵部队。蔓延的特大城市与深雨林共存，这颗富裕的行星始终由骑兵队重兵防守。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Menkent is an arid world lit by a dim orange star. While it possesses water, it is so salty that purification units are needed to prep it for consumption and irrigation. Menkent has little to offer, exporting common metals and small industrial goods.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Menkent是一个干旱的世界，由一颗暗淡的橙色恒星照亮. 虽然它有水，但水太咸，需要净化装置处理后才能供饮用和灌溉. Menkent几乎没有什么可提供的，只出口普通金属和小型工业品.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Protected by the Menkib militia, this world has thus far been spared much of the horrors of war.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在Menkib民兵的保护下，这个星球迄今为止得以免受战争的大部分恐怖.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mentasta was almost entirely depopulated during the Second Succession War due to heavy fighting which destroyed much of the industrial base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 第二次继承战争期间，由于激烈的战斗摧毁了大部分工业基础，Mentasta几乎变得人烟绝迹.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Merak was part of the Stewart Confederation before being invaded by the Free Worlds League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Merak曾是斯图尔特邦联的一部分，后被自由世界联盟入侵.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In 2758, a Rim Worlds Republic unit attacked Mercedes. The 209th BattleMech Division of the Star League Defense Force responded to the attack and smashed the brigade responsible, accidentally unleashing radiation into the atmosphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2758年，边缘世界共和国的一支部队袭击了Mercedes. 星际联盟防卫军第209战斗机甲师对这次袭击做出了回应，击溃了负有责任的旅，却意外将辐射释放到大气层中.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Merdal is covered in a deep sea of dense, fragile vegetation. 'Solid' ground only exists on a few lifeless stone mesas. Anything that burns through the vegetation is swiftly entangled in rapidly vining blooms eager for the open space.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 默达尔覆盖着一片由稠密而脆弱植被组成的深海。“坚实”地面只存在于少数无生命的石台地上。任何烧穿植被的东西都会迅速被渴望开阔空间的快速蔓生花朵缠住。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Though there's no official record of anybody colonizing Merlin, the desert planet is nonetheless dotted with multiple unfinished construction projects on high rocky cliffs that suggest somebody once had ambitions for the world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 尽管没有任何人殖民梅林的官方记录，这颗沙漠行星的高耸岩崖上却散布着多个未完工的建设项目，暗示曾有人对这个世界的野心。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Merlynpede was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Merlynpede在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The harvest of speckled-back prairie squid by local company Cephaloped Food Alternatives Ltd. on Mermentau has became somewhat famous.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 当地公司Cephaloped Food Alternatives Ltd. 在Mermentau捕捞斑点背草原尤鱼的活动已变得小有名气.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the three inhabited worlds of the Pleiades, Merope's climate is the result of Star League terraforming; giant boreholes down into the planet's mantle heat the atmosphere and make the planet temperate and pleasant.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为昴宿星团三颗有人居住的星球之一，墨罗佩的气候是星际联盟地球化改造的结果：深入星球地幔的巨型钻孔为大气加热，使该星球变得温和宜人。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Merowinger was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Merowinger是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Formally one of the worlds of the Alliance of Galedon, it became a key world in the formation of the Draconis Combine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它以前是Galedon联盟的星球之一，后来在天龙联合体建立时成为其关键世界.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In the years prior to the Amaris Civil War, elements of the 13th Royal Mechanized Infantry Division were ambushed by pirate forces near the planetary capital of Meyer while on patrol. The attacks caused considerable damage to the SLDF forces as well as civilian housing nearby.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在阿马里斯内战爆发前的数年里，第13皇家机械化步兵师的部分部队在巡逻时，于行星首府Meyer附近遭到海盗部队伏击. 这些袭击对SLDF部队以及附近的民用住宅造成了相当大的破坏.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The original settlers of Mesartim found a world perfectly suited for growing grapes, and many vineyards are located here - the source of much conflict in the planets history.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mesartim的最初定居者发现了一颗非常适合种植葡萄的星球，这里分布着许多葡萄园——这也是该星球历史上众多冲突的根源.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星盟时代由莱兰联邦开拓定居。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The world was colonized primarily by individuals from western Europe, and compared to most is considered rural.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这个星球主要由来自西欧的人殖民，与大多数相比被视为乡村地区.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Mezzana system was colonized at some point during the Star League era, and was host to a Star League garrison.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mezzana星系在星际联盟时代的某个时期被殖民，并曾驻扎有一支星际联盟驻军.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally one of the core worlds of the Marik Commonwealth, it became part of the Free Worlds League during its formation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它最初是马里克共同体的核心世界之一，在自由世界联盟成立时成为其一部分.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Micanos system was originally colonized by the Draconis Combine in the second half of the twenty-sixth century to take advantage of the rich mineral deposits on three of the worlds within the system.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Micanos星系最初由天龙联合体在26世纪下半叶殖民，以利用该星系内三颗星球上丰富的矿产资源.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Michtal was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Michtal在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mickleover was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在统一战争结束后的星盟时代某个时候，Mickleover被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Recently settled by the Taurian Concordat, Micros is still reliant on supplies from nearby worlds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Micros最近才被金牛协约国拓殖，至今仍依赖附近星球的补给.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once the home of the SLDF 5th Fleet, Midale is now an agricultural world notable for its thin, high spires of rock and beautiful coral reefs. The residents farm tropical tree nuts on long, curving archipelagos.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 米代尔曾经是星际联盟防卫军第5舰队的大本营，现在则是个以薄而高的石塔和美丽的珊瑚礁闻名的农业星球. 居民们在又长又弯的群岛上种植热带坚果.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Midden was apparently used by the Star League and Magistracy of Canopus as a dumping site for toxic waste; the world was staffed by a small population of workers who lived deep underground and oversaw the largely automated facilities.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Midden显然曾被星际联盟和船底自治区用作有毒废料的倾倒场；这颗星球上驻扎着一小群工人，他们生活在深层地下，并监管着大部分已自动化的设施.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally one of the core worlds of the Marik Commonwealth, it became part of the Free Worlds League during its formation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它最初是马里克共同体的核心世界之一，在自由世界联盟成立时成为其一部分.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Midthun was a sterile potentiality when first visited by the Liao. They soon dismissed it from their planning, but not before leaving behind some algae and bacteria that have since established a thriving ecosystem that draws curious biologists from all over.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在廖氏第一次造访时，米德休恩还是一块贫瘠之地. 他们很快就把它从计划中排除了，但在此之前留下了一些藻类和细菌，它们建立了一个繁荣的生态系统，吸引了来自各地好奇的生物学家.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Midway is a water-rich world with a unique celestial feature: Its satellite (Oscuro Corazon) doesn't reflect any light and appears as a pure black spot in the sky, even in daytime. The native shrikebat has been known to carry off small children.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 中途岛是一颗水资源丰富的星球，拥有独特的天体特征：其卫星（暗心）不反射任何光线，即便在白天，在天空中也只是一个纯黑的斑点。已知当地的伯劳蝠会叼走小孩。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era due to its unique flora and fauna.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时代，天琴共同体因这里独特的动植物群而在此定居.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Federated Suns during the Star League era due to its unique flora and fauna.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星际联盟时代，恒星联邦因其独特的动植物群而在此定居.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Devastated during the Reunification War, Milligan's World is mostly an agricultural world these days, with one of the delicacies being a tiny bird that is edible without removing the bones.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 米利根世界在统一战争中被摧毁，如今主要是一颗农业世界，其中的一道珍馐是一种不用去骨就能吃的小鸟。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Federated Suns during the Star League era due to its unique flora and fauna.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星际联盟时代，恒星联邦因其独特的动植物群而在此定居.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: During the Star League era both Millungera and the nearby Saltillo system were jointly administered by the Free Worlds League and the Star League, with the intention on keeping an eye on the traffic moving in and out of the region known as the Bolan Thumb.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时代，Millungera和附近的Saltillo星系由自由世界联盟和星际联盟共同管理，目的是监视进出被称为博兰拇指的区域的交通.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Colonised by the Federation of Oriente, it became a defacto core world of the Free Worlds League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由Oriente联邦殖民，它成为自由世界联盟事实上的核心世界.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Milos is an agricultural world of some strategic importance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Milos是一个具有一定战略重要性的农业世界.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Milton was a paradise world when it was first discovered. Unfortunately, it was ravaged by nuclear and chemical weapons during the early Succession Wars, leaving the atmosphere tainted and the population at half of its Star League Era peak.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Milton在被首次发现时是一个天堂般的世界. 不幸的是，它在继承战争早期遭到核武器和化学武器的揉躏，导致大气受到污染，人口降至星际联盟时代峰值的一半.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Milvano was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Milvano在统一战争结束后的某个时候于星际联盟时代被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Minakuchi is the home of Spreading The Glories Incorporated, which produces and distributes art, holos, and films throughout the Draconis Combine. Known for churning out a large number of low-quality productions, the majority of STG's titles are war movies and morally instructive romances for the civilians of the Combine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 米纳库奇是"传播荣耀"公司的所在地，该公司在龙尼斯联合体全境制作与发行艺术、全息影像和影片。它以大量出品低质量作品而闻名，其绝大多数作品都是供联合体平民观看的战争片与道德教化爱情片。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Colonised by the Protectorate of Dongeal, it became a defacto core world of the Lyran Commonwealth.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由Dongeal保护国殖民后，该星系成为天琴共同体事实上的核心世界.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mindrel was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mindrel在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Federated Suns during the Star League era due to its rich mineral content.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星际联盟时代，恒星联邦因其丰富的矿产资源而在此定居.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Colmar Myomics and Cortide Magnetics operate facilities on Minnacora, producing massive amounts of myomer related products used within BattleMechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Colmar Myomics和Cortide Magnetics在Minnacora运营设施，生产大量用于战斗机甲中的肌纤维相关产品.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Draconis Combine during the Star League era.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时代由天龙联合体建立定居点.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era, it is known for the largest water wheel within the Inner Sphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时代由天琴共同体建立定居点，它以内天体范围内最大的水车而闻名.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mira is a relatively hot world with exceptionally dense jungles and a gravity above the norm. It is quite wealthy, with a large industrial base.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mira是一颗相对炎热的星球，拥有异常茂密的丛林和高于常态的重力. 它相当富裕，拥有庞大的工业基础.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mirach was originally settled to take advantage of the large amounts of minerals and metal ores that were simply lying on the surface of the world. Easy access to these minerals rapidly boosted the planet's economy
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 米拉赫最初被殖民，是为了利用该行星表面随处可见的大量矿物与金属矿石。这些矿物唾手可得，迅速提振了该行星的经济

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Federation Suns during the Star League era.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时代由联邦太阳殖民.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Taurus Majoris Mining owns most of the planet, which is made up of its own employees mining the rich veins of germanium.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Taurus Majoris Mining拥有这颗星球的大部分，星球上主要是其自家员工在开采丰富的锗矿脉.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The icy world of Misery has earned its name, with the winds and temperature leaving the population in a constant state of distress.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Misery这个冰封世界名副其实，狂风和气温让民众始终处于痛苦之中.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Outworlds Alliance during the formation of the Star League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟成立期间，由外世界联盟建立定居点.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era, it is known for being a tax haven within the commonwealth.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时代由天琴共同体殖民定居，它以成为联邦内的避税天堂而闻名.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: When surveyed by the Capellans, Mitchel was found to be marginally habitable but rich in minerals. The massive industrial complexes that strip the world for its resources are supplemented by towering megacities that cluster along the green ocean shorelines.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 卡佩拉人调查米切尔的时候，发现那儿勉强适合居住但富含矿藏. 群聚在绿色海岸线沿线，高耸入云的巨型城市支持着大规模的工业园区剥除星球的资源.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mitchella was the second target for the 10th Brigade of the SLDF during the Reunification War, who earned the name The Baby Killers. The United Outworlders Corporation now operates from Mitchella, but produces a fraction of the capabilities than centuries ago.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mitchella是统一战争期间SLDF第10旅的第二个目标，该旅因此得名“婴儿杀手”. 如今，联合外世界人公司从Mitchella开展业务，但其产能仅为几个世纪前的一小部分.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While Mithron was originally settled by a minor religious group, the inhabitants have mostly left that faith behind. They are, however, justifiably proud of the planet's sunsets, which apparently make living in the mining settlements worth it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 虽然米斯隆最初由一个小型宗教团体定居，居民们如今大多已抛弃了那种信仰。不过，他们为该行星的落日感到当之无愧的骄傲——据说那让住在采矿定居点里也变得值得。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by independent colonists from the Isle of Man, the planet was annexed by the Draconis Combine at some point before the formation of the Star League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由来自马恩岛的独立殖民者定居，该行星在星际联盟成立之前的某个时候被天龙联合体吞并.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Miyako was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Miyako在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Miyazaki was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Miyazaki在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Four small Type A stars permanently illuminate the planet Mizar, making it a tourist world featuring some of most famous vistas in the Inner Sphere. It is unique as the only settled world in a double binary star system in the Inner Sphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 四颗小型A型恒星永久照耀着Mizar行星，使其成为一个旅游世界，拥有内天体最著名的景色. 它的独特之处在于，它是内天体内唯一一个位于双联双星系统中的定居世界.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mizdargh is located in the rimward region of the Deep Periphery beyond the Perses-Cepherus Cloud Complex and the California Nebula. It is uninhabited.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mizdargh位于深外缘中靠近外缘的区域，在英仙座-仙王座星云复合体和加利福尼亚星云之外. 它无人居住.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mizt was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mizt是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the core worlds of the Alliance of Galedon, it became a defacto world of the Draconis Combine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为Galedon联盟的核心世界之一，它事实上成为了天龙联合体的一个世界.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星盟时代由莱兰联邦开拓定居。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Modesto was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Modesto在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mogabouti was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mogabouti在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战乱中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mogyorod was a part of the Apollo Province of the Rim Worlds Republic and was conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth during the 2773-2775 Republic-Commonwealth war. The ruins of a Castle Brian, Fort Shannon, lie amidst the mountains.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mogyorod曾是边缘世界共和国阿波罗省的一部分，并在2773-2775年的共和国-共同体战争期间被天琴共同体征服. 一座布莱恩城堡——香农堡的废墟坐落在群山之中.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mohács was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mohács是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Federated Suns in the years before the formation of the Star League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟成立之前的那些年里，由恒星联邦殖民定居.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mokpo was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mokpo是在星际联盟时代，统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Federated Suns in the years of the Star League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时期由恒星联邦建立定居点.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: For over a century Molokai was an independent world before being invaded by the Free Worlds League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Molokai在被自由世界联盟入侵之前，已经作为一个独立星球存在了一个多世纪.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mondra was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mondra于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Monhegan is home to Bankin Preserve Forest - a vast forest made up of imported Terran vegetation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Monhegan是班金保护林的所在地——一片由引进的地球植被构成的广阔森林.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An independent colony for almost a century, it was annexed by the newly formed Draconis Combine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一个独立殖民地近一个世纪后，它被新成立的天龙联合体吞并.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Monongahela is a water rich, agricultural world. Prior to the fall of the Star League, a majority of the planet's land area was devoted to meat-animal production while there was a major industry in the harvesting of the native Monongahela Tuna Shark.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 莫农加希拉是一颗水资源丰富、以农业为主的行星。在星盟覆灭之前，该行星大部分陆地被用于肉用牲畜生产，同时还有一项重要产业：捕捞当地原生的莫农加希拉金枪鲨。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Federated Suns in the years before the formation of the Star League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟成立之前的那些年里，由恒星联邦殖民定居.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by independent colonists, it was absorbed by the Federated Suns before the formation of the Star League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由独立殖民者建立定居点，后在星际联盟成立之前被恒星联邦吞并.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Monthey was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Monthey在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by independent colonists, it was absorbed by the Lyran Commonwealth before the formation of the Star League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由独立殖民者建立定居点，后在星际联盟成立之前被天琴共同体吞并.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Montour was originally a Taurian colony, until the reunification war where it became the graveyard to thousands of warriors.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Montour原本是金牛殖民地，直到统一战争期间，它成了成千上万名战士的墓地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Montsegur was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Montsegur是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Monument to Man is a man-made structure, with a height of about 20 meters, containing a time capsule of human cultural objects. It is due to be placed here during 3077.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 人类纪念碑是一座人造建筑，高约20米，内含一个保存人类文化物品的时间胶囊. 它预定于3077年期间安置于此.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Monywa's economy is dominated by the petrochemical industry. The size of the industry itself, plus Monywa's proximity to New Samarkand, warranted the Star League to post a garrison of Star League Defense Force troops on world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 蒙育瓦的经济由石化工业主导。该工业本身的规模，加上蒙育瓦靠近新撒马尔罕，使星际联盟在该星球驻扎了一支SLDF部队。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Only 15% of Moore's planetary surface is land, the rest of it is covered in oceans. Due to the high water content, most of the land is swamp. Moore was settled for the large supplies of uranium, germanium, and titanium.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摩尔的行星表面只有15%是陆地，其余都被海洋覆盖。由于含水量极高，大部分陆地都是沼泽。摩尔之所以被殖民，是因为这里有大量的铀、锗和钛。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Moravian is a torrid world, with a mining industry smashed by war and a depressed economy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Moravian是一颗酷热星球，采矿业因战争而支离破碎，经济萧条.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Federated Suns in the years before the formation of the Star League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟成立之前的那些年里，由恒星联邦殖民定居.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Morgan's Holdfast was settled by Phillip Morgan, a famed pirate and MechWarrior. Using his newfound wealth made from raiding wealthy worlds, he settled this small world and formed a trading colony.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 摩根堡由菲利普·摩根殖民——他是一位著名海盗兼机师。凭借劫掠富裕世界得来的新财富，他在这颗小行星定居并建立了一个贸易殖民地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: During the final years of the Star League, Morges supported a garrison of the Star League Defense Force.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟的最后几年，Morges驻有星际联盟防卫军的一支守备部队.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the Star League era, it is known for being a haven for criminal activity.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 该星系于星际联盟时代由天琴共同体殖民定居，以犯罪活动的避风港而闻名.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Large verdant valleys criss cross the single massive continent of Moritz.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 大片翠绿的山谷纵横交错于Moritz唯一的巨型大陆.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: In 2407 a two-pronged invasion into the Lyran Commonwealth by the Draconis Combine was finally stopped at great cost on Morningside after Archon Alistair Marsden personally assumed command of the defense of the Commonwealth.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 2407年，天龙联合体对天琴共同体发动的两路入侵，在执政官阿利斯泰尔·马斯登亲自接管联邦防御指挥后，最终在Morningside以惨重代价被阻止.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Moroney is located between Otisberg and Waypoint in the Rim Collection and is uninhabited.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Moroney位于Rim Collection中的Otisberg和Waypoint之间，且无人居住.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Morrigan was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Morrigan是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled during the Exodus from Terra, Morrill is a poor industrialised world with a high crime rate. The high pollution requires most buildings to be outfitted with atmospheric scrubbers, and much of the population endures indoors.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在从泰拉大迁徙期间被定居，Morrill是一个贫穷的工业化世界，犯罪率很高. 严重的污染使得大多数建筑都必须配备大气净化器，大部分人口只能困在室内艰难度日.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Morthac was a pristine garden world until the Reunification War, where weapons were unleashed into the atmosphere poisoning the world. During the Succession Wars, vast mineral fields were found at the polar caps bringing new wealth to Morthac.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Morthac曾是一颗原始的花园世界，直到统一战争期间，武器被释放到大气层中，毒害了整个世界. 在继承战争期间，极地冰盖发现了广阔的矿田，为Morthac带来了新的财富.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled during the Star League era, Morven's petrochemical industries supply nearby worlds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 莫尔文在星盟时代被殖民，其石化工业为附近世界供货。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mosiro is predominantly Islam. The capital Al-Ilb, carved into a 1km cliff, is devoted to arts and has the largest mosque rimward of Terra. The Ministry of Information houses one of the most extensive libraries of physical books found in the League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mosiro以伊斯兰教为主. 首都Al-Ilb开凿于一座1公里高的悬崖中，以艺术为特色，并拥有泰拉外缘方向最大的清真寺. 信息部收藏着联盟境内规模最大的纸质书图书馆之一.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mostaganem is a colonized world within the Axumite Providence. Largely at twentieth century levels of industrial technology, although manufacturing does allow for industrial fusion power plants.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mostaganem是阿克苏姆天命国境内的一颗殖民星球，工业技术水平大体处于二十世纪水平，不过制造业确实能够建造工业聚变发电厂.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled during the Star League era, Moultrie's nascent petrochemical industry supplies nearby worlds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 莫尔特里在星际联盟时代被殖民，其初生的石化工业为附近星球供货。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled during the Star League era in order to capture the world's massive petroleum deposits, it was devastated during the First Succession War leaving only the northernmost continent inhabitable.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它在星际联盟时代为攫取该星球巨大的石油矿藏而被殖民，却在第一次继承战争中遭到毁灭，只剩最北端的大陆尚可居住。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: During the final years of the Star League, Mualang was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Mualang是一支星际联盟防卫军驻军的驻扎地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: While Multan is a sparsely populated agricultural world, it was the host of a Star League Defense Force garrison during the final years of the Star League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 尽管Multan是一个人口稀少的农业世界，但在星际联盟的最后几年里，它曾是星际联盟防卫军一支驻军的驻地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mumbai was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mumbai在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An independent agricultural world for over a century, it was conquered by the Free Worlds League after the fall of the Terran Alliance.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一个独立农业世界长达一个多世纪，它在泰拉联盟覆灭后被自由世界联盟征服.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Muphrid is blessed with mild seasons, expansive seas and fertile soil. The world has been heavily zoned to protect its natural environment, including a entire continent which is designated as a nature preserve.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Muphrid幸有温和的季节、辽阔的海洋和肥沃的土壤. 这颗星球已进行严格的分区规划以保护其自然环境，其中包括一整块被指定为自然保护区的完整大陆.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Murchison is a habitable planet with a moon (Oasis) that also supports Terran life, and has three continents Abla, Harschweld and Felkra. Whilst Oasis was once an agricultural paradise, it was irradiated during the Succession Wars and the population moved back to Murchison
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Murchison是一颗宜居行星，拥有一颗同样支持地球生命的卫星（Oasis），并有三块大陆: Abla、Harschweld和Felkra. 虽然Oasis曾是一片农业天堂，但它在继承战争期间遭到辐射污染，人口因此迁回了Murchison.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Granted as a backhanded reward to a troublesome minor Liao family, Muridox is a deep-water planet with vast floating hydroponics platforms and settlements on the polar ice caps dedicated to deep-dive harvests of native sea life.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 穆里多克斯曾被作为一份讽刺性的奖赏授予给了一个讨厌的廖氏小家族，它是颗深海行星，拥有大量的浮动式无土栽培平台和极地冰盖上的定居点，这些地方专门从事土著海洋生物的深海捕捞.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Murmansk was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Murmansk是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Muroto was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Muroto于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Murris is a vibrantly alive planet with an oxygen-rich atmosphere and legendarily huge megafauna. It enjoyed a brief period as a safari destination for the Capellan Confederation nobility, but the fad for fighting giant animals with Battlemechs passed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 穆里斯是一颗生机勃勃的星球，拥有富含氧气的大气和传奇般的巨型动物. 它在短暂的时期里被视为卡佩拉联邦贵族的狩猎胜地，但是使用战斗机甲与巨型动物战斗的热潮已经过去了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Muscida was one of the founding worlds of the Principality of Regulus, before the formation of the Free Worlds League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在自由世界联盟成立之前，Muscida是Regulus公国的创始星球之一.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Muskegon is described as a harsh, marginally habitable planet on which survival depended on equally harsh measures. It's petroleum and plastics industry bring riches to the world that belie the horrid conditions on the surface.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 马斯基根被描述为一颗严酷、勉强可居的行星，在那里生存依赖于同样严酷的手段。它的石油与塑料工业为该世界带来财富，与地表恶劣的条件形成反差。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Muswell was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Muswell在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Myrrdin was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Myrrdin在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Myrvoll was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Myrvoll于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The faceted domes over the mining outposts of Mystras glitter along the twilight zone of the tidally locked planet, where constant winds keep the sky clear. Despite the planet's challenges the Taurians have found mining there extremely lucrative.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 米斯特拉斯采矿前哨上方的多面穹顶，在潮汐锁定星球的暮光带上闪闪发光，那里常风让天空保持晴朗。尽管该星球困难重重，牛郎星人发现那里的采矿极为有利可图。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Mytilene was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Mytilene是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被开拓殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Naco was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Naco是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nadrin was settled due its vast stepped plains and transplanted with many terran forests and wildlife. It holds the distinction as one of the founding worlds of the Alliance of Galedon before the formation of the Draconis Combine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Nadrin因其广袤的阶梯平原而得到殖民，并移植了许多地球森林与野生动物. 它拥有一项殊荣: 在天龙联合体成立之前，它是加勒登联盟的创始世界之一.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The world of Nagel is water-rich and most settlements, during the Star League era, lay close to sea level. Boats and hovercraft are preferred methods of travel due to large areas of mangrove trees that restrict ground movement. Every year, the inhabitants hold a boat parade to celebrate the colonization of the planet.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Nagel星球水资源丰富，在星际联盟时代，大多数定居点都位于接近海平面的地方. 由于大片红树林限制了地面交通，船只和气垫船是首选的出行方式. 每年，居民们都会举行船队游行，以庆祝该星球的殖民.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by colonists from Croatia during the Exodus from Terra, it joined the Federated Suns in the years before the formation of the Star League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在从泰拉大迁徙期间，由来自克罗地亚的殖民者定居，并于星际联盟成立前数年加入了恒星联邦.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Naikongzu was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Naikongzu在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Naissus was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Naissus在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nai-Stohl was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Nai-Stohl是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: During the final years of the Star League, Najha was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison, however has been scoured clean of any caches during the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Najha曾驻扎着一支星际联盟防卫军卫守部队，但在继承战争期间，其所有储藏库都已被彻底清除.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Naka Pabni system was settled during the First Exodus from Terra and was annexed into the Draconis Combine during its formation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Naka Pabni星系在第一次从泰拉向外大迁徙期间被殖民，并在天龙联合体成立时被吞并.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Naka Pabni system was settled during the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the United Hindu Collective prior to the Collective joining the Federated Suns.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Naka Pabni星系在第一次自泰拉大迁徙期间被建立定居点，并在联合印度教集体加入恒星联邦之前，是该集体的一员.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nam Dinh was a part of the Andurien Commonality of the Capellan Confederation, but was conquered by the Free Worlds League during the 1st Succession War. Nam Dinh vanished from most maps during the 3rd Succession War due to depopulation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Nam Dinh曾是卡佩拉邦联安杜里安共同区的一部分，但在第一次继承战争期间被自由世界联盟征服. 由于人口减少，Nam Dinh在第三次继承战争期间从大多数星图上消失.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Located in the Coreward Combat Theatre of the Capellan March, Namen is near Helixmar and Quittacas but vanished from most maps during the 3rd Succession War due to abandonment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Namen位于卡佩拉边疆的核心方向战区，邻近Helixmar和Quittacas，但在第三次继承战争期间因被废弃而从大多数星图上消失.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nanking was founded during the reign of the Terran Alliance, and has been the capital of numerous nations over the centuries. It is an extremely wealthy world that is home to Rivverson Technologies and Kallon Industries.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Nanking建立于泰拉联盟统治时期，数世纪以来一直是众多国家的首都. 这是一个极其富裕的星球，是里弗森科技和卡隆工业的所在地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nara was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Nara在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by colonists from Cyprus during the Exodus from Terra, it joined the Federated Suns in the years before the formation of the Star League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在逃离泰拉的大迁徙期间，来自Cyprus的殖民者在此定居，并在星际联盟成立前的岁月里加入了恒星联邦.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Naryn is a pretty blue-gold snowball that the Liao made a brief attempt to colonize before more practical minds realized it was best appreciated in holovids made from orbit. Three failed colonies are slowly sinking into the permafrost.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 纳伦是一颗美丽的金蓝色雪地星球，廖氏家族曾一度试图对其殖民，接着家族中某些更为务实的人意识到他们还是在轨道上摄制的全息影像中欣赏它为好. 三个失败的殖民地正缓缓陷入永冻土层中.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nashira is a heavily industrialised world, that was once segregated into two. The remnants of the Terran Alliance have all but been washed away over time however.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Nashira是一颗高度工业化的星球，曾一度被分隔为两部分. 然而，随着时间流逝，泰拉联盟的残余几乎已被冲刷殆尽.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled during the Star League era by the Capellan Confederation due to its vast edible vegetation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时代，卡佩拉邦联因其广袤的可食用植被而在此定居.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Used mostly as a recreational hub for the Free Worlds Military, the agricultural world of Nathan is a prime relaxation spot.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 主要作为自由世界军方的休闲中心，农业世界Nathan是一个绝佳的放松胜地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Navarre is one of the worlds that formed a part of the Deep Periphery region known as Nueva Castile, and is the headquarters of Quixote Industries.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Navarre是构成被称为新卡斯蒂利亚的深空外围地区的星球之一，也是Quixote Industries的总部所在地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nebula D77 was the name given to a nebula located rimward from the Capellan Confederation, approximately 1,947 lightyears from Terra, in the Rimward Sector
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Nebula D77是赋予一个星云的名称，该星云位于卡佩拉邦联外缘方向，距泰拉约1，947光年，位于外缘星区.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Necedah was settled by the Federated Suns during the formation of the Star League to cement the system and its trade routes as being Davion territory.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Necedah在星际联盟成立期间由恒星联邦殖民，以将该星系及其贸易路线牢固确立为戴维恩领土.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Necromo's tiny population of about a million are there purely to support the planet's Star League orbital dropship manufacturing and repair facility. The planet is wholly dependent on imported food.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 内克罗莫约一百万的小规模人口纯粹是为支持该行星的星盟轨道空投艇制造与维修设施而存在。该行星完全依赖进口粮食。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Neerabup was settled by colonists who commandeered their jumpship after reaching their initial destination as they wished to go further. A mostly agrarian world, it has had an influx of herdlife recently.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Neerabup是由殖民者定居的，他们在抵达最初的目的地后征用了自己的跃迁舰，因为他们希望继续走得更远. 这是一个以农业为主的世界，最近有大量牧群生物涌入.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Free Worlds League during the Star League era.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星盟时代由自由世界联盟建立定居点.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once an independent world with rich resources, it joined the Lyran Commonwealth for protection after the Terran Alliance fell.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它曾是一个资源丰富的独立星球，在泰拉联盟覆灭后，为寻求保护而加入了天琴共同体.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Federated Suns during the Star League era to claim its rich ytterbium deposits.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星际联盟时代，恒星联邦为获取其丰富的镱矿藏而在此建立了定居点.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nerum was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Nerum在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Home to the Nellus Military Academy, this mostly agricultural world is filled with transplanted Terran crops, and exports Terran style foodstuffs to nearby worlds. The rolling hills are ideal for training purposes.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这里是Nellus军事学院的所在地，这颗以农业为主的行星遍布移植而来的地球作物，并向附近世界出口地球风味的食品. 起伏的丘陵非常适合训练.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The New Aberdeen system was colonised during or shortly before the Age of War, and is pockmarked with fresh water lakes across every continent.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: New Aberdeen星系在战争时代期间或稍早之前被殖民，每个大陆上都遍布着淡水湖.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Abilene is a grassy world dedicated to raising livestock. The pastureland is mostly owned by a few wealthy 'barons' who are prone to violent squabbles over water rights and shipping privileges; MechWarrior marshals try to keep the peace.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 新阿比林是一颗以饲养牲畜为业的草原世界。牧场大多归几位富有的"男爵"所有，他们常因水权与运输特权发生暴力争执；机师执法官们则努力维持和平。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Abilene
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 新阿比林

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Ålborg was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: NewÅlborg于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某一时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Aragon is an agricultural world which resides in the near core of the Inner Sphere, anti-spinward of Terra. It's location brings it wealth, as well as a large transient population.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 新阿拉贡是一颗位于内层星域近核心区、地球反自转方向的农业星球。它的位置为它带来财富，也带来大量流动人口。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Athens was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: New Athens是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As the capital world of the Federated Suns since the founding of the nation in the twenty-fourth century New Avalon is a heavily industrialized and populated planet, home to numerous major defense corporations and military academies.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 自二十四世纪建国以来，New Avalon作为恒星联邦的首都世界，是一颗高度工业化和人口稠密的行星，也是众多主要国防企业和军事学院的所在地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Avalon
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 新阿瓦隆

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by colonists from the Scandinavian region of Terra, New Bergen formed one of the core worlds of the Rasalhague Consortium before being annexed by the Draconis Combine during its expansion.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: New Bergen由来自泰拉斯堪的纳维亚地区的殖民者建立，在 天龙联合体 扩张期间被吞并之前，曾是Rasalhague Consortium的核心世界之一.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Britain (Inglesmond 2349+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: New Britain（Inglesmond 2349+）在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The vast agricultural shipping facilities in the city of Avesta provide transport to billions of tons of foodstuffs every year. The ruined Castle Brian known as Redcastle sits overlooking the landings sights.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Avesta城中庞大的农业运输设施每年运送数十亿吨食品. 名为Redcastle的布赖恩城堡废墟俯瞰着着陆场.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Caledonia
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 新喀里多尼亚

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As the Terran Hegemony collapsed, the Capellan Confederation seized the rich mines and fields of New Canton with little bloodshed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 随着泰拉霸权崩溃，卡佩拉邦联几乎兵不血刃地夺取了New Canton富饶的矿山和农田.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Capetown still retains an unstated class system based on skin colour that carries over from the days of Terra.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: New Capetown仍然保留着一种从泰拉时代沿袭下来的、基于肤色的不成文阶级制度.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by Free Worlds colonists during the formation of the Star League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟成立期间，由自由世界联盟殖民者建立定居点.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Ceylon was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: New Ceylon于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Crete was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: New Crete在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Dallas was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: New Dallas在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Damascus is the eighth planet in the system, and is home to manufacturing facilities belonging to a subdivision of Federated Industries.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: New Damascus是该星系中的第八颗行星，也是属于联邦工业下属分支机构的制造设施所在地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The vast rainfall on New Delos causes many of the rapidly flowing rivers to flood in areas where there are no defences.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: New Delos上大量的降雨导致许多湍急的河流在缺乏防御设施的地区泛滥.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The capital of the New Delphi Compact, this warm humid world is located far from the Inner Sphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 新德尔斐盟约国的首都，这颗温暖潮湿的星球远离内天体.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Delphi
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 新德尔斐

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Crescent City is known for being a pilot's wet dream, with eclectic adornments to suit even the most savage beast.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 新月城以“飞行员的春梦”著称，那里的装饰五花八门，连最凶蛮的野兽都能满足。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Florence was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: New Florence在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Galicia was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: New Galicia是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: On New Ganymede, a career miner finds novelty: the valuable ore is on the surface while the water is underground.The Taurian Concordat also maintains a desert warfare training facility in the polar region.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在新盖尼米德，一名职业矿工有了新奇的发现: 宝贵的矿石在地表，而水却在地下. 金牛协约国还在极地地区维持着一处沙漠作战训练设施.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Ganymede
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 新盖尼米德

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: After the stable and self-sufficient colony on Tortuga was well-established enough, colonization begun on other worlds, leading to the settlement of New Gascony and four other worlds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 当Tortuga上稳定且自给自足的殖民地发展得足够完善后，殖民活动开始转向其他世界，促成了New Gascony以及其他四个世界的定居.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: After the stable and self-sufficient colony on Tortuga was well-established enough, colonization begun on other worlds, leading to the settlement of New Gascony and four other worlds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 当Tortuga上稳定且自给自足的殖民地发展得足够完善后，殖民活动开始转向其他世界，促成了New Gascony以及其他四个世界的定居.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Hessen orbits the system primary at a much greater range than Terra does Sol. This means that even though the star is hotter than Sol, the world should be much cooler than it is. Thanks to the thick atmosphere, however, New Hessen enjoys a tropical climate.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: New Hessen以比泰拉绕Sol大得多的距离环绕该系统的主星运行. 这意味着，尽管这颗恒星比Sol更热，这个世界本应比现在冷得多. 然而，由于浓厚的大气层，New Hessen享有热带气候.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A moderately prosperous mining world, New Home has seen a lot of combat over the years as the Lyran Alliance, Free Worlds League, and Capellan Confederation have fought for control.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个中等繁荣的矿业世界，New Home多年来历经了大量战斗，因为天琴联盟、自由世界联盟和卡佩拉邦联曾为争夺其控制权而交战.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Hope was colonised by classic holovid fans at some point before the formation of the Star League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: New Hope在星际联盟成立之前的某个时候被经典全息视频爱好者殖民.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The New India system was discovered and colonized in the early to mid-twenty-second century. It is currently home to the New India Parts Depot, a thrift shop for old and scrapped BattleMechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: New India星系在22世纪早期至中期被发现并殖民. 它目前是New India零部件仓库的所在地，这是一家出售老旧和报废战斗机甲的二手商店.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Ivaarsen is a center of industry, agriculture, learning, and culture, on par with many of the more famous worlds of the Inner Sphere. This has, of course, made it a coveted prize.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: New Ivaarsen是工业、农业、学术与文化的中心，可与内天体许多更为著名的世界相媲美. 这自然使它成了一个令人垂涎的目标.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Kent is a remote world located at the spinward fringe of the Kerensky Cluster in Clan space. The world is best known for being the capital world of Clan Steel Viper. The planet is noted for its high carbon dioxide levels.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: New Kent是位于氏族空间克伦斯基星团顺旋边缘的一颗偏远世界. 该世界最为人熟知的是作为钢蛇氏族的首府世界. 这颗行星以其高二氧化碳水平而闻名.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The hostile fauna on New Kyoto took many years to tame, but during the Star League era it was a shining jewel of human ingenuity. Sadly during the Succession Wars, the great Bolson Shipyards in orbit were destroyed, littering the surface with debris. Whilst New Kyoto still has a bouyant electronics industry, it is still producing less than half of its Star League glory days.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: New Kyoto上充满敌意的动物群历经多年才被驯服，但在星际联盟时代，这里曾是人类智慧的璀璨明珠. 遗憾的是，在继承战争期间，轨道上宏伟的博尔森造船厂被摧毁，残骸散落于地表. 尽管New Kyoto仍拥有蓬勃的电子产业，其产量仍不到星际联盟鼎盛时期的一半.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Macau was colonised by classic casino enthusiasts at some point before the formation of the Star League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: New Macau是在星际联盟成立之前的某个时候由经典赌场爱好者殖民的.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Mendham was a thriving world filled with ranches until joining the Federated Suns, who invested much into industrialising the world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: New Mendham曾是一个遍布牧场、繁荣昌盛的星球，直到加入恒星联邦；后者大力投资于该星球的工业化.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Olympia is home to both the Lloyd Marik-Stanley Aerospace School and the Allison MechWarrior Institute. It's Star League era agridomes produces billions of tons of foodstuffs every year for export to nearby worlds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 新奥林匹亚是劳埃德·马里克-斯坦利航空航天学校与艾利森机师学院的所在地。其在星盟时代的农业穹顶每年生产数十亿吨食物，出口到附近的星系。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Oslo is an icy world home to many manufacturers such as Alshain Weapons and Galileo Instruments.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: New Oslo是一个冰封世界，众多制造商在此设厂，例如Alshain Weapons和Galileo Instruments.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: After the stable and self-sufficient colony on Tortuga was well-established, the Dominions began the colonization of other worlds, leading to the settlement of New Port Royal and four other worlds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在Tortuga上稳定且自给自足的殖民地稳固建立之后，自治领开始殖民其他世界，最终在New Port Royal和其他四个世界上建立了定居点.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Praha was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: New Praha在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A harsh desert world, it is home to the \"Colossii of New Rhodes\", a chain of nearly 150 geological towers scattered across the vast desert like islands in a sea, which has become a tourist attraction that brings people from across the Inner Sphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一颗严酷的沙漠世界，这里有"新罗得岛巨像"——一条近150座地质塔链，如海中岛屿般散布在广袤沙漠上，已成为吸引内天体各地人们前来的旅游胜地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Roland is a Terra-like planet with unusually mobile and predatory plant life, so most of the residents live on the coastlines and work on the oceans, which is also where most of the non-insectile animal life dwells.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 新罗兰是一颗类地星球，有着不同寻常的自行与掠食性植物生命，所以大部分居民都在海岸线生活，在海洋上工作，而海洋也是大多数非昆虫动物生命栖息的地方.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Roland
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 新罗兰

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Sagan was part of the Capellan Commonality before joining the Confederation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: New Sagan在加入卡佩拉邦联之前曾是卡佩拉共同体的一部分.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This former capital of the Draconis Combine was once heavily populated and industrialised, although it has recently been in decline.  It is however still the home of the Combine's ISF and an important university.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这个龙尼斯联合体的前首都曾人口稠密、工业发达，虽然近来已趋衰落。不过它仍是联合体ISF的所在地，也有一所重要大学。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Sapporo was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: New Sapporo是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally called New Sarna, Tsinghai served as a prefecture capital world in the Sarna Supremacy. After the Supremacy joined the Capellan Confederation, Tsinghai's residents turned to mining and the export of nuclear fuel as the cornerstone of their economy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它原名新萨尔纳，青海曾是萨尔纳霸权的一个管区首府世界。霸权加入卡佩兰联邦之后，青海居民转向采矿与核燃料出口，作为其经济的基石。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Sarum was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: New Sarum是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Sierra was colonized in the late twenty-sixth century, and grew to three billion people by the late twenty-eighth century. Soon after, a conflict broke out among the population that led to a global thermonuclear war and nuclear winter...
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: New Sierra在二十六世纪晚期被殖民，到二十八世纪晚期人口增长至三十亿. 不久之后，民众之间爆发冲突，导致全球热核战争和核冬天……

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New St. Andrews is an isolated Periphery planet. The planet possesses few natural resources but it does have a manufacturer - Meridian Manufacturing - which produces menacing looking Mechs such as the Arbiter.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: New St. Andrews是一个与世隔绝的边垂星球. 该星球自然资源匮乏，但它确实有一家制造商——Meridian Manufacturing——生产诸如Arbiter这类外形凶悍的机甲.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Stevens was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: New Stevens在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Sumatra was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: New Sumatra是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Originally settled in the late 2260's, New Syrtis is an icy planet with a narrow temperate band around the equator.  New Sytris is an important mining, manufacturing and military training planet for the Feds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 新瑟提斯最初在2260年代后期被殖民，是一颗冰封行星，赤道周围有一条狭窄的温带。新瑟提斯是联邦重要的采矿、制造与军事训练行星。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Federated Suns during the Star League era, it was heavily damaged during the First and Second Succession Wars, leading to mass depopulation from which it is only now recovering.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时代由恒星联邦建立殖民地，在第一次和第二次继承战争中遭到严重破坏，导致人口大规模锐减，直到现在才逐渐恢复.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Newtown Square was a world within the Apollo Province of the Rim Worlds Republic, and the site of numerous large battles during the Reunification War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Newtown Square是边缘世界共和国阿波罗省境内的一个星球，也是统一战争期间众多大规模战役的发生地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Troy was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: New Troy于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Valencia was a major food exporter during the Star League era. The destruction of JumpShips during the Succession Wars resulted in New Valencia's agriculture shifting to expensive boutique foods.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 新瓦伦西亚在星际联盟时代是主要的粮食出口地。继承战争中跃迁舰被毁，导致新瓦伦西亚的农业转向昂贵的精品食品。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The mining colony of New Vallis is located on the tidally locked moon of a gas giant locally known as Joramander. It has a single city, with a notoriously active nightlife, on a plateau covered with huge, slow-growing trees.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 新瓦利斯的矿业殖民地地处一颗潮锁卫星上，后者属于一颗当地称为若拉曼德的气态巨星. 这里有座城市，坐落在一片覆盖着缓慢生长的巨木的高原上，它有着活跃的夜生活，活跃程度名声在外.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Vallis
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 新瓦利斯

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Long after its eponymous Uprising, New Vandenburg remains a core component in the Taurian Concordat's military industrial complex, while also maintaining a wealth of other industries that make it a highly desirable place to live.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在其同名起义过去很久之后，新范登堡依然是陶里安协约国军工综合体的核心组成部分，同时维持着众多其他产业，使其成为非常宜居的地方。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Vandenburg
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 新范登堡

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Venice was founded by the Marian Hegemony to capitalise on trade routes during the Third Succession War. Little more than a trading outpost, it still garners a fair amount of traffic.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: New Venice由马里安霸权建立，旨在第三次继承战争期间利用贸易路线. 它不过是个贸易前哨，却仍吸引了相当可观的运输流量.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Wessex was once a beautiful world that had light industry and moderate agricultural production, but due to the Succession Wars is now a poisoned world with a diminishing population.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: New Wessex曾是一个拥有轻工业和适度农业生产的美丽星球，但由于继承战争，如今已成为一个饱受毒害、人口日渐减少的星球.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: New Sagan was part of the Sian Commonwealth before joining the Confederation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: New Sagan在加入邦联之前曾是锡安共同体的一部分.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nexus Ri was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Nexus Ri在统一战争结束后、星际联盟时代的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ngake Ducal Spaceport is one of the few remaining DropShip manufacturers left in the Inner Sphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Ngake公爵太空港是内天体仅存的少数降落船制造商之一.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Niangol is one of the main petroleum and ore processing centers in the Commonwealth.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Niangol是共同体主要的石油和矿石加工中心之一.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nichol's Rest was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 尼科尔的安息在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束之后的某个时候被殖民，却在继承战争的战火中消亡。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nightwish was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Nightwish在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民定居，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nihal is a mainly agricultural world that was part of the Sian Commonwealth before joining the Confederation centuries ago.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Nihal是一个以农业为主的世界，在几个世纪前加入邦联之前，它曾是 锡安共同体的一部分.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Annexed into the Free Worlds League during its formation, Niihau is mainly known for its timber products.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Niihau在自由世界联盟成立期间被并入，主要以其木材产品闻名.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Niles is the homeworld of Clan Hell's Horses, in the Kerensky Cluster. Numerous manufacturers are based here, churning out the war machine for Clan Hell Horses.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 奈尔斯是地狱马氏族在克伦斯基星团的母星。众多制造商以此为基地，为地狱马氏族源源不断产出战争机器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Niles was a recently settled world when it was conquered by the Star League during the Reunification War, which killed most of its nascent population. Now mostly an agricultural world, its light industrial base is suitable for minor Mech repairs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Niles在被星际联盟于统一战争期间征服时，还是一个刚刚殖民的星球，那场战争消灭了其大部分新生人口. 如今它主要是一个农业世界，其轻工业基础适合进行小型机甲维修.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ningpo's wide and fertile plains make it an agricultural producer of some renown.  Covered in several exotic hardwood tree species, careful logging practices have allowed custom furniture businesses to produce some of the most beautiful furniture in the Inner Sphere. Some suggest that the Celestial Throne on Sian is made from Ningpo timber.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宁波广阔的肥沃平原使其成为颇具名气的农业产地。该星球覆盖着若干外来硬木树种，谨慎的伐木作业让定制家具企业得以生产出内层星域最精美的一些家具。有人说西安的天界宝座就是用宁波木材制成的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Though Ningxia has many diamonds perfect for industrial processes, the world was actually settled for its beautiful landscapes. Regarded as a planet-sized bonsai garden, every effort since the fall of the Star League to exploit the diamonds has been stopped by highly placed nobles, including Coordinator Takashi Kurita.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 尽管Ningxia拥有许多非常适合工业加工的钻石，这颗星球实际上却是因其美丽的风景而有人定居的. 它被视为一座行星大小的盆景园，自星际联盟覆灭以来，每一次开采这些钻石的尝试都被位高权重的贵族阻止，其中包括协调者栗田隆.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Niomede is the largest airless rock in a system full of them. Yet people dwell there, deep under the surface in sealed caves. The original valuable mineral deposit was long ago exhausted, but a thriving astronomical research community endures.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 尼奥米德是它那个星系中最大的一个岩质星球，缺乏空气，星系里满是这样的星球. 目前还是有人居住在那里，住在深入地面的密闭洞穴内. 原有的珍贵矿藏早已耗尽，但一个欣欣向荣的天文研究团体依然在支撑着.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Niops system was colonized by the Star League to conduct the first study of a falling star based on generations of direct observation. After the fallout of the League, they elected to remain forgotten, a technocracy with no ruler.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Niops星系被星际联盟殖民，以基于数代人的直接观测，对一颗流星展开首次研究. 星际联盟覆灭后，他们选择继续被遗忘，成为一个没有统治者的技术官僚政体.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Niquinohomo system was colonised during the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the United Hindu Collective prior to the Collective joining the Federated Suns.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Niquinohomo星系在第一次从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间被殖民，并在联合印度教集体加入恒星联邦之前是该集体的成员.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nirasaki is a warm but pleasant world whose people are known for their fierce streak of independence. While not home to any military production, Maltex Corporation maintains a 'Mech design thinktank on the planet.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 尼拉萨基是一颗温暖却宜人的世界，其人民以强烈的独立心性著称。虽然这里没有任何军工生产，马尔泰克斯公司在该行星维持着一处机甲设计智库。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nis was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Nis在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nito was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Nito于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Nizina system was colonised during the First Exodus from Terra and was an independent world prior to joining the Federated Suns.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Nizina星系在第一次从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间被殖民，在加入恒星联邦之前是一个独立世界.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An icy world known for its whales, seals and aquatic life.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个以鲸鱼、海豹和水生生物闻名的冰雪世界.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nobel was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Nobel是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Nockatunga system was colonized at some point prior to or during the early 23rd Century. During the Star League era, it was classified as a 'vital' world and the construction of many Fort Brian's commenced. Only one remains today, Fort Brittany.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 诺卡通加星系在二十三世纪初或之前某个时期被殖民。在星盟时代，它被列为"关键"世界，并开始建造众多布莱恩堡。如今只剩一座留存：布列塔尼堡。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nogales was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Nogales在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Noh-wan Hohm was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Noh-wan Hohm在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某时被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Noisiel is a small and humble Lyran Commonwealth system, best known for its summer 'Mech games.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 努瓦西尔是莱兰联邦一个不起眼的小型星系，以其夏季机甲运动会最为知名。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Non Diz was briefly occupied by the Capellan Confederation, in order to keep it clear of pirates. Eventually they determined even pirates didn't want to deal with the endless dust storms, and redirected their resources elsewhere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 非迪兹曾被卡佩兰联邦短暂占领，以防止海盗盘踞。最终他们认定连海盗都不想应付那无尽的沙尘暴，便把资源调往别处。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Non Diz
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 诺恩迪兹

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nopah is a world with a dying star. Though well suited for flora the radiation from the star had killed all native life by the time the first settlers arrived. In response they imported insects from Terra to make sure their crops were fertilized. This effort was successful, and Nopah became a breadbasket world supporting many nearby systems
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Nopah是一颗环绕垂死恒星的世界. 尽管这里很适合植物生长，但当第一批定居者抵达时，来自恒星的辐射已经杀死了所有原生生命. 为此，他们从泰拉引进了昆虫，以确保作物能够授粉. 这项努力取得了成功，Nopah也成为了一个粮仓世界，支撑着周边许多星系.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled during the Star League era after colonists from the Capellan Confederation misjumped into the system, the world was luckily not far from known space.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时代，来自卡佩拉邦联的殖民者因跳跃失误进入该星系后，这里得以被定居；幸运的是，这颗星球距离已知空间并不远.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Thyne Weapons Plant utilises local radioactives to produce numerous weaponry for export across the Free Worlds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Thyne武器工厂利用当地放射性物质生产大量武器，出口至整个自由世界联盟.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Norman's World was settled during the Star League era, and was the site of a large rebellion. Norman told them to stop it though, and they did.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 诺曼世界在星际联盟时代被殖民，并曾发生一场大规模叛乱。不过诺曼叫他们停下，他们就停了。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The most habitable world in the Norn system, Verthandi, is considered a Lostech world with its people dependent on others for transport and commerce. Primary industries are agriculture and manufacturing which supports agriculture and local commerce.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Norn星系中最宜居的星球Verthandi被视为一个失落科技世界，其人民在运输和商业上依赖他人. 主要产业是农业，以及支撑农业和当地商业的制造业.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Northfield is home to numerous germanium mines and refineries.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Northfield拥有众多锗矿和精炼厂.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Northsun was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Northsun是在统一战争结束后的某个时候、于星际联盟时代被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Northwind is the homeworld of the famed mercenary unit the Northwind Highlanders and Northwind Military Academy. Cosara Weaponries and Bulldog Enterprises also have large manufacturing facilities on the surface.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Northwind是著名雇佣兵部队Northwind Highlanders和Northwind Military Academy的母星. Cosara Weaponries和Bulldog Enterprises在地表也拥有大型制造设施.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: During the Star League era, great chasms opened up on the surface due to a once in a million years seismic event.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时代，由于一场百万年一遇的地震事件，地表裂开了巨大的深谷.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: During the final years of the Star League, Nouasseur was the host of a Star League Defense Force garrison.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟的最后几年，Nouasseur曾是星际联盟防卫军一支驻军的驻地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nouveau Toulouse was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Nouveau Toulouse是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候建立定居点的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nouveaux Paris is a colony world located in the Deep Periphery, approximately 250 light years coreward of the border between the Inner Sphere and the Periphery, near Trelleborg and Bazaar.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Nouveaux Paris是一颗位于深空外围的殖民星球，大约在内天体和外围之间边界朝核心方向约250光年处，靠近Trelleborg和Bazaar.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: During the final years of the Star League, Novara was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟的最后几年，Novara曾是星际联盟防卫军驻军的驻扎地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nova Roma is an agrarian world. Lacking a strategic position and possessing a great deal of arable land, Nova Roma quickly became one of the \"breadbasket worlds\" in the Free Worlds League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 新罗马是一颗农业行星。由于缺乏战略位置却拥有大量可耕地，新罗马很快成为自由世界联盟的"粮仓行星"之一。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Novaya Zemlya has the dubious honor of being the first inhabited world bombarded by WarShips. The resulting bombardment killed three-quarters of the world's population, destroyed nearly all cities and planetary infrastructure, and poisoned the farmlands. The few survivors had to then deal with the \"nuclear winter\" that resulted from the dust and debris thrown into the world's upper atmosphere. The Federated Suns are currently pouring many resources into the world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 新地岛有着成为首个被战舰轰击的有人居住世界的不光彩荣誉。那场轰击杀死了该世界四分之三的人口，摧毁了几乎所有城市与行星基础设施，并毒化了农田。少数幸存者随后还得应对尘埃与碎屑抛入高层大气所导致的"核冬天"。联邦太阳目前正向该世界投入大量资源。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Novgorod is one of the worlds that form a part of the Deep Periphery nation known as the Hanseatic League, exporting goods to other Hanseatic worlds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Novgorod是组成被称为汉萨同盟的深空外围国家的一部分的星球之一，向其他汉萨同盟星球出口商品.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Novo Franklin is a hot, agricultural world settled in 2598 by Reunification War refugees fleeing the Outworlds Alliance. Over the next four hundred years, all of these splinter groups had developed feudal states, as many as 55 different kingdoms.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Novo Franklin是一颗炎热的农业世界，于2598年由逃离外域联盟的统一战争难民定居. 在接下来的四百年里，所有这些分裂群体都发展出了封建邦国，多达55个不同的王国.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An arid world, it is relatively poor with few visitors.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个干旱的世界，相对贫穷，访客寥寥.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nowhere is aptly named. While it was spared the general devastation of the Succession Wars, it has little that makes it stand out, making it a marginal world on the edge of space.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Nowhere之名恰如其分. 虽然它躲过了继承战争的普遍浩劫，却几乎没有什么出众之处，使它在太空边缘成为一个无足轻重的世界.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nox was settled by the wealthy Tamar family and was one of the worlds within the Tamar Pact, a short lived protostate. It's mines are operated by Metals of the Earth, who have a loose relation with Operational Health and Safety.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 诺克斯由富裕的塔玛家族殖民，是塔玛协定这一短命原初国家中的世界之一。其矿场由“大地金属”公司运营，而该公司与职业健康安全部门关系松散。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nuelson Minor was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Nuelson Minor是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nukus was a minor colony until the Capellans withdrew, leaving the residents to fend for themselves. Only the volcanic equatorial region is inhabited, where temperate climate allows some subsistence agriculture. Elsewhere, the planet is scoured by ice storms.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在卡佩拉人撤出努库斯，留下居民自力更生之前，那儿是个小型殖民地. 只有赤道火山地区才有人居住，那里温和的气候使一些自给自足的农业生产得以存在. 而在其它地方，行星一直被冰风暴冲刷.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by colonists fleeing Terra, Nullarbor was an independent colony for over a century before joining the Free Worlds League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Nullarbor由逃离泰拉的殖民者建立，在加入自由世界联盟之前，曾作为独立殖民地存在了一个多世纪.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Numenor largely escaped the ravages of warfare during the Succession Wars, leading to the population becoming some of the most confident, erudite and snobbish to be found in the Federated Suns. It is home to Aston-Martin, one of the premium electric vehicle manufacturers in the Inner Sphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在继承战争期间，Numenor基本未遭战火揉躏，这使得当地居民成为恒星联邦中最为自信、博学且势利的一群人. 这里也是Aston-Martin的所在地，它是内天体高端电动汽车制造商之一.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Draconis Combine during the Star League era due to one of the Kuritas wanting to play with a space seal. Yes, really.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星际联盟时代，天龙联合体在此建立定居点，起因是栗田家族的一位成员想和一只太空海豹玩耍. 是的，真的.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of many worlds settled and then subsequently abandoned and forgotten about during the succession wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这是众多在继承战争期间被开拓、随后又被废弃和遗忘的世界之一.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Lyran Commonwealth settled Nuneaton at some point during the Star League era, taking advantage of the thick lumber in the primeval forests.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 天琴共同体在星际联盟时代的某个时期殖民了Nuneaton，以利用原始森林中粗壮的木材.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Federated Suns during the Star League era, it was heavily damaged during the First and Second Succession Wars, leading to mass depopulation from which it is only now recovering.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时代由恒星联邦建立殖民地，在第一次和第二次继承战争中遭到严重破坏，导致人口大规模锐减，直到现在才逐渐恢复.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nusakan, despite its cold climate, has become home to many consumer electronics and luxury aircraft manufacturers. While these are not military industries, they are highly profitable.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 尽管气候寒冷，Nusakan已成为众多消费电子产品和豪华飞行器制造商的所在地. 虽然这些并非军事产业，但利润极为丰厚.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nyamlell is a colonized world within the Axumite Providence. The world is at approximately a 20th Century technological level.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Nyamlell是阿克苏姆天命国境内的一颗殖民星球. 该星球的技术水平大约相当于20世纪.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Nyasa was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Nyasa在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Annually, a viral plague would break-out on Nykvarn's northern continent, which was also the site of special type of grain that was the only viable cure for it. At the first sign of the plague, the grain was harvested and baked into loaves of bread which the locals ate to survive that year's outbreak.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 每年，尼克瓦恩北大陆都会爆发一场病毒瘟疫，而那里也生长着一种特殊谷物，是唯一有效的解药。瘟疫一露头，人们就收割这种谷物并烤成面包，当地人就靠吃它撑过那一年的疫情。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Oberon, the capital of perhaps the most infamous bandit kingdom, has been home to numerous proto states over the centuries. A great pirates fortress towers over the main capital city.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Oberon，或许是史上最臭名昭著的匪帮王国的首都，数百年来一直是众多原始政权的所在地. 一座巨大的海盗堡垒高耸于主要首府城市之上.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Obrenovac system was colonised at some point prior to the end of the Age of War by the Magistry of Canopus, before becoming part of the Inner Sphere during the Reunification War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Obrenovac星系在战争时代结束前的某个时候被卡诺帕斯行政区殖民，随后在统一战争期间成为内天体的一部分.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by colonists fleeing Terra, Oceana was an independent colony for over a century before joining the Free Worlds League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由逃离泰拉的殖民者建立，Oceana在加入自由世界联盟之前，作为独立殖民地存在了一个多世纪.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by colonists fleeing Terra, Odabase was an independent colony for over a century before being annexed into the Draconis Combine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由逃离泰拉的殖民者建立，Odabase在被并入天龙联合体之前，曾作为独立殖民地存续了一个多世纪.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Odawara was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Odawara在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Odell's Star League industrial base was destroyed entirely during the First Succession War
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 奥德尔的星盟工业基础在第一次继承战争中被彻底摧毁

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Odessa was settled early in humanity's expansion to the stars and is home to the Odessan Raxx, a reptilian pack animal used across the world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 敖德萨在人类向群星扩张的早期被殖民，是敖德萨拉克的家园——一种遍布全世界的爬行类驮兽。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by colonists fleeing Terra, O'Fallon was an independent colony for over a century before joining the Federated Suns.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 奥法伦由逃离地球的殖民者建立，作为独立殖民地存在了一个多世纪之后才加入联邦太阳国。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: During the Star League era, the planet Offerman was a lightly populated industrial world. Whilst never invaded, the fall of the Star League caused most of the factories to fall into disrepair and most of the remaining industry is related to lumber and woodwork.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时代，Offerman行星是一个人口稀少的工业世界. 尽管从未遭到入侵，但星际联盟的崩溃导致大多数工厂失修，而剩余的工业大多与木材和木工有关.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by colonists fleeing Terra, Ogano was an independent colony for over a century before being annexed into the Draconis Combine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由逃离地球的殖民者建立，Ogano在被并入天龙联合体之前，曾作为一个独立殖民地存在了一个多世纪.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by colonists fleeing Terra, Ogilvie was an independent colony for over a century before being incorporated into the Federated Suns.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Ogilvie由逃离泰拉的殖民者建立，作为一个独立殖民地存在了一个多世纪，之后才被并入恒星联邦.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Fort Gorndack is the first sight of many to the world of Ohrensen, a vast heavily defended Star League era spaceport.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Fort Gorndack是许多人抵达Ohrensen星球时看到的第一处景象，它是一座庞大且防御森严的星际联盟时代太空港.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Federated Suns at the dawn of the Star League, Okains is known for its high quality gemstones that are mined from the surface.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟成立之初，恒星联邦在Okains建立了定居点，Okains以其从地表开采的高品质宝石而闻名.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Okaya was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Okaya在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Having been colonised in the twenty-sixth century by deeply religious individuals seeking the solitude of deep space, by the end of the Second Succession War Okefenokee was one of the poorest worlds to be found within the borders of the Federated Suns.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在二十六世纪被一群寻求深空孤寂的虔诚宗教信徒殖民后，到第二次继承战争结束时，Okefenokee已成为恒星联邦境内最贫穷的星球之一.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Maarakiva University, located on Olafsvik, is one of the Free Worlds League's top two business schools. Maarakiva focuses more on the academic and theoretical in its courses, with particular attention paid to advertising and market research.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 位于奥拉夫斯维克的马阿拉基瓦大学是自由世界联盟两所顶级商学院之一。马阿拉基瓦的课程更偏重学术与理论，尤其注重广告与市场研究。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Great canyons scour the desert world of Olancha, remnants of massive detonations from the First Succession War where it was brutally and swiftly taken by the Combine.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 巨大的峡谷切割着Olancha的沙漠世界，这些峡谷是第一次继承战争中大规模爆炸留下的遗迹；当时该星球被天龙联合体残酷而迅速地夺取.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Old Canton was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Old Canton在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.
