Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Royal was one of the worlds engulfed in conflict during what became known variously as the Second Hidden War of the Star League era, also known as the War of Davion Succession. DCMS infantry forces captured the First Prince, pulling him from his cockpit, forcing him to kneel and then beheading him.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Royal是星际联盟时代后来以不同名称闻名的那场冲突——即第二次隐秘战争，也被称为戴维恩继承战争——中卷入战火的星球之一. DCMS步兵部队俘获了第一王子，将他从驾驶舱中拖出，强迫他跪下，然后将他斩首.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The headquarters of Foxx Infantry Systems, Royal Foxx has three continents named Vixen, Skulk, and Waagosh. The capital city of Reynard is located on Vixen.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Foxx Infantry Systems的总部所在地Royal Foxx拥有三块大陆，分别名为Vixen、Skulk和Waagosh. 首府城市Reynard位于Vixen.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Royalston was an important trading world within the St. Ives Mercantile League  thanks to numerous jump points within easy reach of the planet.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 得益于该行星近旁众多易于抵达的跃迁点，Royalston曾是圣艾夫斯商业联盟内的重要贸易世界.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Rubigen is a small, dark, and cold world with over half of its surface locked away under ice. Over 15% of the admiralty of the Draconis Combine comes from Rubigen, proving the addage that tough times create tough people.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Rubigen是一个微小、昏暗且寒冷的世界，其表面超过一半被冰封. 天龙联合体超过15%的海军将领都来自Rubigen，这印证了那句老话: 艰难岁月造就坚韧之人.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Michaelson Heavy Industries is headquartered on Ruchbah, and is the main source of income for the world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 迈克尔森重工业总部位于Ruchbah，是该行星的主要收入来源.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Outworlds Alliance during the Star League era, this quiet world avoids attention for the most part.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时代由外空联盟殖民定居，这个宁静的世界大多数时候都不引人注意.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Rukbat is a poisoned jewel of a world. Despite the abundant plant and animal life, the vast mineral resources, and a climate much like Terras, the environment is totally incompatible with human and Terran lifeforms.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Rukbat是一颗如毒宝石般的世界. 尽管拥有丰富的动植物生命、储量巨大的矿产资源以及与地球十分相似的气候，但其环境与人类和地球生命形式完全不相容.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ruschegg once rebelled against the Free Worlds League, but mercy granted by Marion Marik has ensured that the population is now fiercely loyal.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Ruschegg曾反抗自由世界联盟，但玛丽昂·马里克赐予的仁慈确保了当地民众如今忠心耿耿.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Rushaven didn't attract significant attention from the Star League and Draconis Combine forces during Operation UNION HOLD.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在联合控制行动期间，拉什黑文并未引起星盟与龙尼斯联合体部队的太多注意。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A hot, arid world with a single, shallow, briny sea, Ryans Fate survives on flood farming in the brief rainy seasons, and mining high-quality crystals and fissionable materials from the extensive caverns that honeycomb the planet's surface.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Ryans Fate 是一颗炎热干旱的世界，只有一片浅而咸的海域。它依靠短暂雨季中的漫灌农作，以及从遍布地表的广阔洞穴中开采高品质晶体与裂变材料来维持生存。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ryans Fate
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 瑞安斯菲特

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A hot, arid world with a single, shallow, briny sea, Ryans Fate survives on flood farming in the brief rainy seasons, and mining high-quality crystals and fissionable materials from the extensive caverns that honeycomb the planet's surface.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Ryans Fate 是一颗炎热干旱的世界，只有一片浅而咸的海域。它依靠短暂雨季中的漫灌农作，以及从遍布地表的广阔洞穴中开采高品质晶体与裂变材料来维持生存。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ryans Fate
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 瑞安斯菲特

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Ryde is a cold world with a great deal of volcanic activity. It is an important manufacturer of pharmaceuticals, water purifiers, and chemicals (including explosives) and therefore enjoys a permanent defensive garrison of Lyran 'Mech Regiments.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 赖德是一颗寒冷而火山活动频繁的星球。它是重要的药品、净水器与化学品（包括炸药）制造地，因此常年驻有莱兰机甲团作为防御卫守。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Most of Ryerson's lowlands are taken up by a single massive megacity, carefully planned in the reconstruction following the Second Succession War. Industrial centers in the highlands supply raw materials to the factories at the outskirts of the city.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 赖尔森的洼地大部分被一座巨大的超级都市占据，这座城市是在第二次继承战争后重建时精心规划的。高地上的工业中心为城市郊区的工厂供应原材料。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Rypful was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Rypful是在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Rzhishchev was settled by colonists during the Exodus from Terra, and remained fiercely independent until eventually joining the Free Worlds League over three centuries later.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Rzhishchev在从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间由殖民者建立，之后一直顽强地保持独立，直到三百多年后最终加入自由世界联盟.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Saaremaa was settled by colonists during the Exodus from Terra, and was part of the Alliance of Galedon until eventually joining the Draconis Combine over a century later.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Saaremaa是在从泰拉大出走期间由殖民者拓殖的，并一直是Galedon联盟的一部分，直到一个多世纪后最终加入天龙联合体.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Gold is only one of the precious metals found here, and the other rare metals, minerals, and gems, as well as the more common metal ores, make Sabinillas a valuable resource center. Sabanillas Mining Company has an almost mafia like grip on the government.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 黄金只是这里发现的贵金属之一，而其他稀有金属、矿物和宝石，以及更常见的金属矿石，使Sabinillas成为一个宝贵的资源中心. Sabanillas Mining Company对政府有着近乎黑手党般的控制.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sabhal Mòr Ostaig was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sabhal Mòr Ostaig于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sabik is a sparsely populated desert world in a strategically important location. While there are some profitable mining operations on the planet, most of the small population exists to support the garrisoned 11th Lyran Regulars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sabik是一颗人口稀少的沙漠世界，地处具有战略重要性的位置. 虽然星球上有一些有利可图的采矿作业，但这里稀少人口中的大多数都是为了支持驻守于此的第11天琴正规军而存在.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled during the Star League era, the green rolling hills of Sackville are known for producing pipeweed and Bagginses.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时代有人定居，Sackville的翠绿起伏丘陵以出产烟斗草和巴金斯家族而闻名.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This subterranean colony is excavated into a barren rocky planet. It serves as a critical shipping and travel link between the Aurigan region and the Magistracy. Trade, both legal and otherwise, thrives here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这片地下殖民地挖入了一颗贫瘠的岩质行星. 它是御夫座地区和自治区之间重要的运输与航行纽带. 无论是合法的贸易还是其它的贸易，都在这里蓬勃发展.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Most of Sadachbia's inhabitants live along the large islands scattered through the northernmost ocean for the simple reason that the most of the inland areas are harsh deserts.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 萨达奇比亚的大多数居民生活在散布于最北部海洋中的大岛沿岸，原因很简单：大部分内陆地区都是严酷的沙漠。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sadalbari is a mostly tropical world; most of the two major continents, Aberlani and Beth'lamel, and the island continent of New Kenya are covered with rainforests and jungles.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 萨达尔巴里主要是一颗热带行星；两大主要大陆阿贝拉尼和贝斯拉梅尔，以及岛屿大陆新肯尼亚，都覆盖着雨林与丛林。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The agricultural world of Sadurni once served as the HQ of the SLDF 7th Army. Since then it has traded hands between Liao and Marik several times. The small population is spread out in rambling rural villages and cities, serving the surrounding farms.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 农业星球萨杜尔尼曾是星际联盟防卫军第7集团军的总部. 自那以后它在廖氏和马里克之间易手了好几次. 少量的人口分散在杂乱的乡村和城市里，为周边的农场干活.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Safe Port was an important trading world within the St. Ives Mercantile League  thanks to numerous jump points within easy reach of the planet.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Safe Port是圣艾夫斯商业联盟内一个重要的贸易世界，这得益于该行星附近有众多易于抵达的跃迁点.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Saffel is an arctic world along the Davion/Kurita border. Both a common target and staging area for attacks between the two nations, Staffel was only just seized by the Kuritans in 3039.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 萨菲尔是戴维恩与库瑞塔边界上的一颗极寒星球。它既是两国之间攻击的常见目标也是集结地，3039年刚被库瑞塔人夺取。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Discovered by an eagle eyed private citizen as part of the OBT movement, Saggina is a long way from anywhere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为OBT运动的一部分，Saggina是由一位目光敏锐的普通公民发现的，它地处偏远，离哪里都不近.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Saginaw was settled by colonists during the Exodus from Terra, and remained fiercely independent until eventually joining the Federated Suns over a century later.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Saginaw是由殖民者在从泰拉向外大迁徙期间建立的，并且一直保持着强烈的独立倾向，直到一个多世纪后最终加入恒星联邦.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Saidia is a colonized world within the Axumite Providence. Like most Axumite worlds, it survives on a late 20th Century technological level, with limited access to technology for most of the population.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Saidia是阿克苏姆天命国境内的一个殖民世界. 与大多数阿克苏姆世界一样，它维持着20世纪后期的科技水平，大多数人口获取技术的机会有限.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The headquarters of Sitwell Corporation, the main competitor to Bluth Corporation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sitwell Corporation的总部，Bluth Corporation的主要竞争对手.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An independent world for centuries until annexed by the Draconis Combine. During the final years of the Star League, Sakai was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 数个世纪以来，它一直是一颗独立星球，直到被天龙联合体吞并. 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Sakai曾是星际联盟防卫军一支驻军的驻地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The icy world of Sakhalin was settled during or shortly after the First Exodus from Terra and was a member of the Sarna Supremacy prior to the formation of the Capellan Confederation
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 冰封星球Sakhalin在第一次泰拉大迁徙期间或之后不久被殖民，并在卡佩拉邦联成立之前是萨尔纳霸权的一员.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sakhalin marks one edge of the area of space within which the interstellar trade company Skye Traders was the dominant commercial interest, and was once host to an SLDF Garrison.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sakhalin标出了星际贸易公司Skye Traders曾占据主导商业利益的那片空间区域的一侧边缘，并且曾是一支SLDF驻军的驻地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sakhara V was originally settled for its wide variety of rare earth metals. The harsh local terrain, mostly desert, also serves as a demanding training environment. With that in mind, the Sakhara Academy was established here.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sakhara V最初因拥有种类繁多的稀土金属而被殖民. 当地严酷的地形，多为沙漠，也可作为要求严苛的训练环境. 有鉴于此，Sakhara Academy在此建立.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sakuranoki was settled by colonists during the Exodus from Terra, and was part of the Alliance of Galedon until eventually joining the Draconis Combine over a century later.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sakuranoki是在泰拉大迁徙期间由殖民者定居的，曾隶属于加勒顿联盟，直到一个多世纪后最终加入天龙联合体.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Once a minor travel hub, this system was quarantined due to an incurable, disfiguring viral plague. The moons serve as bases for pirate activity, but the status of the population on the surface is unknown.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这个星系曾经是一个小型航行枢纽，由于一种可致毁容，无药可救的病毒性疫情而遭隔离. 它的卫星群是海盗活动的基地，但地表的人口状况不详.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Salem is the location of a significant percentage of the defense manufacturing that supplies the Armed Forces of the Federated Suns.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Salem是相当大一部分为恒星联邦武装部队提供补给的国防制造业所在地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Home to the University of Salford, its lessons focus more on practical applications than theory.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为Salford大学的所在地，该校的课程更注重实际应用而非理论.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Salisberg was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Salisberg是在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Salonika is a fleet base stationed at the Nadir jump point of an A4V star in the Deep Periphery. Located near Ctesiphon and Suda Bay, Salonika was operated by Clan Nova Cat during Operation Revival.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Salonika是深空外围中一颗A4V型恒星天底跃迁点处的一处舰队基地. Salonika位于Ctesiphon和Suda Bay附近，在复兴行动期间由新猫氏族运作.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: During the Star League era both Saltillo and the nearby Millungera system were jointly administered by the Free Worlds League and the Star League, which sparked conflict.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时代，Saltillo和附近的Millungera星系均由自由世界联盟与星际联盟共同管理，这引发了冲突.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Saltural was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Saltural在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Saltville was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Saltville是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居的，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Federation of Oriente during the initial years after the Exodus from Terra.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由Oriente联邦在从泰拉出走后的最初几年建立定居点.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Salvende was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Salvende在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the founding planets of the Taurian Concordat, Samantha is a large planet where cold-weather entertainment thrives and a broad range of manufacturing industries benefit from the low temperatures.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 萨曼莎是金牛协约国的创始行星之一，是一颗大行星，在那儿，适于寒冷天气的娱乐产业蓬勃发展，许多制造业也受益于低温环境.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: San Carlos was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: San Carlos在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sanda was settled by colonists during the Exodus from Terra, and was part of the Alliance of Galedon until eventually joining the Draconis Combine over a century later.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sanda是在从泰拉大迁徙期间由殖民者建立定居点的，并一直是加勒登联盟的一部分，直到一个多世纪后最终加入天龙联合体.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sanilac was settled by colonists during the Exodus from Terra, and remained fiercely independent until eventually joining the Federated Suns over a century later.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sanilac在从泰拉出发的大迁徙期间由殖民者建立，并在之后一直顽强保持独立，直到一个多世纪后最终加入恒星联邦.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Free Worlds League during the initial years of the formation of the Star League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟成立的最初几年，由自由世界联盟殖民定居.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Santa-Ana was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Santa-Ana在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的交战中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Santiago IV is a surface garrison located in the Deep Periphery, near Kinbrace and Ramsey. During Operation Revival, Santiago IV was controlled by Clan Jade Falcon.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Santiago IV是位于深空外围、靠近Kinbrace和Ramsey的一支地表驻军. 在复兴行动期间，Santiago IV由翡翠猎鹰氏族控制.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Santander is also known as Santander's World. The infamous pirate Helmar Valasek is believed to launch operations from this planet.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 桑坦德也被称为桑坦德世界。臭名昭著的海盗赫尔马·瓦拉塞克据信就是从这颗行星发起行动的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Santiago IV is a surface garrison located in the Deep Periphery, near Kinbrace and Ramsey.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Santiago IV是位于深空外围、靠近Kinbrace和Ramsey的地表驻防部队.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Santiago (OA) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Santiago (OA) 是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sanurcha (Ildrong 2750+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sanurcha（Ildrong 2750+）在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sanurcha was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sanurcha在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战乱期间消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Saonara system was home to a military outpost prior to the Reunification War, and became a colony world after the end of the War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Saonara星系在统一战争之前曾是一座军事前哨站的所在地，战争结束后则成为了一个殖民世界.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sapienza was originally a part of the Timbuktu Province of the Rim Worlds Republic and was conquered by the Lyran Commonwealth during the 2773-2775 Republic-Commonwealth war.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sapienza原本是边缘世界共和国Timbuktu行省的一部分，并在2773-2775年的共和国-共同体战争期间被天琴共同体征服.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sappho was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sappho是在统一战争结束后的星盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the initial years of the formation of the Star League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟成立的最初几年间，由天琴共同体建立定居点.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Lyran Commonwealth during the initial years of the formation of the Star League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟成立的最初几年间，由天琴共同体建立定居点.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sardis was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sardis在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: During the final years of the Star League, Sargasso was the host of a Star League Defense Force garrison.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟的最后几年，Sargasso曾驻扎着星际联盟防卫军的一支卫守部队.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Colonised by the Rim Worlds Republic before the era of the Star League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时代之前由边缘世界共和国殖民.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sarkel was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sarkel在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An industrialised world of grasslands and forests, Sarmaxa exports many products across the Inner Sphere thanks to the Tao 'Mechworks facility.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为一颗拥有草原与森林的工业化世界，萨尔马克萨凭借陶氏机甲厂向整个内天体出口众多产品。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sarna has a dense population spread across seven mountainous heavily industrialized continents. The other seventy percent of the planet is deep saltwater oceans.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sarna拥有稠密的人口，分布在七个多山且高度工业化的大陆上. 这颗行星其余百分之七十是深邃的咸水海洋.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: After the original Terran colony was violently destroyed during the Age of War, the Star League tried to re-establish a functioning colony here with marginal success.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在战争时代，最初的泰拉殖民地被暴力摧毁后，星际联盟曾试图在此重建一个能正常运作的殖民地，但收效甚微.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sartu (Bastille 3130+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sartu (Bastille 3130+) 在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Covered in wide volcanic plains and plagued by storms, Satalice still has enough oases of beauty to support a moderate-sized population and even a 'Mech production plant.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 萨塔利斯遍布广阔的火山平原，又饱受风暴困扰，但仍有足够多的美丽绿洲，足以支撑一个中等规模的人口，甚至还有一座机甲生产厂。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sauk City was settled by colonists during the Exodus from Terra, and remained fiercely independent until eventually joining the Federated Suns over a century later.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sauk City是在从泰拉大迁徙期间由殖民者定居建立的，并一直保持强烈的独立，直到一个多世纪后最终加入恒星联邦.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Saumur was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Saumur是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居的，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Saunemin was settled by colonists during the Exodus from Terra, and remained fiercely independent until eventually joining the Federated Suns over a century later.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Saunemin是在从泰拉大迁徙期间由殖民者定居的，并一直保持着强烈的独立，直到一个多世纪后最终加入恒星联邦.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The major manufacturer on Savannah is Technicron Manufacturing, which is one of the medium sized military hardware manufacturers in the Free Worlds League, producing both a smattering of BattleMechs as well as JumpShips and WarShips.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Savannah上的主要制造商是Technicron Manufacturing，它是自由世界联盟中一家中型军用硬件制造商，既生产少量战斗机甲，也生产跃迁舰和战舰.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Savinsville is best known for the behavior of its satellites. Every thirty three years Schlera, Iris and Pupil (the moons) line up in the sky in such a way that they resemble a human eye. Luthien Armor Works built a factory on this world, which led to the population expanding quickly.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Savinsville最出名的是其卫星的运行方式. 每隔三十三年，Schlera、Iris和Pupil（这三颗卫星）便会在天空中排成一线，看起来就像一只人眼. Luthien Armor Works在这颗星球上建造了一座工厂，这使得人口迅速增长.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Savonburg is home to the Colleges of Savonburg, which educate millions of students every year. Recently, mysterious drop ships have been reported landing in the uninhabited continent of Solestra, with rumours abounding as to their purpose ranging from time travel experiments to alien invasion.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Savonburg是Savonburg学院的所在地，这些学院每年培养数百万学生. 最近，据报道有神秘降落飞船降落在无人居住的索莱斯特拉大陆上，关于其目的的谣言四起，从时间旅行实验到外星入侵，不一而足.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled during the initial years of the formation of the Star League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟成立初期被开拓定居.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An ancient water world dotted with thousands of island chains, Sax is the home of a Liao training facility as well as several specialized research campuses that rely on the planet's tectonic stability.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 萨克是一颗古老的水世界，散布着数千个岛链。它既是廖氏一处训练设施所在地，也是若干依赖该星球地壳稳定性的专业研究园区所在地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Scarborough Licensing PLC is all that remains of Scarborough Manufacturing, a once massive manufacturing complex that was destroyed centuries ago in the First Succession War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Scarborough Licensing PLC是Scarborough Manufacturing仅存的一切，后者曾是一个庞大的制造综合体，于数百年前的第一次继承战争中遭到摧毁.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Scheat has basic metal ores in its crust and rich fertile soil, and is known for exporting iron, aluminium, lumber and textiles.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Scheat的地壳中蕴藏着基础金属矿石，并拥有肥沃的土壤，以出口铁、铝、木材和纺织品而闻名.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Schedar was settled for its mineral resources. These minerals are key ingredients in semiconductors, and the harsh desert environment minimizes the incoming settlers.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Schedar因其矿产资源而被殖民. 这些矿物是半导体的关键成分，而严酷的沙漠环境使迁入的定居者数量极少.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Free Worlds League during the Star League due to its easily accessible petroleum deposits.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星盟时期，自由世界联盟因其易于开采的石油矿藏而在此建立了定居点.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Scheurheck once rebelled against the Free Worlds League, but mercy granted by Marion Marik has ensured that the population of Schuerheck is now fiercely loyal.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Scheurheck曾反抗自由世界联盟，但马里昂·马里克赐予的仁慈确保了Schuerheck的民众如今极为忠诚.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by the Free Worlds League during the Star League due to its easily accessible gemstone deposits.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟时期，自由世界联盟因其易于开采的宝石矿藏而在此定居.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Schirmeck is a world with little industry, but is relatively self sufficient thanks to abundant agriculture and lumber.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Schirmeck是一个工业寥寥的世界，但由于农业和木材资源丰富，相对而言能够自给自足.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Schmitt was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Schmitt在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Schrim was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Schrim在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Dharma HyperSpace operates one of the last JumpShip facilities in the Inner Sphere in this system, with numerous other industries propped up by the vast mineral requirements.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Dharma HyperSpace在该星系运营着内天体最后一批跃迁舰设施之一，而庞大的矿物需求也支撑着众多其他产业.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The capital city of Schwartztadt lies near to the Komache Fields, a vast empty plain suitable for pastoral farming.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Schwartztadt的都城位于Komache Fields附近，那是一片适合畜牧的广阔空旷平原.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The forested world of Scituate was originally settled by the St Ives Mercantile League thanks to its many warp points.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 森林覆盖的Scituate星球最初由圣艾夫斯商业联盟殖民，这得益于其众多的跃迁点.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Prior to the fall of the Star League, Scudder was a lightly-populated world rich in germanium. Multiple mining sites were scattered over the world's four large continents. The germanium mined on this world was used in the construction of K-F drives in dozens of shipyards.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟崩塌之前，斯卡德是一颗人口稀少、富含锗的星球。多处矿点散布在该星球的四块大陆上。这里开采的锗被用于在数十家船厂建造K-F驱动器。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sebha was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sebha在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Second Chance is still littered with battle debris centuries after the First Succession War, where numerous drop ships and war ships were brought down over the surface.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 第一次继承战争过去数百年后，Second Chance上仍散落着战斗残骸，当年大量降落船和战舰被击落在其表面.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: After the initial colony landing site was destroyed in an earthquake, the colonists moved to a new one and renamed their planet Second Try.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 最初的殖民地登陆点在地震中被摧毁后，殖民者迁往了一处新地点，并将他们的行星更名为Second Try.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Segerica was a Capellan industrial world, with extensive manufacturing facilities tucked into its planet-wide canyon systems. These facilities were the target of orbital nuclear strikes from the Free Worlds League, and the planet has been an empty wasteland since.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 塞格利卡曾经是卡佩拉人的工业星球，遍布全球的峡谷中藏着大量的制造设施. 这些设施成了自由世界联盟轨道核打击的目标，自那以后整颗星球就变成了一片荒芜的废土.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Seginus is a planet in slow decline. Bad weather paired with a long in system transit time has led to trade with the planet declining over time, although the long travel times also keeps the planet peaceful as it dissuades most raiders.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Seginus是一颗正在缓慢衰落的行星. 恶劣的天气，再加上漫长的星系内航行时间，使得与该行星的贸易逐渐衰退；不过，漫长的旅途时间也让这颗行星保持安宁，因为这吓退了大多数劫掠者.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Seiduts is described as being a rocky world, sparsely populated, with forests and jungles around the equator.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Seiduts被描述为一个岩石世界，人口稀少，赤道周围分布着森林和丛林.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sekulmun is described as being a beautiful world, sparsely populated, with volcanoes around the equator.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sekulmun被描述为一个美丽的星球，人口稀少，赤道周围分布着火山.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The dangerously high temperatures on Semenyih are just one of the dangers the miners here face.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Semenyih上危险的高温只是这里的矿工面临的危险之一.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The ice plains of Semichi are inhospitable to most life, but are home to a breed of bear similar to a terrestrial Kodiak.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Semichi的冰原对大多数生命而言都不适宜生存，但这里却栖息着一种类似地球科迪亚克熊的熊类.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sendai was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sendai在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sendalor's inland forests are home to the Manx Treecat, a rare delicacy that is only found on this world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 森达洛尔的内陆森林是曼克斯树猫的家园，这是一种只在本行星才能找到的稀有珍馐。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Senftenberg's industrial base in the Cavez Valley was destroyed during the Second Succession War, which thankfully spared most of the populace.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 森夫滕贝格在卡韦兹谷的工业基地在第二次继承战争中遭到摧毁，所幸大多数平民得以幸免。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Senorbi was used centuries ago as a staging post during the Reunification War, which has led many treasure hunters to the surface to look for caches.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Senorbi在几个世纪前曾被用作统一战争期间的中转站，这使得许多寻宝者前往其地表寻找储藏点.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sentarus was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sentarus是在统一战争结束后的某个时间点、星际联盟时代被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Serenity was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Serenity在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战乱中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Apart from a few frozen lakes and rivers, Sertar is dry. Basins of red dust exist where oceans should be.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 除了少数冰封的湖泊与河流外，Sertar十分干燥. 在本该是海洋的地方，分布着红色尘土的盆地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The planet Setubal is a desert world with very hot equatorial zones. Human habitation is only possible in the polar regions with their tropical and subtropical climate. Settled for its abundant subterranean water supplies, Setubal features extensive cave systems which are used to grow edible fungi.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Setubal行星是一个沙漠世界，赤道地区极其炎热. 人类只可能在拥有热带和亚热带气候的极地地区居住. 由于拥有丰富的地下水源而在此定居，Setubal拥有庞大的洞穴系统，这些洞穴被用于种植食用真菌.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Seuta Bimyeong was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Seuta Bimyeong于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Seven Lands (Garotte 3130+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Seven Lands (Garotte 3130+) 在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sevon - is a lightly-populated and lightly industrialized world with a single moon. A mutual distrust of outsiders is common across the world, due to the devastation caused to their world during the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sevon——是一颗人口稀少、工业化程度较低、拥有一颗卫星的星球. 由于在继承战争期间他们的星球所遭受的破坏，整个星球普遍对外来者怀有共同的不信任.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The presence of radioactive materials within the crust of Sevren support the burgeoning industrial base, which offers power plants to numerous worlds across the Inner Sphere
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sevren地壳中放射性物质的存在支撑着其蓬勃发展的工业基础，该工业基础为内天体的众多世界提供发电厂.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Shadow is a large moon orbiting a gas giant. The system's sun is only a slightly larger star in Shadow's dark sky which is dominated by the gas giant. The world is in twilight most of the time, with no discernible day-night-cycle.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 暗影是一颗环绕气态巨行星的大型卫星。该星系的太阳在暗影黑暗的天空中只是一个略大的恒星，天幕由那颗气态巨行星主宰。该世界大部分时间处于暮光之中，没有可辨识的昼夜循环。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Placed deep in the Deep Periphery astrogeographical feature known as the Orion Rift, the installation known colloquially as Shady Palms is located within the asteroid belt around the the yellow-white super giant star catalogued as SLSC F81a.0086.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 位于被称为Orion Rift的深空外围天文地理特征深处，俗称Shady Palms的设施坐落在编号为SLSC F81a.0086 的黄白色超巨星周围的小行星带内.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the only Axumite Providence worlds with the resources to maintain an industrial fusion power plants, Shahhat is at roughly mid 21st century levels of technology.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为仅有的几个拥有维持工业聚变发电厂所需资源的阿克苏姆天命国世界之一，Shahhat的技术水平大致处于21世纪中叶.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The forested moon of Shahr Kord was originally settled by the Rim Worlds Republic.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Shahr Kord的森林卫星最初由边缘世界共和国拓殖.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Shalaine was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Shalaine在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时间点被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Shardayne was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Shardayne在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sharpe vanished from maps during the Third Succession War, but the Argo still contains its location. I wonder what is there?
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sharpe在第三次继承战争期间从星图上消失了，但阿尔戈号仍然存有它的位置. 我想知道那里有什么？

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sharqah was once the base for an SLDF Division. After they left, the world's most notable feature was a series of religious retreats and pilgrimage sites in the world's craggy mountains.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 沙尔卡曾是某支SLDF师的基地。他们离开之后，该世界最引人注目之处就是其嶙峋群山间的一系列宗教静修所与朝圣地点。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by colonists from South America during the Exodus from Terra. Shasta is home to large amounts of native wildlife such as the Skatha Ape, Agouti Rat and Lute Shrike.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在从泰拉大迁徙期间，来自南美洲的殖民者在此定居. Shasta是大量本土野生动物的家园，例如斯卡萨猿、刺豚鼠和鲁特伯劳.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: During the final years of the Star League, Shaul Khala was the host to a Star League Defense Force garrison.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟的最后几年里，Shaul Khala曾驻有星际联盟防卫军的一支驻军.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Shaul Khala
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 绍尔哈拉

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Shaun (Burl 2822+) was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Shaun（Burl 2822+）在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The population of Shaunavon is mostly confined to domes and subterranean facilities. Deep fissures in the crust allow miners to reach rare earth minerals, and the planet's economy is built around their extraction.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 肖纳文的人口大多局限于穹顶与地下设施中。地壳深处的裂隙让矿工能够触及稀土矿物，该行星的经济便建立在其开采之上。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Iroquois Machinery Limited is the primary exporter of goods from Shawnee, a heavily industrialised world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 易洛魁机械有限公司是Shawnee所产商品的主要出口商，Shawnee是一个高度工业化的星球.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sheliak is a minor planet with few resources, and very little garrison.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sheliak是一颗资源匮乏、驻军极少的次要行星.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Shensi is a Earth-like world, which is most notable for its extensive forestry and mineral reserves. It has three continents (Klondike, Mongot and Kungara), which are extensively forested.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Shensi是一颗类地星球，以其广阔的森林和矿产资源而闻名. 它有三块大陆（克朗代克、蒙戈特和昆加拉），上面森林广布.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Shenwan's inland seas are home to the Manx Kipper, a rare delicacy that is only found on this world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 神湾的内海是曼克斯腌鱼的家园，这是一种只在本行星才能找到的稀有珍馐。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sheratan is described as being a beautiful world, sparsely populated, with forests and jungles around the equator.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sheratan被描述为一个美丽的星球，人口稀少，赤道周围有森林和丛林.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sheridan contains many ores that are considered rare within the Inner Sphere, making it an ideal world for manufacturing and industry.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sheridan蕴藏着许多在内天体被视为稀有的矿石，使其成为制造业和工业的理想世界.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Dense jungles of light purple fungal towers cover Sheridan, with kilometers of large plateaus with steep sides breaking through the glowing canopy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sheridan被茂密的浅紫色真菌塔丛林覆盖，绵延数公里、边缘陡峭的大型高原穿透了发光的林冠.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sherwood is one of those worlds that was eminently suitable for human colonisation without the need for terraforming, with a flourishing ecology that features towering, tree-like plants that reach heights of more than 100 metres.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sherwood是那些极其适合人类殖民、无需地球化改造的世界之一，其繁茂的生态系统以高逾100米的参天树状植物为特色.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The hot, dry, high-gravity world of Shiba is a center for mining and manufacturing, and its two billion inhabitants live in an endless urban sprawl that surrounds the factories that drive the world's economy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 炎热干燥的高重力世界希瓦是采矿与制造中心，其二十亿居民生活在无边无际的城市蔓延之中，环绕着驱动该世界经济的工厂。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Shibukawa is the world where Cholobara grows, a fruit from which a potent and valuable but perishable aphrodisiac wine can be made.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Shibukawa是Cholobara生长的世界，这种水果可以酿成一种强效、珍贵但不耐储存的催情酒.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Shiloh is an unappealing planet, inhabited almost entirely by a splinter religious group known as the Exituri. The Exituri shun interstellar politics and advanced technology, and so Shiloh has remained an unimportant and barely inhabited world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Shiloh是一颗不讨喜的行星，居民几乎全是被称为Exituri的一个分裂宗教团体. Exituri回避星际政治和先进技术，因此Shiloh一直是一个无足轻重且几乎无人居住的世界.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Shimoda was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Shimoda在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Shimonita possesses a single large industrialised continent surrounded by islands. The surrounding ocean is constantly whipped into a frenzy by massive storm activity that perpetually forms in Shimonita's atmosphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 下仁田拥有一块被岛屿环绕的大型工业化大陆。周围海洋因该行星大气中永久形成的猛烈风暴而不断翻腾激荡。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Transport pilots tell stories about the horrific winds over Shimonoseki which have wrecked numerous dropships.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 运输飞行员们讲述着Shimonoseki上空的可怕狂风，这些狂风已经摧毁了许多降落飞船.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Shimosuwa was conquered by the Draconis Combine during the First Succession War, which resulted in massive civilian casualties and an end to the industrial base on the planet.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在第一次继承战争期间，Shimosuwa被天龙联合征服，导致大量平民伤亡，并终结了该行星上的工业基础.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Shinonoi has a long, mild growing season, fertile land and ample native livestock, which continues to this day. Great mineral wealth was found during the Star League era which further boosted its economy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Shinonoi拥有漫长而温和的生长季、肥沃的土地和丰富的本土牲畜，这些优势延续至今. 星际联盟时代发现了大量矿产资源，进一步推动了其经济发展.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Shionoha is a quiet, industrialised world that has slightly too much nitrogen in the atmosphere for human comfort, requiring either special medication or respirators for long periods outside.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Shionoha是一个宁静的工业化世界，其大气中的氮气含量略高于人类舒适范围，长时间在户外需要服用特殊药物或佩戴呼吸器.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Shipka was discovered by traders under the command of Captain Phillip Shipka out of St. Andre who were trying to reach Highspire. After exploring the system they discovered that the world was rich in natural resources and possessed abundant fresh water.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Shipka是由来自St. Andre、试图抵达Highspire的商人发现的，他们由Phillip Shipka上尉指挥. 在探索该星系后，他们发现这颗星球自然资源丰富，并拥有充足的淡水.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Shipton was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Shipton是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Shira was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Shira在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Shiri was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Shiri在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: As one of the first colonised worlds, Shiro is a heavily industrialised world with major factories of Irian BattleMechs Unlimited and Grumman Amalgamated producing massive quantities of material.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为最早被殖民的星球之一，Shiro是一个高度工业化的世界，拥有Irian BattleMechs Unlimited和Grumman Amalgamated的大型工厂，生产着大量物资.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Brusk, Massona and Meijer are the trio of cities that make up the Triumverate government of Shirotori.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Brusk、Massona和Meijer是组成Shirotori三城执政政府的三座城市.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Shitara's inhospitable desert like surface was originally settled not for agricultural or manufacturing reasons, but to serve as a regional transportation hub. With access to many star systems, Shitara is now a wealthy waystation and refueling point for expeditions into the further reaches of the Inner Sphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 设田那不宜居住的沙漠般地表最初被殖民，并非出于农业或制造的原因，而是要充当区域交通枢纽。由于能通往众多星系，设田如今是一个富裕的中转站与补给点，供深入内天体更远地区探险者使用。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Shoreham has vast mudflats that criss cross its continents.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Shoreham拥有广阔的泥滩，纵横交错贯穿其大陆.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sighisoara has vast fungal growths that criss cross its continents, used for chemical and medicinal purposes.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sighisoara拥有广袤的真菌群落，纵横交错地遍布其各大洲，被用于化学和医药用途.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The planet Shuen Wan is the homeworld of the Kincha fruit, a delicacy that resists all attempts to grow it on other worlds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Shuen Wan行星是Kincha果实的母星，这种美味佳肴无法在其他任何世界种植，所有尝试均告失败.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Shui-pào was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Shui-pào是在统一战争结束后的星盟时代某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sialkot was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sialkot在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sian is the modern capital world of the Capellan Confederation, noted be the best defended planet of House Liao. It is the home of much of House Liao's major industries and political leadership.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 罗罗是卡佩兰联邦如今的都城世界，被认为是廖家族防御最严密的行星。它是廖家族大部分主要产业与政治领导层的所在地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sichuan was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sichuan在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sidon was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sidon于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Siendou is a rocky, resource-rich world and an established constitutional theocracy. Adherants to the global faith of Siendou are prohibited from serving in a national military.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Siendou是一个岩石质、资源丰富的世界，也是一个成熟的宪政神权政体. Siendou全球信仰的信徒被禁止在国家军队中服役.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sierpc is a quiet, average world that has slightly too much ozone in the atmosphere for human comfort, requiring either special medication or respirators.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sierpc是一个安静、普通的星球，其大气中的臭氧含量对人类舒适而言略高，需要服用特殊药物或佩戴呼吸器.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Vast tundras filled with mineral rich rock ensure the population of Sierra is at least well paid amidst the inhospitable environment.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 广袤的冻原上遍布富含矿物的岩石，这至少确保了Sierra的居民在这片不宜居的环境中能获得丰厚的报酬.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sighisoara has vast mud flats that criss cross its continents, used for mining and recreational purposes.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sighisoara拥有广袤的泥滩，纵横交错地分布在其各个大陆上，既用于采矿，也用于休闲娱乐.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Despite being a small, cold and inhospitable world Sigma Mare is rather overpopulated. By the end of the Third Succession War Sigma Mare was known as a center of research for geophysical/terraforming research, something that helped make the planet liveable.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 尽管是一颗寒冷小而不宜居的星球，西格玛母马却人口过剩。到第三次继承战争结束时，西格玛母马已以地球物理与地球化改造研究中心闻名，这也帮助该星球变得可居。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sigurd is the cold moon of a glowing gas giant, described as a striped sphere that fills a third of the sky. The surface of Sigurd is completely made up of an ice mantle several hundred meters thick, with liquid water below.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sigurd是一颗寒冷的卫星，围绕着一颗发光的气态巨行星运行，被描述为一个布满条纹的球体，占据了天空的三分之一. Sigurd的表面完全由数百米厚的冰幔构成，冰层之下是液态水.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sikkim was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sikkim在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sileste was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sileste在星盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争期间战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Acid rain is a persistent problem on Silkeborg. The rain is so acidic that it poses a danger to human health, although it does carve the native rock into some interesting formations.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 酸雨是Silkeborg长期存在的问题. 雨水酸性极强，对人类健康构成威胁，不过它也确实将原生岩石侵蚀成了某些有趣的地貌.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Named for the large deposits of silver found on the surface, Silver is a wealthy mining colony.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 因地表发现的大量银矿藏而得名，Silver是一个富裕的采矿殖民地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Simancas was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Simancas在统一战争结束后的星盟时代某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Acid rain is a persistent problem on Simferopol. The rain is so acidic that it poses a danger to human health, although it does carve the native rock into some interesting formations.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 酸雨是Simferopol长期存在的问题. 雨水酸性极强，对人体健康构成危险，不过它确实将原生岩石侵蚀成了些有趣的地貌.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Simone was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Simone在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期有人定居，但在继承战争的战斗中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Named after a dessert thanks to a typo by a clerk, Simpson Desert is actually a world filled with beautiful forests and rolling hills.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 因一名文员的笔误而以甜点命名，Simpson Desert实际上是一颗遍布美丽森林和起伏丘陵的星球.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A minor Capellan colony, Sindalin's frequent impact events from its asteroid-choked orbit eventually led Liao to abandon the world. The colony buildings were soon consumed by the planet's endless dust storms.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为卡佩兰的一块次要殖民地，辛达林因其小行星密布的轨道而频繁遭受撞击事件，最终让廖氏放弃了这颗行星。殖民地的建筑很快被该行星无尽的沙暴吞没。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sinope served as the headquarters world for the XV Corps of the Star League Defense Force before the end of the Star League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在星际联盟终结之前，Sinope曾是星际联盟防卫军第15军的总部世界.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: There are large underground reservoirs of liquid water, heated by geothermal vents. Occasionally this water erupts onto the surface and freezes in the cold vacuum, covering the planet with tiny ice crystals.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 地下有巨大的液态水储层，由地热喷口加热. 偶尔这些水会喷涌到地表，在寒冷的真空中冻结，使整个行星覆盖上细小的冰晶.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The moon of Sirius VI was colonised first, before the terraforming on the mineral rich oxygen poor main planet could take place. Sirius was recently a member of the Tikonov Free Republic until the end of the Fourth Succession War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sirius VI的卫星最先被殖民，那时对资源丰富但氧气稀薄的主行星进行的地球化改造尚未开始. 直到第四次继承战争结束前，Sirius最近还是Tikonov自由共和国的一员.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: One of the original worlds of the Rasalhague Consortium, it was conquered by the Draconis Combine during its war of conquest.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 它是Rasalhague Consortium的原始世界之一，在天龙联合体的征服战争期间被征服.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Often used as an administrative hub or tax haven over the centuries thanks to its location, Skandia is an otherwise unexceptional world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 由于其地理位置，几个世纪以来，Skandia常被用作行政枢纽或避税天堂；除此之外，它只是一颗毫不起眼的行星.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Skaslien was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Skaslien在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Skat is a quiet, average world that has slightly too much ozone in the atmosphere for human comfort, requiring either special medication or respirators.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Skat是一个安静、普通的世界，大气中的臭氧含量对人类舒适度而言略高，因此需要特殊药物或呼吸器.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Skepptana was the site of a major warship crash during the Amaris Civil War, leaving its surface a war torn wreck. Many scavengers and pirates find their way here to pick up repaired weaponry or mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Skepptana曾是阿马里斯内战期间一艘大型战舰坠毁的地点，其地表因此沦为饱受战火摧残的废墟. 许多拾荒者和海盗辗转来到此地，以获取修复过的武器或机甲.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Skiland was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Skiland是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An ice world rich in minerals, its geothermal vents produce much of the power for the mining facilities.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一个富含矿物的冰封世界，其地热喷口为采掘设施提供了大部分动力.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Skondia possesses abundant deposits of rare metals and minerals. Skondia produces nickel-alloys, titanium, and steel, used in everything from forks to fusion reactors. Ownership has changed hands multiple times over the course of the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Skondia拥有丰富的稀有金属和矿产储量. Skondia生产镍合金、钛和钢，用于从餐叉到聚变反应堆的各种产品. 在继承战争期间，其所有权曾多次易手.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled after the age of war, the vast bulbous plant life on on Skvorec is not very tasty but is extremely mineral rich.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 战争时代之后才有人定居，Skvorec上广袤的球状植物并不太美味，但富含矿物质.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The planet Skye is dominated by a single supercontinent that reaches into more than one hemisphere. Skye is a rarity, in that it is a habitable planet within a binary star system; when Skye was discovered by explorers it was an unspoiled world.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Skye行星由一个延伸至不止一个半球的单一超级大陆所主导. Skye十分罕见，因为它是双星系统中的一颗宜居行星；当探险者发现Skye时，它还是一片未遭破坏的世界.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A science colony which had over two million people at one point, Skyfog was abandoned in 2769 when the Amaris Coup ended the supply runs that the colonists needed to survive. The moon was rediscovered by Interstellar Expeditions in 3003.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Skyfog曾是一个科学殖民地，一度拥有超过两百万人口；2769年，阿马里斯政变中断了殖民者赖以生存的补给运输，Skyfog因此被废弃. 3003年，这颗卫星被星际探险组织重新发现.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Slaithwaite has vast mud flats that criss cross its continents, used for mining and recreational purposes.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Slaithwaite拥有广袤的泥滩，纵横交错于其各大陆之上，用于采矿和休闲娱乐.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Slewis system was colonised by the Rim Worlds Republic by the end of the Age of War and became an fiercely independent world after the fall of the Star League.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Slewis星系在战争时代末期被边缘世界共和国殖民，并在星际联盟覆灭后成为一个极度独立的世界.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Devastated during the Amaris Civil War, Slocum still remains hostile to life due the nuclear bombardment centuries ago
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在阿马里斯内战期间遭到毁灭性打击，由于几个世纪前的核轰炸，Slocum至今仍不适合生命生存.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Small World is an arctic world in the middle of a two thousand year long ice age. Settlements are limited to a narrow band around the planet's equator and the only exports of note are high grade thorium and uranium ore.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 小世界是一颗北极世界，正处于长达两千年的冰河期中。定居点仅限于行星赤道周围一条狭窄地带，值得一提的出口产品只有高品位钍矿与铀矿。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A former Star League era armory and fortification, Smithon is the home system of House Karosas. The old Capellan fortresses have been converted to civilian habitation, and enterprising scavengers scour the planet for any remaining LosTech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 史密森是一处前星际联盟时代的军火库兼要塞，也是卡罗萨斯家族的母星. 这座古老的卡佩拉要塞已经转变为民用居所，而有商业头脑的拾荒者则在此星球搜寻任何残存的失落科技.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A former Star League era armory and fortification, Smithon is the home system of House Karosas. The old Capellan fortresses have been converted to civilian habitation, and enterprising scavengers scour the planet for any remaining LosTech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 史密森是一处前星际联盟时代的军火库兼要塞，也是卡罗萨斯家族的母星. 这座古老的卡佩拉要塞已经转变为民用居所，而有商业头脑的拾荒者则在此星球搜寻任何残存的失落科技.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A former Star League era armory and fortification, Smithon is the home system of House Karosas. The old Capellan fortresses have been converted to civilian habitation, and enterprising scavengers scour the planet for any remaining LosTech.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 史密森是一处前星际联盟时代的军火库兼要塞，也是卡罗萨斯家族的母星. 这座古老的卡佩拉要塞已经转变为民用居所，而有商业头脑的拾荒者则在此星球搜寻任何残存的失落科技.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Early in Smolensk's history it was the site of the Smolensk Incident, where many colonists were killed by Terran Colonial Marines. It remains wary of Terra ever since.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 斯摩棱斯克历史早期曾发生“斯摩棱斯克事件”，许多殖民者被地球殖民陆战队杀害。此后它一直对地球心存戒备。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The howling winds of Smolnik are believed to contain the souls of the departed, according to folklore.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 根据民间传说，Smolnik呼啸的狂风被认为承载着逝者的灵魂.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Smythe was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Smythe在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时候被开拓，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Snailzar was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Snailzar是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民的，但在继承战争期间的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Snowdon was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Snowdon是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled after the age of war, the vast fungi growths on Sodertalje are not very tasty but are very nutritious.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在战争时代之后才有人定居，Sodertalje上广袤的真菌虽然不太好吃，但营养非常丰富.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sodus has vast salt plains that criss cross its continents, used for mining and recreational purposes.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sodus拥有广袤的盐原，纵横交错地分布在其各个大陆上，既用于采矿，也用于休闲娱乐.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Soilihull was colonised early in the Exodus from Terra, and remains an important agricultural world for nearby systems.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Soilihull在泰拉大迁徙早期就被殖民，至今仍是附近星系重要的农业世界.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Solaris VII is known across the galaxy for its 'Mech fights. Gamblers place exorbitant amounts of money on longshot bets, and fortunes are won and lost daily. Solaris City, in particular, hosts six major arenas and numerous MechWarrior stables.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 索拉里斯VII在整个银河以其机甲近战闻名。赌徒在冷门赌注上押下巨额金钱，财富每日在此赢得又输掉。尤其是索拉里斯城，拥有六个主要竞技场和众多机师马疚。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Solor was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Solor在统一战争结束后的星际联盟时代某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Somerset I - more commonly known simply as Somerset - is the innermost planet in the system and has two moons named Bull and Hint. Somerset has been home to a small military academy during its history.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Somerset I——通常简称为Somerset——是该星系中最内侧的行星，拥有两颗名为Bull和Hint的卫星. 在其历史上，Somerset曾是一所小型军事学院的所在地.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The Songgang system was colonised during or shortly before the Age of War by the United Hindu Collective.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Songgang星系是在战争时代期间或稍早之前由联合印度教集体殖民的.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Son Hoa has an interesting geographical feature: The Vanishing Sea. During the blistering summers, all the water in the sea evaporates. Once the seasons turn, the water condenses out of the atmosphere and returns to the seabed.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Son Hoa拥有一个有趣的地理特征: 消失之海. 在酷热的夏季，海中所有水分都会蒸发. 一旦季节转换，水便会从大气中凝结出来，并重新回到海床.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled at the start of the First Succession War by refugees from the borders, Sonnia has grown into an economic powerhouse.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 在第一次继承战争之初，来自边境的难民定居于Sonnia，如今它已发展成为一个经济重镇.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A center for the arts and learning, Sophie's Choice is an idyllic planet with vast fertile oasis dotted throughout its desert like surface.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为艺术与学术的中心，苏菲之选是一颗田园般的行星，沙漠般的地表上点缀着大片肥沃的绿洲。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sornath was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sornath在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sorsk was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sorsk在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sorunda has a large population of Buddists. It also possesses three continents named Black Falls, Serenity, and Xeno.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sorunda拥有大量佛教徒. 它还拥有三块大陆，分别名为Black Falls、Serenity和Xeno.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Soul is a generally inhospitable world. The unforgiving environment is a combination of the dimness of the system's star, as well as Soul's lack of an axial tilt. Soul is home to a Blankenburg Technologies assault mech factory.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 索尔总体上是颗不宜居的星球。严酷的环境源于该星系恒星的昏暗，以及索尔缺乏轴倾角。索尔是布兰肯堡科技公司一处突击机甲工厂的所在地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Kilometer wide rapids criss cross this otherwise stepped world, allowing the creation of vast hydroelectric plants.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 宽达一公里的急流纵横交错于这个在其他方面呈阶梯状的世界，使得建造庞大的水力发电厂成为可能.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Home to Marley Munitions Works, Sparrevohn is specialized in the production of munitions
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为Marley Munitions Works的所在地，Sparrevohn专门从事弹药生产.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Sparta was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Sparta是在统一战争结束后的某个时候于星际联盟时代建立的殖民地，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: This former Taurian world is encircled by a vast shallow ocean, teeming with native and Terran aquatic life. During the abortive Taurian-Canopian War, the Magistracy invaded as a retaliation for attacks on their worlds.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 这颗前金牛星球被一片广袤的浅海包围着，其中充满着本土和地球的水生生物. 在流产的金牛-船底战争期间，自治区出于对袭击他们星球的报复，入侵了这里.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Spica has been fought over for centuries, leaving its surface a war torn wreck. Many scavengers and pirates find their way here to pick up repaired weaponry or mechs.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 数个世纪以来，各方为争夺Spica而战，使其地表沦为饱受战火揉躏的废墟. 许多拾荒者和海盗会寻路至此，获取修复后的武器或机甲.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Spirit was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Second Succession War.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Spirit在星际联盟时代，即统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在第二次继承战争期间的交战中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Orignally a Draconis Combine world, Spittal is now part of the Free Resalhague Republic. Spittal is home to Benson and Bjorn which manufacures a variety of military vehicles.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Spittal原本是一个天龙联合体星球，现在是自由拉萨尔哈格共和国的一部分. Spittal是Benson and Bjorn的所在地，该公司生产各种军用车辆.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A nearly lifeless world reminiscent of primordial Terra, Spitz is primarily of interest to exogeologists who study the early days of future life-bearing planets.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 施皮茨是一个几乎没有生命的星球，让人回忆起原始地球. 关注施皮茨的人主要是研究未来宜居行星的早期阶段的地外地质学家.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: St. Andre is a red desert planet located anti-spin of Terra, notable for its rich natural resources. St. Andre is noteworthy for the meeting of leaders in 2366 that formed the Capellan Confederation.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: St. Andre是一颗位于泰拉反旋向的红色沙漠行星，以其丰富的自然资源而闻名. St. Andre之所以引人注目，是因为2366年在此举行的领导人会议组建了卡佩拉邦联.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: St. Timalin is a recently rediscovered planet in the St. Andreas system, orbiting a dim red primary. It is a dark world, with black flora that has evolved to survive on the dim light emitted by the red primary, which the colonists named St. Andreas.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: St. Timalin是St. Andreas星系中最近被重新发现的一颗行星，环绕一颗暗淡的红色主星运行. 它是一颗黑暗的世界，拥有黑色植物群，这些植物已经进化到能在红色主星St. Andreas发出的微弱光线下生存.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: St. Cyr was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: St. Cyr是在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候被殖民的，但在继承战争的战火中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: St. Gall was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: St. Gall在星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时候有人定居，但在继承战争期间的交战中消亡了.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: St. Ives is the capital of the newly formed St. Ives League. The military industries on the planet have been built in to the vast cavern networks present on the planet, forcing attackers to attempt to seize them in costly close quarters actions.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: St. Ives是新成立的St. Ives联盟的首都. 该行星上的军事工业已建入行星上庞大的洞穴网络之中，迫使进攻者试图以代价高昂的近距离作战夺取它们.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: St. Ives
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 圣艾夫斯

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: The St. Jean colony is situated on the system's second planet. Barely 500 monks remain on the colony, as the planet slowly dies out as its largest moon falls towards the planet.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 圣让殖民地位于该星系的第二颗行星上。殖民地仅剩不到500名修士，因为随着它最大的卫星向行星坠落，这个世界正慢慢消亡。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: St John is an oceanic world, consisting of a few large islands that are dotted around an ocean mostly free of ice, except at the poles. There are great tidal plains that appear during the lunar cycle, showcasing wreckage from ancient battlefields.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: St John是一个海洋世界，由几座大岛组成，这些岛屿散布在一片大部分无冰的海洋中，只有两极除外. 在月相周期期间会出现大片潮汐平原，露出古代战场的残骸.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: St. Loris is an important agricultural center. In 3010 the 2nd St. Ives Lancers fought the Ceti Hussars there and much of the planet's vital wheat crop was destroyed, which caused a mighty famine. The crop has recovered, but the population has not.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 圣洛里斯是一处重要的农业中心。3010年，第2圣艾夫斯枪骑兵在此与塞提骠骑兵交战，星球上大量重要的小麦作物被毁，引发了一场严重饥荒。作物后来恢复了，人口却再未回到从前。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: St. Loris
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 圣洛里斯

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Dense jungles of light blue fungal towers cover St. Robert, with kilometers of large plateaus with steep sides breaking through the canopy.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 茂密的淡蓝色真菌塔丛林覆盖着St. Robert，绵延数公里、侧壁陡峭的大型高原穿透了林冠.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Staffin was settled during the Star League era at some point after the end of the Reunification War but died out during the fighting in the Succession Wars.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Staffin于星际联盟时代、统一战争结束后的某个时期被殖民，但在继承战争的战火中消亡.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A large recruiting world for the Marian Hegemony, Stafford's high gravity produces extremely muscular troopers who excel in mountainous terrain.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为马里亚纳霸权的大型募兵世界，斯塔福德的高重力造就了极为强壮的士兵，他们在山地地形中表现出色。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: A supercontinent with some small, shallow seas that are constantly steaming. Spires of sharp stone interrupt the otherwise flat terrain.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 一片超大陆，点缀着几片不断冒着蒸汽的浅小海洋. 尖锐的石峰打破了原本平坦的地形.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Settled by scientists during the first Exodus as a research station to examine the planet's rings, 'Stantsia' has evolved into a fully self sufficient colony.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 作为第一次大逃亡期间科学家们为考察该星球环系统而建的研究站，“斯坦齐亚”已发展为一个完全自给自足的殖民地。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Stanzach took severe damage in the Fourth Succession War, and the recovery was stifled when it become part of the recently formed Free Rasalhague Republic. Regardless, it is still an important economic system for the FRR.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: Stanzach在第四次继承战争中遭受了严重破坏，而当它成为新近成立的自由拉萨尔哈格共和国的一部分时，其复苏又受到了抑制. 尽管如此，它仍是FRR重要的经济星系.

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: Named for its poor agriculture, Stapelfeld is a grubby little world with little going for it. And that's what the last mayor called it.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 因农业贫瘠而得名，施塔佩尔费尔德是一颗邋遢的小行星，几乎一无是处。而这话还是上一任市长说的。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An unexplored star cluster outside the Inner Sphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 内天体之外一处未经探索的星团。

Localization.CULTURE_EN_US: An unexplored star cluster outside the Inner Sphere.
Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 内天体之外一处未经探索的星团。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 内天体之外一处未经探索的星团。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 内天体之外一处未经探索的星团。

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 星团752

Localization.CULTURE_ZH_CN: 内天体之外一处未经探索的星团。
